name: Aboleth
description:
Before the coming of the gods, aboleths lurked in primordial oceans and underground lakes. They reached out with their minds and seized control of the burgeoning life-forms of the mortal realm, making those creatures their slaves.
Aboleth for use in any epic adventure!

pt.name: Aboleth
pt.description:
Antes da chegada dos deuses, os aboleths espreitavam em oceanos primordiais e lagos subterrâneos. Estendiam as suas mentes e tomavam controlo das formas de vida emergentes do reino mortal, transformando essas criaturas em seus escravos.
Aboleth para usar em qualquer aventura épica!

name: Abyssal Chicken
description:
Abyssal chickens are carnivorous, temperamental, tasty bottom-feeders native to the Abyss. They beat their leathery wings to scare predators and to help them run faster, and they taste like fatty chicken.
Abyssal chicken for use in any epic adventure!

pt.name: Galinha Abissal
pt.description:
As galinhas abissais são carnívoras, temperamentais e saborosas criaturas de fundo, nativas do Abismo. Batem as suas asas coriáceas para assustar predadores e para correr mais depressa, e têm sabor a galinha gorda.
Galinha abissal para usar em qualquer aventura épica!

name: Abyssal Rooster
description:
Abyssal chickens are carnivorous, temperamental, tasty bottom-feeders native to the Abyss. They beat their leathery wings to scare predators and to help them run faster, and they taste like fatty chicken.
Abyssal chicken for use in any epic adventure!

name: Active Shadow
description:
Shadows are undead that resemble dark exaggerations of humanoid shadows.
Shadow for use in any epic adventure!

name: Adult Blue Dragon
description:
Adult blue dragons command small empires, which might be territories of subjugated followers, shadowy criminal networks, or cultic enclaves. Endlessly suspicious and wary of rivals, these dragons enact elaborate schemes to ruin their foes, test the loyalty of their servants, and ensure their dominance for centuries.
Adult Blue Dragon for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Adult Green Dragon
description:
The most cunning and treacherous of true dragons, green dragons use misdirection and trickery to get the upper hand against their enemies. Nasty tempered and thoroughly evil, they take special pleasure in subverting and corrupting the good-hearted.
Adult Green Dragon for use in any epic adventure!

name: Aggravated Akhlut (Land)
description:
Possessing the body, head, and tail of a killer whale and the powerful legs of a huge wolf, the akhlut is the alpha predator of the polar landscape.
Aggravated Akhlut for use in any epic adventure!

name: Aggravated Akhlut (Water)
description:
Possessing the body, head, and tail of a killer whale and the powerful legs of a huge wolf, the akhlut is the alpha predator of the polar landscape.
Aggravated Akhlut for use in any epic adventure!

name: Agro Leucrotta
description:
A leucrotta is what you would get if you took the head of a giant badger, the legs of a deer, and the body of a large hyena, then put them together and reanimated them with demon ichor without bothering to cover up the stink of death.
Leucrotta for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Agro Vine Blight
description:
Alone among the blights, vine blights could speak, and their connection to the spirit of the Gulthias tree that spawned them meant that they spoke in a broken version of the spirit's voice. They were known to taunt victims and bargain with more powerful foes.
Vine Blight for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Air Elemental
description:
Elementals are incarnations of the elements that make up the universe: air, earth, fire, and water. Though little more than animated energy on their own planes of existence, they can be called on by spellcasters and powerful beings to take shape and perform tasks.
Air Elementals for use in any epic adventure!

name: Alert Chuul
description:
Survivors of the ancient aboleth empire, chuuls are crustaceans the aboleths modified and endowed with sentience. They follow the ingrained directives of their creators, as they have done since the dawn of time.
Chuul for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Alert Ghoul
description:
Ghouls roam the night in packs, driven by an insatiable hunger for humanoid flesh.
Staring Ghoul for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Alert Gorgon
description:
Few creatures that encounter a gorgon live to tell about it. Its body is covered in iron plates, and its nostrils fume with green vapor.
Gorgon for use in any epic adventure!

name: Alert Needle Blight
description:
Needle blights have vaguely bipedal forms, with gaunt, misshapen limbs. While they looked enough like a hunched humanoid to be mistaken for one in the shadows of a forest, when standing unnaturally still or lurching with their awkward gaits, these blights can't pass as either normal plants or woodland travelers.
Needle Blight for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Alert Troglodyte
description:
Troglodytes are barbaric reptilian humanoids, coated with rough leathery scales.
Watchful Troglodyte for use in any epic adventure!  for use in any epic adventure!

name: Alert Witherling
description:
By invoking rituals to Yeenoghu, they bring the remains of their slain comrades back to a semblance of life in the form of a gnoll witherling.
Witherling for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Ancient Red Dragon
description:
The most covetous of the true dragons, red dragons tirelessly seek to increase their treasure hoards. They are exceptionally vain, even for dragons, and their conceit is reflected in their proud bearing and their disdain for other creatures.
Ancient Red Dragon for use in any epic dungeon adventure!
.

name: Animated Armour
description:
Animated suit of plate armor, crafted with magic to follow the command of its creators
Animated Armour for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Ankheg
description:
Formicid are huge insectoid monsters. They are ambush predators that hunt thier prey from below the ground
Formicid for use in any epic adventure!

name: Annis Hag
description:
Annis hags were the most physically imposing of their race. Wickedly cruel and physically powerful they were often compared to ogresses.
Annis hag for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Armored Fighter
description:
Fighters are skilled warriors trained in the arts of war, all were trained to use virtually any armor or weapon with great skill.
Armored Fighter for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Army of Bullywugs
description:
Life as a bullywug is nasty, brutish, and wet. These frog-headed amphibious humanoids must stay constantly moist, dwelling in rainy forests, marshes, and damp caves.
Bullywugs for use in any epic adventure!

name: Atropal
description:
An atropal is malformed and unfinished. Its wet, wrinkled, and bloated body is surmounted by a hairless, overlarge head set with glassy, vacant eyes. Since an atropal was never truly alive, it can't be raised from the dead or resurrected by any means. Even divine intervention can't breathe true life into this hateful, miserable horror.
Atropal for use in any epic adventure!

name: Attacking Bulette - Book of Beasts
description:
Land Shark from the 'Adventurers Guide - The Book of Beasts' kickstarter campaign. Late pledges still available!
Attacking Land Shark for use in any epic adventure!

pt.name: Bulette a Atacar - Book of Beasts
pt.description:
Tubarão-da-Terra da campanha de kickstarter 'Adventurers Guide - The Book of Beasts'. Ainda há apoios em atraso disponíveis!
Tubarão-da-Terra a atacar para usar em qualquer aventura épica!

name: Attacking Flame Salamander
description:
Salamanders slither across the Sea of Ash on the Elemental Plane of Fire, their sinuous coils and jagged spines smoldering. Intense heat washes off their bodies, while their yellow eyes glow like candles in the deep-set hollows of their hawkish faces.
Salamander for use in any epic adventure!

name: Attacking Witherling
description:
By invoking rituals to Yeenoghu, they bring the remains of their slain comrades back to a semblance of life in the form of a gnoll witherling.
Witherling for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Auril - First Form
description:
Frozen Queen is a lesser god who embodies winters cruelty. In her first form the Frozen Queen is seen as a large hunched humanoid with the head of an owl, talons for hands and large goat like horns.
Frozen Queens first form for use in any epic adventure!

name: Auril - Second Form
description:
Frozen Queen is a lesser god who embodies winters creulety. In her second form The Frozen Queen is a 10ft tall woman of ice. She crackles as she moves and blades of ice protrude from her body.
Frozen Queens second form for use in any epic adventure!

name: Auril - Third Form
description:
Frozen Queen is a lesser god who embodies winters creulety. In her third form the Frozen Queen is seen as a floating ice diamond that holds her devine spark.
Frozen Queen third form for use in any epic adventure!

name: Auril All Forms Bundle
description:
Frozen Queen is a lesser god who embodies winters creulety in all her forms.
All 3 forms of the Frozen Queen at a 30% discount!
Frozen Queen for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Aurumvorax
description:
Despite only being an average length of 3ft, the Gorger is an incredibly dangerous creature. Being heavily muscled and weighing over 500 pounds provides much of it’s natural protection but this combined with its speed, power and sheer viciousness make it a fearsome creature to encounter.
Gorger for use in any epic adventure!

name: Axe Beak
description:
An axe beak is a tall flightless bird with strong legs and a heavy, wedge-shaped beak. It has a nasty disposition and tends to attack any unfamiliar creature that wanders too close.
Axe Beak for use in any epic adventure!

name: Baby Myceloid - Book of Beasts
description:
Baby Myceloid from the 'Adventurers Guide - The Book of Beasts' kickstarter campaign. Late pledges still available!
Baby Myceloid for use in any epic adventure!

name: Bagman
description:
The Bagman is an urban legend about an adventurer who sought to escape doom by abandoning his party and hiding inside a bag of holding. When he tried to leave, though, he became lost amid a constantly increasing number of extradimensional storage spaces. Over time, the strange forces of this magical in-between place transformed the adventurer into a monstrous creature.
Bagman for use in any epic adventure!

name: Balor
description:
Figures of ancient and terrible evil, balors rule as generals over demonic armies, yearning to seize power while destroying any creatures that oppose them.
Balor for use in any epic adventure!

name: Banderhobb
description:
A banderhobb is a hybrid of shadow and flesh. Through dark magic, these components take on an enormous and vile humanoid shape, resembling a bipedal toad. In this form, a banderhobb temporarily serves its creator as a thug, a thief, and a kidnapper.
Banderhobb for use in any epic adventure!

name: Bandit
description:
Bandits rove in gangs and are sometimes led by thugs, veterans, or spellcasters. Not all bandits are evil. Oppression, drought, disease, or famine can often drive otherwise honest folk to a life of banditry.
Bandit for use in any epic adventure!

name: Bandit Captain
description:
Bandits rove in gangs and are sometimes led by thugs, veterans, or spellcasters. Not all bandits are evil. Oppression, drought, disease, or famine can often drive otherwise honest folk to a life of banditry.
Bandit Captain for use in any epic adventure!

name: Banshee
description:
When night falls, unlucky travelers hear the faint cries of the forlorn dead. This woeful spirit is a banshee, a spiteful creature formed from the spirit of a female elf. Banshees appear as luminous, wispy forms that vaguely recall their mortal features. A banshee's face is wreathed in a wild tangle of hair, its body clad in wispy rags that flutter and stream around it.
Banshee for use in any epic adventure!

name: Barlgura
description:
The barlgura represents the savagery and brutality of the Abyss. Barlguras gather in packs to take down tougher foes, keep gruesome trophies from their victories, and decorate their territory with such objects.
Barlgura for use in any epic adventure!

name: Barovian Witch
description:
The mad women and men known as Barovian witches forge pacts with Strahd and the Dark Powers of Ravenloft in exchange for magic and longevity.
Barovian Witch for use in any epic adventure!

name: Barovian Witches
description:
The mad women and men known as Barovian witches forge pacts with Strahd and the Dark Powers of Ravenloft in exchange for magic and longevity.
Barovian Witch for use in any epic adventure!

name: Basilisk
description:
Basilisks are large, eight-legged reptiles with adults typically weighing around 300 pounds and reaching 11 - 13ft. With the ability to poison or petrify their prey, travelers sometimes found objects that looked like pieces of remarkably lifelike stone carvings of wildlife. Seasoned explorers regard such relics as warnings, knowing the basilisk that created them is likely to be nearby.
Basilisk for use in any epic adventure!

name: Battle Steeder (Female)
description:
Giant hunting spiders, steeders prowl the depths of the Underdark. Female steeders grow larger and stronger than males, and the female often devours the male after breeding. Numerous Underdark folk domesticate steeders, particularly duergar. Typically the females serve as steeds in battle, while the males are used as draft animals.
Female Steeder for use in any epic adventure!

name: Behir
description:
The Behir has a long, snake-like body, with six pairs of legs. Adults typically reached lengths of 40ft.
Behir for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Beholder
description:
Large, orb-shaped beings, their entire body covered in eyes, each containing a powerful magic. Beholders have the capacity to see in all directions at once making it nearly impossible to ambush them. Powerful and intelligent, beholders are among the greatest threats to the world.
Eye Tyrant / Beholder for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Beholders - Book of Beasts
description:
Eye Tyrant Bundle from the 'Adventurers Guide - The Book of Beasts' kickstarter campaign. Late pledges still available!
This pack includes 3 unique Eye Tyrant designs, including a defeated variant.
Fully Pre-supported (for resin printing) in 32mm and 54mm scaling options, with chitu files provided!

name: Blood Tyrant
description:
A Blood Tyrant is a lesser tyrant-kin with tentacles that ended in mouths instead of eyestalks. Blood Tyrant's came to being as physical manifestations of tyrants' vivid dreams of mass blood loss.
Blood Tyrant for use in any epic adventure!  Set to 54mm scaling for easier printing and because bigger is better! but you can reduce to 60% for 28-32mm scale.

name: Bo Staff Tortle
description:
Tortles are omnivorous, turtle-like humanoids with shells that cover most of their bodies. Tortles have a saying: "We wear our homes on our backs." Consequently, tortles feel little need to stay put for long. An adult tortle stands about 6 feet tall and weighs between 450 and 500 pounds. Males and females are nearly identical in size and appearance.
Tortle for use in any epic adventure!  for use in any epic adventure!

name: Bone Golem - Book of Beasts
description:
Bone Golem from the 'Adventurers Guide - The Book of Beasts' kickstarter campaign. Late pledges still available!
Bone Golem for use in any epic adventure!

name: Braxat
description:
A braxat is a towering, warm-blooded carnivore with a thick, articulated shell covering its back, a squarish head topped with horny protrusions, and thick arms ending in large hands with opposable thumbs. The creature walks upright on two legs and speaks in a voice similar to that of a human.
Braxat for use in any epic adventure!

name: Breaching Chuul
description:
Survivors of the ancient aboleth empire, chuuls are crustaceans the aboleths modified and endowed with sentience. They follow the ingrained directives of their creators, as they have done since the dawn of time.
Chuul for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Bugbear
description: Tabletop miniature. Scale: 28mm and 54mm.

name: Bulette
description:
Land Shark's are extremely dangerous. With bodies covered in thick, layered plates they burrow unseen beneath the soil before erupting up at an unexpected moment to seize their prey. For this reason they are also known as 'Land Sharks'.
Land Shark for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Bulezau
description:
Bulezaus embody the violence of nature, their emaciated builds hid a terrifying strength making them able to weild weapons much too large for their size. Covered in filth, their flesh stunk of carrion and was dotted with boils and open wounds.
Bulezau for use in any epic adventure!

name: Bullywug
description:
Life as a bullywug is nasty, brutish, and wet. These frog-headed amphibious humanoids must stay constantly moist, dwelling in rainy forests, marshes, and damp caves.
Bullywug for use in any epic adventure!

name: Bursting Ankheg
description:
Formicid are huge insectoid monsters. They are ambush predators that hunt thier prey from below the ground
Formicid for use in any epic adventure!  for use in any epic adventure!

description:
Bursting Land Shark from the 'Adventurers Guide - The Book of Beasts' kickstarter campaign. Late pledges still available!
Bursting Land Shark for use in any epic adventure!

name: Cargo Steeder (Male)
description:
Giant hunting spiders, steeders prowl the depths of the Underdark. Female steeders grow larger and stronger than males, and the female often devours the male after breeding. Numerous Underdark folk domesticate steeders, particularly duergar. Typically the females serve as steeds in battle, while the males are used as draft animals.
Male Steeder for use in any epic adventure!

name: Cast of Crabfolk
description:
The crab folk are the result of a magical ritual used long ago by a mighty green hag to transform her ogre minions into more useful servants. All crab folk that now exist are descended from those original creations, with most living in small, isolated clutches.
Crabfolk for use in any epic adventure!

name: Chain Devil
description:
Sadistic and cruel, chain devils gained great pleasure from inflicting pain. Their chains served as both clothing and weaponry, allowing them to brutally lash victims and enemies alike.
Chain Devil for use in any epic adventure!

name: Charging Chuul
description:
Survivors of the ancient aboleth empire, chuuls are crustaceans the aboleths modified and endowed with sentience. They follow the ingrained directives of their creators, as they have done since the dawn of time.
Chuul for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Charging Dire Wolf
description:
Wolves were canine pack hunters that were excellent trackers by scent. They were shrewd hunters and worked as a team, surrounding and tripping their prey. They were very common as companions for rangers and druids.
This immensely large wolf seems as big as a horse, with fiery eyes and a thick coat of fur.
Dire Wolf for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Charging Gargoyle
description:
Gargoyles are sculptures inhabited by elemental spirits. Wings and magic allow their heavy stone bodies to fly, and they often perch where they can blend in amid ornate architecture, rock formations, or mundane statues. Gargoyles usually serve the magic-users who conjured them into their bodies, but if left to their own devices, they might play cruel pranks and steal treasures to hoard in lofty lairs.
Gargoyle for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Charging Girallon
description:
A girallon looks like an oversized, four-armed ape. Its vicious fangs and claws reveal it to be a monstrous predator..
Girallon for use in any epic adventure!

name: Charging Gorgon
description:
Few creatures that encounter a gorgon live to tell about it. Its body is covered in iron plates, and its nostrils fume with green vapor.
Gorgon for use in any epic adventure!  for use in any epic adventure!

name: Charging Minotaur - Book of Beasts
description:
Charging Minotaur from the 'Adventurers Guide - The Book of Beasts' kickstarter campaign. Late pledges still available!
Charging Minotaur for use in any epic adventure!

name: Charging Twig Blight
description:
Twig blight can root in soil, which they do when living prey are scarce. While rooted, they resemble woody shrubs. When it pulls its roots free of the ground to move, a twig blight's branches twist together to form a humanoid-looking body with a head and limbs.
Twig blight for use in any epic adventure!

name: Chimera
description:
Chimeras were created after mortals summoned Demogorgon to the world. The Prince of Demons, unimpressed with the creatures that surrounded it, transformed them into horrific, multi-headed monstrosities.
Chimera for use in any epic adventure!

name: Chwinga
description:
A chwinga is a tiny elemental spirit that lives in plants, rocks, and rivers far from civilization. Those found in cold climates also live in ice and snow. Painfully shy, chwingas prefer to move about unseen.
Chwinga for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Clawed Goblin - Book of Beasts
description:
Clawed Goblin from the 'Adventurers Guide - The Book of Beasts' kickstarter campaign. Late pledges still available!
Clawed Goblin for use in any epic adventure!

name: Cloaked Oni
description:
Oni look like demonic ogres with blue or green skin, dark hair, and a pair of short ivory horns protruding from their foreheads. Their eyes are dark with strikingly white pupils, and their teeth and claws are jet black.
Oni for use in any epic adventure!

name: Cloaker
description:
Cloakers earned their names for the resemblance they bear to dark leathery cloaks. Lurking in remote dungeons and caves, these stealthy predators wait to slay lone or injured prey stumbling through the darkness.
Cloaker for use in any epic adventure!

name: Cloud Giant
description:
Cloud giants often displayed handsome and well-defined features with skin ranging from milky white to light sky blue. Often dressed in clothing made of the finest material and jewelry, they preferred to wear or carry things enchanted with protective magic.
Cloud giant for use in any epic adventure!

name: Cockatrice
description:
The cockatrice looks like a hideous hybrid of lizard, bird, and bat, and it’s infamous for its ability to turn flesh to stone. A cockatrice flies into the face of any threat, squawking and madly beating its wings as its head darts out to peck. The smallest scratch from a cockatrice's beak can spell doom as its victim slowly turns to stone from the injury.
Cockatrice for use in any epic adventure!

name: Corpse Flower
description:
The Corpse Flower can grow to an enormous size over several weeks, sprouted atop the grave of an evil necromancer or the remains of a powerful undead. Once it grows large enough it tears itself free of the ground and begins scavenging corpses from battlefields and graveyards, stuffing the remains into its body.
Corpse Flower for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Coyote Necromancer
description:
A necromancer was a specialist wizard whose spells manipulate the power of death, unlife, and the life force.
Coyote Necromancer for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Crag Cat
description:
The creature referred to in Northlander lore as the Hunter of Men is a sure-footed predator that can be found anywhere except deep forest, preferring ledges and cliffs in the mountains.
Crag Cat for use in any epic adventure!

name: Crawling Claw - Elden
description:
Elden crawling claws are a grotesque mutation of their smaller kin but now resembling a giant, disembodied hand or a cluster of fingers. They are extremely hostile and known to use its many fingers to move surprisingly quickly, often grabbing and crushing its unsuspecting targets.
Elden Crawling Claw for use in any epic dungeon adventure!
* Small crawling claw variants are shown for scale reference only. They are not included.

name: Crawling Dire Bat
description:
Dire bats, also known as giant bats, were large beasts the size of horses. Dire bats averaged 200 pounds and had a wingspan that stretched15 feet. Hunting at night and resting during the day, Dire bats were easily startled and quick to attack any other creatures it encountered.
Dire bat for use in any epic adventure!

name: Crawling Ghoul
description:
Ghouls roam the night in packs, driven by an insatiable hunger for humanoid flesh.
Crawling Ghoul for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Creeping Ettercap
description:
Ettercaps are humanoid spiders that tend, feed, and watch over spiders the way a shepherd oversees a flock of sheep.
Creeping Ettercap for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Creeping Nothic
description:
Nothics were wizards cursed for delving too deep into arcane knowledge. Once transformed, the nothic held no discernible memory of its former self, except for a faint notion that there might be a way to reverse its condition.
Nothic use in any epic adventure!

description:
Bandits rove in gangs and are sometimes led by thugs, veterans, or spellcasters. Not all bandits are evil. Oppression, drought, disease, or famine can often drive otherwise honest folk to a life of banditry.
Sneaking Bandit for use in any epic adventure!

description:
Mind flayers are tyrants and slavers. They are aggressive and attempt to mentally dominate any non-slave, non-illithid that they meet, twisting the potential of other creatures to further their evil and far-reaching goals

name: Cultists
description:
Cultists swear allegiance to dark powers such as elemental princes, demon lords, or archdevils. Most conceal their loyalties to avoid being ostracized, imprisoned, or executed for their beliefs. Unlike evil acolytes, cultists often show signs of insanity in their beliefs and practices.
Group of Cultists for use in any epic adventure!

name: Cyclops - Greatclub
description:
Cyclopes are one-eyed giants that eke out a meager existence in wild lands. They are a terrifying threat in combat due to their size and strength, but they can often be tricked by clever foes.

name: Death Tyrant
description:
On rare occasions, a beholder's sleeping mind drifts to places beyond its normal madness, imagining a reality in which it exists beyond death. When such dreams take hold, a beholder can transform, its flesh sloughing away to leave a death tyrant behind. This monster possesses the cunning and much of the magic it had in life, but it is fueled by the power of undeath. A death tyrant appears as a massive, naked skull, with a pinpoint of red light gleaming in its hollow eye socket. With its eyestalks rotted away, ten spectral eyes hover above the creature and glare in all directions.
Death Tyrant for use in any epic adventure!

description:
Devas appeared as human-like men and wome of extraordinary beauty with two magnificent feathered wings emerging from their shoulders. Devas were averse to clothing; when they must adhere to mortal custom, they wore simple loincloths or other coverings.
Deva for use in any epic adventure!

name: Dingo-folk Hunter
description:
Dingo-folk are renowned for their exceptional tracking skills, their acute sense of smell enables them to follow any target from hundreds of feet away.
Dingo-folk for use in any epic adventure!

description:
Displacer Beasts are large cat-like creatures with six legs and a pair of long tentacles sprouting from their shoulders. Used their innate magic, they can bend light making them appear to be a foot or two from their actual positions.
Displacer Beast for use in any epic adventure!

Flameskulls for use in any epic adventure!

name: Diving Grell
description:
A grell resembles a bulbous floating brain with a wide, sharp beak. Its ten long tentacles are made of hundreds of ring-shaped muscles sheathed in tough fibrous hide.
Grell for use in any epic adventure!

name: Doppelganger
description:
Doppelgangers are devious shapeshifters that take on the appearance of other humanoids, throwing off pursuit or luring victims to their doom with misdirection and disguise.
Doppelganger for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Draegloth
description:
Draegloths were a unholy creation of the drow in the name of their goddess Lolth. These four armed brutes prefered hand to hand combat, revelling the the carnage they could cause.
Draegloth for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Drider
description:
Driders were once drow, transformed in an agonizing process for failing a test of Lolth. From their waist up they retained their drow form but from the waist down they had the form of immense spiders.
Drider for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Druid - Human Female - Lvl 1
description:
Druids dwell in forests and other secluded wilderness locations, where they protect the natural world from monsters and the encroachment of civilization. Some are tribal shamans who heal the sick, pray to animal spirits, and provide spiritual guidance.
Druid for use in any epic adventure!

name: Duergar
description:
The tyrannical duergar, also known as gray dwarves, dwell in fantastic cities deep in the Underdark. Using ancient dwarven knowledge and myriad slaves, they work tirelessly to expand their subterranean kingdoms.
Duergar for use in any epic adventure!

name: Earth Elemental
description:
Elementals are incarnations of the elements that make up the universe: air, earth, fire, and water. Though little more than animated energy on their own planes of existence, they can be called on by spellcasters and powerful beings to take shape and perform tasks.
Earth Elementals for use in any epic adventure!

name: Echidna-folk Druid
description:
While their bellies, hands, feet, and face are soft and furry, the backs of Echidna-folk are covered in long spines that can detach to cause extreme pain to their foes, giving them an opening for escape.
Echidna-folk for use in any epic adventure!

name: Eclipse of Drow
description:
Tens of thousands of years ago, the elves were divided, with those of benevolent disposition battling those that were selfish and cruel. The war among elvenkind ended when the good elves banished their malevolent kin to the subterranean depths. Here they found leadership in the only elven deity who had not forsaken them. At her command, the dark elves built an empire in the underworld.
Drow for use in any epic adventure!

name: Elder Oblex
description:
An Oblex was an incredibly intelligent ooze created by Mind Flayers. They are able to absorb the memories of their victims and in doing so they could replicate identical copies of them.
Oblex for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Elder Tressym
description:
A tressym was a magical beast resembling a small winged cat. They were also popular as familiars for good wizards.
Elder Tressym for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Ettin
description:
An ettin is a foul, two-headed giant with the crude characteristics of an orc. It never bathes if it can help it, and its thick skin is usually encrusted with a thick layer of dirt and grime beneath the stinking hides it wears. Its long stringy hair hangs in an unkempt mess about its faces, and its breath reeks from mouths filled with crooked teeth and tusks.
Ettin for use in any epic adventure!

name: Evil Mage
description:
Evil mages hunger for arcane power and dwell in isolated places, where they can perform terrible magical experiments without interference.
Evil Mage for use in any epic adventure!

name: Exposed Mimic - Book of Beasts
description:
Exposed Mimic from the 'Adventurers Guide - The Book of Beasts' kickstarter campaign. Late pledges still available!

name: False Hydra
description:
Common wisdom holds that false hydras come from the ground. They spontaneously originate as undifferentiated masses of flesh. Potatoes that sprout from no seed. Supposedly, they germinate in response to lies, and that each falsehood causes a false hydra to swell larger.
False Hydra for use in any epic adventure!

name: Feeding Banderhobb
description:
A banderhobb is a hybrid of shadow and flesh. Through dark magic, these components take on an enormous and vile humanoid shape, resembling a bipedal toad. In this form, a banderhobb temporarily serves its creator as a thug, a thief, and a kidnapper.
Banderhobb for use in any epic adventure!

name: Fortune Teller
description:
Driven by a need to know what lies beyond the mysteries of death, the world, and the mists, Vadoma finds spirits are instinctively drawn to her. Despite being terribly superstitous, she does all she can to help them find peace.
Fortune Teller for use in any epic adventure!

name: Four-Armed Gargoyle
description:
Gargoyles are sculptures inhabited by elemental spirits. Wings and magic allow their heavy stone bodies to fly, and they often perch where they can blend in amid ornate architecture, rock formations, or mundane statues. Gargoyles usually serve the magic-users who conjured them into their bodies, but if left to their own devices, they might play cruel pranks and steal treasures to hoard in lofty lairs.
Gargoyle for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Frost Salamander
description:
Frost salamanders are natives of the Plane of Ice, also called the Frostfell, which rests between the Plane of Air and the Plane of Water. Frost salamanders especially like to hunt warm-blooded creatures. They sometimes travel to frigid climes on the Material Plane by wandering through planar gates.
Frost Salamander for use in any epic adventure!

name: Gelatinous Cube
description:
Quivering masses of acidic goo, gelatinous cubes wobble through narrow caverns and dungeons, engulfing anything in their paths. These Oozes are naturally transparent, making them difficult to see while they're stationary. Creatures and objects that become stuck within these slimes are gradually dissolved.
Undigested detritus sometimes floats within a gelatinous cube, hinting at its past meals.
Gelatinous Cube for use in any epic adventure!
Hollowed with a removable insert!

name: Giant Boar
description: Tabletop miniature. Scale: 32mm and 54mm.

name: Giant Goat
description:
Giant goats were a rare, larger than normal species of goat growing to 5ft tall at the shoulder. They mimicked their smaller kin by charging and ramming with their long sharp horns.
Giant goat for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Giant Spider
description:
To snare its prey, a giant spider spins elaborate webs or shoots sticky strands of webbing from its abdomen. Giant spiders are most commonly found underground, making their lairs on ceilings or in dark, web-filled crevices. Such lairs are often festooned with web cocoons holding past victims.
Giant Spider for use in any epic adventure!

name: Gibbering Mouther
description:
This creature is the composite eyes, mouths, and liquefied matter of its former victims. Driven to insanity by the destruction of their bodies and absorption into the mouther, those victims gibber incoherent madness, forced to consume everything in reach.
Gibbering Mouther for use in any epic adventure!

name: Gill-Man
description:
The Gill-man is fully amphibious, capable of breathing both in and out of the water. It also possesses superhuman strength and the Gill-man's scaly skin is extremely tough, which combined with a fast acting healing factor, allows it to survive wounds which would be fatal to humans, such as gunshots and full immolation.
Gill-man use in any epic adventure!

name: Girallon
description:
A girallon looks like an oversized, four-armed ape. Its vicious fangs and claws reveal it to be a monstrous predator..
Girallon for use in any epic adventure!

name: Glabrezu
description:
Glabrezu reveled in destroying mortals, although not with their sheer might but instead with temptation. Tricking them into making evil deals with the lure of wealth and power.
Glabrezu for use in any epic adventure!

name: Gluttony Demon
description:
The Gaping Maw, the hungering mass, Gluttony is the embodiment of the sinful Hunger. It is the personification of mortals desire to consume, the endless hunger to fill one's emptiness.
Gluttony for use in any epic adventure!

name: Gnoll
description:
Gnoll's were carnivorous beasts known for their savage culture. Resembling a human-hyena hybrid, they stood 7 foot tall with lean musculature
Gnoll for use in any epic adventure!

name: Goblin
description:
Goblins are small, black-hearted humanoids that lair in despoiled dungeons and other dismal settings. Individually weak, they gather in large numbers to torment other creatures.
Goblin beast for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Goblinoid Crew
description:
Crew of 3 Goblinoids at a discount!
Goblin, Hobgoblin and Bugbear for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Goose Hydra
description:
The goose hydra is exactly what it sounds like. It is normally a simple-looking, one headed goose. They are dangerous in that their docile appearance deceives without effort, and by the time their enemy realizes, they will have triggered its innumerable wrath. It knows no fear, and its challenger will soon realize their own grave mistake when the heads become two, three, four...
Goose Hydra for use in any epic adventure!

name: Grave Titan
description:
Grave Titans are walking monoliths of he undead. Lumbering forward on its master’s command, the Grave Titan leaves a trail of death and lurching zombies. A true success in the minds of necromancers, sowing death as it walks.
Grave Titan for use in any epic adventure!
This thing truly is a titan, to give you a sense of scale those are the same zombies that are available in the collection - at normal human size. It stands just under 150mm tall in 32mm tabletop scale.

name: Graveyard Scatter - Tabletop Props (Pre-Supported)
description: Graveyard scatter for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Great Wight Shark (Undead)
description: Tabletop miniature. Scale: 32mm and 54mm.

name: Green Hag
description:
The wretched and hateful green hags dwell in dying forests, lonely swamps, and misty moors, making their homes in caves. Green hags love to manipulate other creatures into doing their bidding, masking their intentions behind layers of deception.
Green Hag for use in any epic adventure!

name: Grell
description:
A grell resembles a bulbous floating brain with a wide, sharp beak. Its ten long tentacles are made of hundreds of ring-shaped muscles sheathed in tough fibrous hide.
Grell for use in any epic adventure!

name: Grick
description:
Always hungry, Gricks hunt anything that moves. Ambushing their prey with a snapping beak and large barbed tentacles.
Grick beast for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Grick Alpha
description:
Always hungry, Gricks hunt anything that moves. Ambushing their prey with a snapping beak and large barbed tentacles.
Grick Alpha for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Griffin
description:
Griffins are intelligent avian beasts with the bodies of lions and the head, forelegs, and wings of eagles. An adult griffon is about 8 ft (2.4 meters) long, with a wingspan of 25 ft (7.6meters). The average griffon weighs around 500lb (226kg).
Griffin for use in any epic adventure!

name: Grinch - Max
description:
The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbours in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realises there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.
The Grinch for use in any epic adventure!

name: Grinkle the Goblin King
description:
Grinkle the Goblin “King”, contrary to his selfappointed title, is detested by his own kind. The would-be ruler is in fact little more than a kleptomaniac and a thug, hoarding wealth jealously and never sharing it with others.
Grinkle for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Grinkle the Goblin King - Bust
description: Created specifically for all the painters out there, Grinkle the Goblin “King” in bust form.

name: Grinkle the Goblin King - Bust (Pre-Supported)
description: Created specifically for all the painters out there, Grinkle the Goblin “King” in Pre-Supported bust form.

name: Growling Hellhound
description:
Fire-breathing fiends that take the form of powerful dogs, hell hounds are most commonly seen in service to devils, fire giants, and other evil creatures that use them as guard animals and companions.
Hellhound for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Guard Drake
description:
Drakes are smaller and not as powerful as dragons but were much easier to train. They were often used as guards by dragons or they were commonly used as mounts.
Drake for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Gundren Rockseeker
description:
One of three dwarf brothers who hail from the Rockseeker Clan of Sorrolk. They are known in Andaria for their various business ventures.
Gundren Rockseeker for use in any epic adventure!

name: Harpy
description:
Harpies are a twisted mix of a vulture and a humanoid female. With jet black eyes and powerful wings it uses it's sweet song to lure countless adventurers and carry them away to their deaths.
Harpy for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Hellhound
description: Fire-breathing fiends that take the form of powerful dogs, hell hounds are most commonly seen in service to devils, fire giants, and other evil creatures that use them as guard animals and companions. for use in any epic adventure!

name: Hezrou
description:
Hezrou are large demons, standing 8ft tall and weighing around 750lb. Often used as powerful soldiers in the hordes of the Abyss, they force their way behind enemy lines reaking with a foul and overpowering stench sickening even the toughest of opponents.
Hezrou for use in any epic adventure!

name: Hobgoblin
description:
Hobgoblins are a bigger, stronger and smarter goblinoid. They are vindictive creatures who take pleasure in causing pain and are considered evil like the rest of their kin.
Hobgoblin for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Hollyphant
description:
Hollyphants are gentle, stalwart creatures native to the Upper Planes. Good-aligned deities and angels use them as messengers and helpers. Hollyphants treasure friendship and honesty.
Hollyphant for use in any epic adventure!

name: Hook Horror
description:
A fierce predator of the Underdark, the hook horror aggressively defends its hunting grounds. The subterranean caverns where these creatures dwell echo with the constant clacking and scraping of their hooks as they wend their way up cliffs and along cavern walls.
Hook Horror for use in any epic adventure!

A selection of Horses/Unicorns for use in any epic adventure!  for use in any epic adventure!

name: Hunched Needle Blight
description:
Needle blights have vaguely bipedal forms, with gaunt, misshapen limbs. While they looked enough like a hunched humanoid to be mistaken for one in the shadows of a forest, when standing unnaturally still or lurching with their awkward gaits, these blights can't pass as either normal plants or woodland travelers.
Needle Blight for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Hungry Ghoul
description:
Ghouls roam the night in packs, driven by an insatiable hunger for humanoid flesh.
Hungry Ghoul for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Ice Golem
description:
Ice golems were huge creatures carved out of glaciers or icebergs.
Ice golem for use in any epic adventure!

name: Imp
description:
Imps are found throughout the Lower Planes, either running errands for their infernal masters, spying on rivals, or misleading and waylaying mortals. An imp will proudly serve an evil master of any kind, but it can't be relied on to carry out tasks with any speed or efficiency.
Imp for use in any epic adventure!

name: Intellect Devourer
description:
An intellect devourer resembles a walking brain protected by a crusty covering and set on bestial clawed legs. This foul aberration feeds on the intelligence of sentient creatures, taking over a victim's body on behalf of its mind flayer masters.
Intellect Devourer for use in any epic adventure!

name: Intellect Devourers
description:
An intellect devourer resembles a walking brain protected by a crusty covering and set on bestial clawed legs. This foul aberration feeds on the intelligence of sentient creatures, taking over a victim's body on behalf of its mind flayer masters.
Intellect Devourer for use in any epic adventure!

name: Intent Nothic
description:
Nothics were wizards cursed for delving too deep into arcane knowledge. Once transformed, the nothic held no discernible memory of its former self, except for a faint notion that there might be a way to reverse its condition.
Nothic use in any epic adventure!

name: Ixitxachitl Swarm
description:
Many creatures mistake ixitxachitl for common manta rays, but this can prove a deadly mistake. The ixitxachitl are as evil as they are cunning, leading to their common nickname "demon rays." They inhabit bodies of fresh and salt water, but their violent nature means that little is known of them.
Ixitxachitl for use in any epic adventure!

name: Kenku Barbarian
description:
Kenku are feathered humanoids that wander the world as vagabonds, driven by greed. They can perfectly imitate any sound they hear.
Kenku Barbarian for use in any epic adventure!  for use in any epic adventure!

name: Kindness of Wereravens
description:
Wereravens are secretive and extraordinarily cautious lycanthropes that trust one another but are wary of just about everyone else. Although skilled at blending into society, they keep mostly to themselves, respect local laws, and strive to do good whenever possible.
Wereraven for use in any epic adventure!

name: Knot of Duergar
description:
The tyrannical duergar, also known as gray dwarves, dwell in fantastic cities deep in the Underdark. Using ancient dwarven knowledge and myriad slaves, they work tirelessly to expand their subterranean kingdoms.
Duergar for use in any epic adventure!

name: Koala-folk Ranger
description:
Koala-folk are small humanoid koalas living in the trees of thick forested areas. They are stealth hunters who move through the leaves with barely a detectable noise, this unique hunting style allows them to ambush targets from the leafy tree canopy above.
Koala-folk for use in any epic adventure!

name: Kobold Archer
description:
Kobolds are craven reptilian humanoids that worship evil dragons as demigods and serve them as minions and toadies. Kobolds inhabit dragons' lairs when they can but more commonly infest dungeons, gathering treasures and trinkets to add to their own tiny hoards.
Kobold Archer for use in any epic adventure!

name: Kraken
description:
Beneath the waves, the kraken sleeps for untold ages, awaiting some fell sign or calling. Land-born mortals who sail the open sea forget the reasons their ancestors dreaded the ocean, even as the races of the deep ignore strange gaps in their histories when their civilizations nearly vanished after the appearance of the tentacled horror.
Huge Kraken for use in any epic adventure!

name: Krampus
description:
Krampus is the devilish companion of St. Nicholas, a half-goat, half-demon monster that punishes misbehaving children at Christmastime.
Krampus for use in any epic adventure!

name: Kuo-toa - Archpriest
description:
Kuo-toa are degenerate fishlike humanoids that once inhabited the shores and islands of the surface world. Long ago humans and their ilk drove the kuo-toa underground, where they dwell in madness and everlasting night.
Kuo-toa for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Lamia
description:
Lamia were cruel and seductive beings who lured their victims closer to doom with illusions of beauty. Most appeared to be beautiful women from the waist up but had the bodies of powerful lions from the waist down.
Lamia for use in any epic adventure!

name: Lantern Wraith - Book of Beasts
description:
Lantern Wraith from the 'Adventurers Guide - The Book of Beasts' kickstarter campaign. Late pledges still available!
Lantern Wraith for use in any epic adventure!

description:

name: Laying Mummy
description:
Raised by dark funerary rituals, a mummy shambles from the shrouded stillness of a time-lost temple or tomb. Having been awoken from its rest, it punishes transgressors with the power of its unholy curse.
Mummy for use in any epic adventure!

name: Leaping Hellhound
description:
Fire-breathing fiends that take the form of powerful dogs, hell hounds are most commonly seen in service to devils, fire giants, and other evil creatures that use them as guard animals and companions.
Hellhound for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Leaping Orc
description:
Orcs are savage raiders and pillagers with stooped postures, low foreheads, and piggish faces with prominent lower canines that resemble tusks.
Orc for use in any epic adventure!

name: Leucrotta
description:
A leucrotta is what you would get if you took the head of a giant badger, the legs of a deer, and the body of a large hyena, then put them together and reanimated them with demon ichor without bothering to cover up the stink of death.
Leucrotta for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Leucrotta Pair
description:

Leucrotta for use in any epic adventure!

name: Lich
description:
Liches are undead spellcasters of great power, feared by mortals for their magic, intelligence, and their willingness to embrace undeath for a chance to live forever.
Lich for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Litter of Tabaxi
description:
Tabaxi are catfolk who hail from the land of Maztica. The ultimate wanderers, Tabaxi rarely stay in one place for long. They love to collect interesting artifacts, gather tales, and lay eyes on all the world's wonders. This curiosity pushes them to leave no secrets uncovered, and no treasures or legends lost. They revere a fickle deity called the Cat Lord, who is said to wander the world.
Tabaxi for use in any epic adventure!

name: Lizardfolk
description:
Lizardfolk are powerfully built reptilian humanoids. Fiercely territorial and savage, they can be highly dangerous when provoked.
Lizardfolk for use in any epic adventure!  Set to 54mm scaling for easier printing and because bigger is better! but you can reduce to 60% for 28-32mm scale

name: Lizardfolk War Chief - Book of Beasts KS Sample
description:
Get notified of the launch!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yasashiikyojinstudio/adventurers-guide-the-book-of-beasts
Enjoy this sample Lizardfolk War Chief from my upcoming Kickstarter 'Adventurer's Guide - The Book of Beasts'
This campaign was designed to give you warbands of creatures in the same style, at the same level of quality, with consistent sizing and enough variety to cover a wide range of uses. Many are low CR or horde type creatures that are perfect for starting adventurer's to encounter.
Wherever possible I included a close, medium and far ranged option while designing each warband and many of these even have their own War Chief, a bigger, meaner, mini boss variant for those extra special encounters!

Lizardfolk with shield for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Lobbing Umber Hulk
description:
Umber Hulks are monstrosities. Extremely bulky creatures, highly muscular with their bulk covered in chitinous armored plates.
Umber Hulk for use in any epic adventure!

name: Loxodon Barbarian
description:
The humanoid elephants called loxodons are often oases of calm in the busy streets of Ravnica. They hum or chant in sonorous tones and move slowly or sit in perfect stillness. If provoked to action, loxodons are true terrors, bellowing with rage, trumpeting and flapping their ears. Their serene wisdom, fierce loyalty, and unwavering conviction are tremendous assets to their guilds.
Loxodon for use in any epic adventure!  for use in any epic adventure!

name: Lumbering Vine Blight
description:
Alone among the blights, vine blights could speak, and their connection to the spirit of the Gulthias tree that spawned them meant that they spoke in a broken version of the spirit's voice. They were known to taunt victims and bargain with more powerful foes.
Vine Blight for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

description:

Lunging Mimic for use in any epic adventure!

name: Lunging Quaggoth
description:
For quaggoths, every fight means life or death. They battle with wild fury and do anything to survive.
Quaggoth for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Lurking Troglodyte
description:
Troglodytes are barbaric reptilian humanoids, coated with rough leathery scales.
Lurking Troglodyte for use in any epic adventure!  for use in any epic adventure!

name: Magmin
description:
A grinning, mischievous magmin resembles a stumpy humanoid sculpted from a black shell of magma. Even when it isn't ablaze and radiating heat like a bonfire, small jets of flame erupt from its porous skin.
Magmin for use in any epic adventure!

name: Maks the Giant Rat
description:
Grinkle wouldn’t be much of a thief without his one loyal servant, Maks. Despite being a giant rat, Maks is remarkably crafty and able to squeeze and sneak into places Grinkle simply can’t.
Maks the Giant Rat for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Manananggal
description:
Horrid undead, manananggals walk among the living by day and prey upon them at night. These creatures delight in spreading fear and distrust. Manananggals pass themselves off as normal people, usually posing as mad old women, midwives, hedge witches, or mystics. This allows the undead creatures to select their prey from within the community. Once separated, a manananggal’s mobile torso has a 6-foot wingspan.
Manananggal for use in any epic adventure!

name: Mantaur
description:
Half man, half another man... Mantaurs are the rare offspring of two half-human creatures. Sometimes the child will be all human, sometimes neither but in certain circumstances the human side will multiply and become a Mantaur.
Mantaur for use in any epic adventure!

name: Manticore
description:
Manticores were giant beasts with the bodies of a lion, the wings of a dragon, a humaniod head and tails covered in spikes. Intelligent and extremely deadly, Manticores were true monsters.
Manticore for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Manticore B
description:
Manticores were giant beasts with the bodies of a lion, the wings of a dragon, a humaniod head and tails covered in spikes. Intelligent and extremely deadly, Manticores were true monsters.
Manticore for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Marilith
description:
Terrible to behold, a Marilith has the lower body of a great serpent and the upper torso of a humanoid female with six arms. Wielding a weapon in each of its six hands, a marilith is a devastating foe that few can match in battle.
Marilith for use in any epic adventure!

name: Marut - Active
description:
The nigh-unstoppable inevitables serve a singular purpose: they enforce contracts forged in the Hall of Concordance in the city of Sigil. Primus, the leader of the modrons, created maruts and other inevitables to bring order to dealings between planar folk.
Marut for use in any epic adventure!

name: Meditating Oni
description:

Consequently, tortles feel little need to stay put for long. An adult tortle stands about 6 feet tall and weighs between 450 and 500 pounds. Males and females are nearly identical in size and appearance.

description:
Gargoyles are sculptures inhabited by elemental spirits. Wings and magic allow their heavy stone bodies to fly, and they often perch where they can blend in amid ornate architecture, rock formations, or mundane statues. Gargoyles usually serve the magic-users who conjured them into their bodies, but if left to their own devices, they might play cruel pranks and steal treasures to hoard in lofty lairs.

name: Platy-folk Bard
description:
Platy-folk are some of the strangest creatures to behold in any land. They have thick brown fur, a round head with the bill of a duck, and the tail of a beaver. Their hands and feet are bare, webbed, rubbery, and black. They have retractable barbs protruding from the elbows.
Platy-folk for use in any epic adventure!

name: Pointing Witherling
description:
By invoking rituals to Yeenoghu, they bring the remains of their slain comrades back to a semblance of life in the form of a gnoll witherling.

name: Praying Cultist
description:
Cultists swear allegiance to dark powers such as elemental princes, demon lords, or archdevils. Most conceal their loyalties to avoid being ostracized, imprisoned, or executed for their beliefs. Unlike evil acolytes, cultists often show signs of insanity in their beliefs and practices.
Praying Cultist for use in any epic adventure!

name: Pumpkin Tyrant
description:
A Tyrant that has fully given itself to the Halloween spirit, infecting and twisting the land into corrupted forms. It appears as a pumpkin of impossible size, floating on a tangle of vines.

name: Qalupalik
description:
The legend of the Qalupalik comes from the Inuit people and their icy, arctic waters. Unlike many other mythical mermaids, there is nothing attractive about the Qualupalik. They are described as aquatic fish-like humanoids, with webbed, clawed hands made for the hunt.

name: Rakshasa
description:
The Rakshasa employs delicacy and misdirection in its pursuit of dominion over others. Few creatures ever see the fiend in its true form, for it can take on any guise it wants, although it prefers to masquerade as someone powerful or influential: a noble, cardinal, or rich merchant, for example. A rakshasa's true form combines the features of a human and a tiger, with one noteworthy deformity: its palms are where the backs of the hands would be on a human.

name: Wombat-folk Miner
description:
Wombat-folk are humanoid wombats, known for thier excellent tunnel digging capability. Their bodies appeared powerful, and they were covered in short coarse fur.
Wombat-folk for use in any epic adventure!

name: Worg Pair
description:
A worg is an evil predator that delights in hunting and devouring creatures weaker than itself. Cunning and malevolent, worgs roam across the remote wilderness or are raised by goblins and hobgoblins.
Worg for use in any epic adventure!

name: Worshipping Cultist
description:
Cultists swear allegiance to dark powers such as elemental princes, demon lords, or archdevils. Most conceal their loyalties to avoid being ostracized, imprisoned, or executed for their beliefs. Unlike evil acolytes, cultists often show signs of insanity in their beliefs and practices.
Worshipping Cultist for use in any epic adventure!

name: Wraith
description:
An undead creature born of evil, appearing as a sinister spectral figure robed in darkness. Despising light and all living things Wraiths can drain the life from living creatures, turning them into new wraiths upon their death.
Undead Wraith for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Wraith Swordsmen - Book of Beasts
description:
Wraith Swordsmen from the 'Adventurers Guide - The Book of Beasts' kickstarter campaign. Late pledges still available!
Wraith Swordsmen for use in any epic adventure!

name: Wraiths - Book of Beasts
description:
Wraith Bundle from the 'Adventurers Guide - The Book of Beasts' kickstarter campaign. Late pledges still available!
This pack includes 3 unique wraith designs, including a reaper mini boss and defeated variant.
Fully Pre-supported (for resin printing) in 32mm and 54mm scaling options, with chitu files provided!

name: Wrath of the Lich Bundle
description:
Wrath of the Lich Bundle for use in any epic dungeon adventure!
Bundle Includes:
1 Lich1 Wraith2 Zombies4 Skeletons7 Tombstones (scatter)5 Skulls (scatter)1 Candle Group (scatter)1 Lantern (scatter)1 Heart (scatter)1 Severed Hand (scatter)

name: Xorn
description:
Bizarre creatures native to the Elemental Plane of Earth, xorn sniff out gemstones and precious metals, then tunnel through earth and rock to consume those treasures.
Xorn for use in any epic adventure!

name: Yeenoghu
description:
A demon lord worshiped by gnolls, driven only by destruction, the embodiment of killing.
Yeenoghu for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Yeti
description:
These hulking creatures stalk alpine peaks in a ceaseless hunt for food. Their snow-white fur lets them move like ghosts against the frozen landscape. A yeti's icy simian eyes can freeze its prey in place.
Yeti for use in any epic adventure!

name: Yuan-Ti Archer
description:
Monstrous serpents with burly humanoid torsos and arms, abominations form the highest caste of yuan-ti society.
Yuan-Ti Archer for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Yuan-Ti Dual Khopesh
description:
Monstrous serpents with burly humanoid torsos and arms, abominations form the highest caste of yuan-ti society.
Dual Khopesh Yuan-Ti  for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Yuan-Ti Dual Scimitars
description:
Monstrous serpents with burly humanoid torsos and arms, abominations form the highest caste of yuan-ti society.
Yuan-Ti for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Yuan-Ti Halberd
description:
Monstrous serpents with burly humanoid torsos and arms, abominations form the highest caste of yuan-ti society.
Yuan-Ti for use in any epic dungeon adventure!

name: Zombies
description:
Zombie’s are an almost mindless re-animated corpse, able to follow simple commands. They moved with an uneven awkward gait, leaving behind the foul stentch of death and decay.
Zombie’s for use in any epic adventure!

name: Aaron Drafthold – Loremaster of Tharador
description: A mysterious man from the north with an incomprehensible secret to most mortal minds. He knows all that was and seems to understand well what will be, though his foresight isn’t as perfect as his knowledge from time’s creation and before. He is seemingly able to warp the very fabric of Minera’s Breath to his will, able to transpose spells greater and more complex than any other spellcasters alive. Stoic in his behaviour, charisma can come to him at will when required, and when no one else will be a leader he steps up. He does his best to preserve the lives of all, and when that fails he blesses the soul to the afterlife as though he were a devout paladin or cleric rather than a stoic wizard.

name: Aaron Drafthold – The Wandering Mage
description: A mysterious man from the north with an incomprehensible secret to most mortal minds. He knows all that was and seems to understand well what will be, though his foresight isn’t as perfect as his knowledge from time’s creation and before. He is seemingly able to warp the very fabric of Minera’s Breath to his will, able to transpose spells greater and more complex than any other spellcasters alive. Stoic in his behaviour, charisma can come to him at will when required. He is the master of the Bastion, using it as a crucible to test the will of adventurers and heroes, preparing them for what is to come.

pt.name: Aaron Drafthold – O Mago Errante
pt.description: Um homem misterioso vindo do norte, com um segredo incompreensível para a maioria das mentes mortais. Conhece tudo o que foi e parece compreender bem o que há de vir, embora a sua clarividência não seja tão perfeita quanto o seu conhecimento desde a criação do tempo e antes. Parece capaz de moldar o próprio tecido do Sopro de Minera à sua vontade, conseguindo transpor feitiços maiores e mais complexos do que qualquer outro conjurador vivo. Estoico no seu comportamento, o carisma surge nele à vontade quando necessário. É o mestre do Bastion, usando-o como um crisol para testar a vontade de aventureiros e heróis, preparando-os para o que está para vir.

name: Aberrant Hellhounds
description: Creatures from the depths of Nosmarka's Abyss, risen from the underworld by Hendrak and converted to be his subservient dogs.

name: Aboro-Ko – Cleric of Tears
description: A mercenary and a master of the waves. Aboro-Ko is in touch with the swells and calls of the waves and uses it to power himself in rhythm and beat in his fights. The power of the ocean courses through him and wherever he is Minera’s Tears will protect him. So they have protected him from his homeland of East Hydana in Zandorion all the way to the lands of Tharador. Though at his side his sister Inedra-Ki has also kept his mind and heart calm and clear.

pt.name: Aboro-Ko – Clérigo das Lágrimas
pt.description: Um mercenário e mestre das ondas. Aboro-Ko está em sintonia com o marulhar e o chamado das ondas, e usa-o para se potenciar no ritmo e cadência dos seus combates. O poder do oceano corre através dele e, onde quer que esteja, as Lágrimas de Minera protegê-lo-ão. Assim o protegeram desde a sua terra natal, East Hydana, em Zandorion, até às terras de Tharador. Ainda assim, ao seu lado, a sua irmã Inedra-Ki tem mantido a sua mente e o seu coração calmos e claros.

name: Achtum of the Meadow – Ranger of Renmaeth
description: A hill dwarf dedicated to the divine of nature, Renmaeth. Achtum always found himself enamoured by the beauty of the mountain meadows his people crafted in honour of the goddess. His life as a hunter often kept him entwined with her domain, and after a close brush with death, Achtum abandoned the hunt, seeing it as a sign from his matron. Since that day he has dedicated himself to her will, and joined the latest expedition of the Church of the Tharameni into Sudd Tohst’s sunburnt plains.

name: Adana White
description: A ranger lost to a blizzard on her expedition into the wastes. Unfortunately for her was that it was not the cold that took her, rather a shapeshifter morphed to the form of her lost horse. As Adana cradled a fire, praying to any gods that would answer, her horse appeared through the blizzard. As she ran to mount it, the beast opened to a mass of teeth and tentacles, holding her down and slowly and terrifyingly consuming her. Now in her shapeshifted form, the entity cannot mimic her voice, instead acting as though her voice has been taken by illness. At its first chance it will make it to travel beyond Oldavor, to find a village or group it can consume entirely.

name: Aedre The Angry
description: Raised by Goliaths, tempered with snow, strength, anger and steel; Aedre vows revenge upon the Alimrothi that took her family from her with little regard for the plights of any of those that she fights alongside, nor her own safety.

name: Aeus Invictus – Soulforged Inventor
description: A Soulforged from Edrador who has travelled far to seek the wisdom of the High Elves in a bid to save his kin. Though Aeus found the Elves intolerable to his nature, calling him an abomination. So he pondered in Tharador for many years, seizing his opportunity when war arose. Thus he joined the Coalition army: if he could not be given the information he sought freely, he would take it for himself in the fires of a siege.

name: Agatol – Crystalline Serpent
description: Within the Dreamscape of Maethromin, Agatol was given rise in the Plane of Earth. Formed from crystals, stone and dirt, the great beast still bares the appetite of any other beast. When Agatol awoke on the physical plane, it found itself in the Underground of Lo Fuin and Abunos. There it made great trails that connected it to the Queendoms of the Drow. Using the gems on it as a baiting light, it consumed any drawn by it. When the Earth Elemi heard of the beast, they saw their best detain it and hold it in Abunae, lest it continue its rampage.

name: Agent – Scarlett
description: Whatever it takes to get the job done is exactly what Scarlett will do. Driven by a silver-tongue and devil-may-care attitude, Scarlett’s heart of ice and blades of crimson can see even her comrades tossed aside to ensure mission success.

name: Agga Eyes-Like-Eagle – Goliath Barbarian & Ranger
description: A Goliath estranged from her hereditary homeland of Oldavor. Agga is one of few Goliaths to have been born and grown beyond the icy plains of the Goliath homeland, raised by a small tribe of wanderers in Greypeak, Agga found herself alone, barely an adolescent as disease left her an orphan and her tribe in ruin. With her traditional upbringing she learnt to fend and provide for herself easily, living in the hills near the city of Vulfkopt. When townsfolk placed a price on her head, calling her a she-beast, Agga slayed every mercenary or adventurer foolish enough to test her. Only when the WEHL was called in did they realise the She-Beast was simply a towering Goliath woman, communicating with her and eventually convincing her to join their own ranks for her tracking prowess and power with any weapon.

pt.name: Agga Olhos-de-Águia – Bárbara e Patrulheira Goliath
pt.description: Uma Goliath afastada da sua terra natal ancestral, Oldavor. Agga é uma das poucas Goliath a ter nascido e crescido para além das planícies geladas da terra natal dos Goliath; criada por uma pequena tribo de nómadas em Greypeak, Agga viu-se sozinha, mal chegada à adolescência, quando uma doença a deixou órfã e destruiu a sua tribo. Com a sua educação tradicional, aprendeu facilmente a defender-se e a sustentar-se, vivendo nas colinas perto da cidade de Vulfkopt. Quando os habitantes puseram um preço pela sua cabeça, chamando-lhe fera, Agga abateu todos os mercenários ou aventureiros suficientemente tolos para a desafiar. Só quando o WEHL foi chamado é que perceberam que a “Fera” era simplesmente uma imponente mulher Goliath, e acabaram por convencê-la a juntar-se às suas fileiras pela sua perícia em rastreio e poder com qualquer arma.

name: Ahmarai Waqalas – Time Wizard
description: Betwixt in time, Ahmarai’s existence is peculiar to even the most seasoned and well-read scholars. Once a scholar of the Anshani Empire hundreds of years prior, Ahmarai is the last known survivor of the ancient Edradori empire, having been in a pocket realm at the time of the populace’s sudden vanishing. When he returned, his body and mind were changed, as if every waking moment he lived through a thousand possibilities at once, each outcome clear to him. His body has been in stasis ever since, forgoing any need for food, water or sleep.

name: Ahznagol – Aberrant Guard
description: The elite of Quorenderi’s guards. These are creatures plated in heavy chitin armour and stand almost as tall as a Colossal with the strength to match. They make up much of the elite forces of his army, both as his own bodyguards and as officers for his forces. On land they are a formidable foe even for the most experienced adventurers, but encountering one in the water is a death sentence.

name: Aimar Batteux – Vampiric Vintner
description: Aimar served as the court sommelier in the city of Strassen for centuries, having been turned and enthralled by Duke Henrik Strauss. Aimar was able to slip the grasp of his master three years ago.

name: Akataka – Flighted Air Ranger
description: A pilgrim Bird-folk traveled far from the Dividing Sea, thousands of miles away. Akataka hails from the colonies there, many of which worship both Wind and Sea as their favoured divine. For many this comes in the form of worshiping Maethromin, the divine of Elements and Lord of Wind and Water. In a wish to learn more, Akataka traveled to the Elemi colonies of Tharador, to speak to the children of Maethromin and learn more of the deity. Volunteering in their churches, he took the charge of watching over Zaus the Chimera, a great sleeping beast. Never did he think it would awake on his watch.

name: Akranak – Colossal Cleric of War
description: A Cleric of Horauthin, his god ancestor. Akranak remembers little of his home before Khandara. His mind now is consumed with the whispers of his God, and a unyielding thirst for blood and war in Horauthin’s honour. With his life before a scrambled, fading memory, Khandara is now his home, but he feels spilling blood in Horauthin’s name has always been his purpose.

name: Aktara Adrientem – Lioness Gladiator
description: A Lionfolk arena fighter who earned her reputation as a master of the bloody fighting pits of Edrador, and then Sudd Tohst. Though her freedom was earned long ago, she chose to stay out her life surrounded by sand and blood, earning her favour with Horauthin. Though she could not be top cat forever, and was slain by another feline contender: Kara’Ta, who fought with grit, but dishonourably. Now Horauthin has chosen Aktara as his favoured fighter in the Crucible.

name: Aldith – Alimrothi Designated Markswoman
description: A sure shot as there ever was, Aldith is one of Alimroth’s finest and a war hero. With over three-hundred confirmed kills, Aldith is trained in guerilla warfare and has done an exceptional job at keeping Alimroth’s enemies at bay in the warring kingdom of Mayreth. Aldith graduated top of her class in the AAA, destined from greatness from the start. It’s said she can shoot the belt off a bee from two miles away while riding in an Airship, a feat all her fans would be clamouring to see.

name: Algaira – Hydra of the Shifting Dunes
description: One of the largest predators to stalk the sands of Sudd Tohst’s deserts. The local Sun Elf tribes revere the Algaira as a warden of the desert, for its enormous presence shifts dunes overnight, turning the terrain into a labyrinth to confuse and disorientate those who might do them harm. Yet, the creature does not discriminate in what it feasts on, and many over-zealous Sun Elves who worship it have met their end as its next meal. It is particularly drawn to the vibration of large groups travelling through the sea of sand, for each mouth will receive its own feed.

name: Alia of Ardris – Adept of Evocation
description: A recent graduate from the University of Ardris in Belfrie. Alia had immigrated to Baldur despite its unfavourable look towards magic.

name: Almenhier Thrasliche – Alpha Vampire
description: The first vampire born from Myrothlir during the Age of Creation. His devotion to the divine of undeath severed and freedom bestowed unto him by Tharador, Almenhier grew to hate his kindred and has since used his own immortality to hunt vampires, and all other manner of Myrothlir’s creations, vowing never to feed upon humans unless in the most dire circumstances or they were men of evil. He now travels with Etherian, one of his first Thralls from the earliest days. The two seek to instill their creed and morals to Almenhier’s descendants across Tharador, destroying those who do not wish to comply.

name: Aloxian – Warrior of the Groves
description: A wanderer druid and warrior that constantly finds themselves patrolling the forests and lands between Brel Vardra, and Brel Endra in Oldavor. Aloxian considers himself a defender of the wilds, though often will step out his way to bring violence to those who at times might not be deserving of its full spate. Regardless he is a friend of both circles, and the druids that inhabit the lands inbetween.

name: Alwine von Findros – Elite Marine Knight
description: One of the elite Marines from the city of Findros. Alwine and her brother Lars have been summoned at the request of their Duke to quell the supposed infestation of a new Dragonblight strain that has taken hold in the kingdom’s south. Having seen the devastation Dragonblight caused exactly two years ago, they will bring upon a righteous, unmerciful fury to the ailment, and pray for the souls of all those who are afflicted.

name: Alysion of the Spotless Wood – Feywalker Duelist
description: A Feywalker raised in the depths of Renmaeth's Dream itself. Alysion is known to be a Planewalker in his own realm.

name: Amaru Taiyo – The Wolf Spirit
description: The Wolf Spirit, the ancestral guardian of Kaoru’s family. Amaru is a powerful spirit who has imbued her champion with unrivalled sword fighting skills and a penchant for tracking and hunting. She now is one of the few guardian spirits left within the Seirei no Samurai that has retained her sanity or dared to show herself among mortals in a time where the balance of Yomi is tipped so far against the benevolent spirits.

name: Amélie Saffron – Maiden Cleric
description: One of the twin daughters of His Excellency High Bishop Madrigal, Speaker of Erdrydion. Amélie’s life has been spent entirely within the church, though in a very different part from her sister. Her eyes wore out from years of study spent upon the books of her forefathers, and Erdrydion’s Grace could not heal them. Thinking this a sign from the great Divine, she took on her affliction with esteem, using it to devise and teach the blind the ways of reading, scripture, prayer and navigating their lives using Erdrydion’s guidance. Now she calls on Erdrydion’s Guidance once more, to aid her in unleashing Idinhelieth’s grasp on her city, and her sister.

name: Anatolius of the Far Sands – Soulforged Wanderer
description: A Soulforged whose memories solely place him in the arid lands of Sudd Tohst. Whatever memories he has in his homeland beyond the sea have long since faded. What remains is a past painted with misery and blood, all spilt by his own hands. Anatolius’ fate is bound to his fervour for coin, and the dark means he will pursue to receive it. Enslavement, bounty hunting and assassination are all part of his repertoire, and have afforded him status as a valuable instrument to the noble class of Hinatal.

name: Andrazia the False Incarnate
description: A supposed Incarnation of Maethromin born from the ashes of war in Abunen Kolden, rising with newfound power after a mortal wound.

name: Andrek Strongarm – Hexhunter Gladiator
description: A hexhunter who was trapped in Draksborne during the time of the Dragonblight. Through grit, luck and his training, he endured, slaying many of the plaguefiends in those months. Yet his path has not ended with the plague, and he remains in the south to aid the kingdom in rebuilding, earning coin at the Crucible to do so.

name: Angela “Cat-Eyes” Hardvin – Rogue Duelist
description: A supposed descendant of the legendary explorer Janius Hardvin, Angela Hardvin has held onto this shred of family legacy as part of her identity since she was a small child, growing up in the slums of Underkeep Downs.

pt.name: Angela “Olhos-de-Gato” Hardvin – Ladina Duelista
pt.description: Uma suposta descendente do lendário explorador Janius Hardvin, Angela Hardvin agarrou-se a este resquício de legado familiar como parte da sua identidade desde criança, tendo crescido nos bairros pobres de Underkeep Downs.

name: Angels of Syelden – Selvaneri Warriors
description: Warriors of the Divine, all once mortals, ascended to status as divine servants after their deaths.

name: Angler Gluglin – Fishfolk Abomination
description: Grunts of the armies of Quorenderi. The Angler Gluglin’s were once fishfolk that lived in the unmapped depths between lands. Quorenderi enslaved their people when he found them, torturing them, twisting them and breeding them to create a new race of hardy creatures that would do his and his officer’s bidding, and could take many blows from a sword before they fell.

name: Apokris the Resolute – Silver Dragonkin Paladin
description: A paragon of the virtues embodied by the Silver Dragonkin of Azmordion. Apokris is unwavering in his convictions.
