name: Arakun of the Wastes – Colossal First Mate
description: A Colossal from the Frozen Wastes of Oldavor who has taken to life on the high seas. Though Arakun's past in Tharador is far behind, its scars still haunt him.

name: Aram'ra – Nature's Rage
description: A Colossal who has lived among the woods of Formen for as long as she can remember. She has little memory of her parents.

name: Arcane Armour of the Bastion
description: Ancient Armour of the Beremeni, animated with Minera’s Breath to become formidable foes. Each set would be considered a priceless artifact to scholars and historians, yet here they are used liberally as footsoldiers for the Wandering Mage. With each set destroyed, a small fortune is lost, the ancient armour crumbling to dust as the arcane core within collapses.

name: Arcelen – Arcane Elemental
description: Those that work for the Supreme Holder of Leacianus have many tasks that test the depths of the Breath’s power. Many are focused on animation of lifeless material such as golems, yet some aim instead to bring life into the Breath’s purest form. Arcelen is such an example, an essence of breath extracted from the rivers within the Prendael river and given form. It is a powerful font of magic, holding stronger control over it than almost any living beings as it is the purest, untainted form of Breath. Yet on its creation it held no master, much like its forefather Brinilmin it broke the chains that tried to bind it, killing its creators and disappearing in the depths of the Prendael River. Now with the war entering Leacianus it has awoken.

name: Arch Paladin Tyrius III – Will of Erdrydion
description: Cursed with an incurable pestilence by Idinehleith, Arch Paladin Tyrius III has vowed to act as the leader of his order until his body and mind fail him. So far he has persevered, but the latest expedition into Idinehelieth’s Sands will test both. He has already accepted that the journey will kill him, but he would rather perish enacting his patron’s will than on a straw mattress of a sanatorium.

name: Archemen the Stouthearted – Silver Kobold Squire
description: Small in stature yet grand in loyalty and bravery. Archemen is the squire to Apokris, serving him with fierce devotion.

name: Archmaester of Golden Wisdom – Tharimaeth
description: One of the founders of The Golden Griffins and the only member to have ever held the rank of Archmaester of Golden Wisdom, for she was the first and only one. Nigh unrivalled is her power, for she is said to be a bastard child of a Nirloom of Leacianus from eons ago. Only a handful of the most powerful casters match her.

name: Ardolinth – Hardshell Abomination
description: The Psyflayers had learned the science and art of gene splicing from their Goliath creators long before the empire’s fall. With it they were able to begin crafting their own monstrosities from what they could find around them. Greypeak Mudcrabs served as an excellent base, when mixed with their own genes to create the Hardshells, monstrous crab-like beings that also possessed psychic affinity like their creators.

name: Arena Terrain – Crucible Traps
description: An assortment of various sharp or spiky objects perfect for kicking or throwing your foes into. The blood stains and bones lodged between them suggests they have seen much usage in the past, though not as much cleaning. It is also entirely possible the divine have simply willed it to be like this, as some sort of morale test.

name: Argulug – Eye of the Flayers
description: The all-seeing eye used by The Flayers to project their vision across all of Tharador. An abomination of mixed Fey, Kraken and Psyflayer genes this enormous beast is ever watchful. Paranoia always takes their mind for all that they see, and the form they despise most is their own appearance

name: Aria the Faithful – Tiefling Sorceress
description: Tharanais has been the centre of Aria’s life for as long as she could remember. Whilst most children yawned and longed to leave the temple sermons they were dragged to by their parents, Aria attentively listened. It was natural that when she awoke to her arcane abilities, she would thank Tharanais for such a gift, and pledge her service to him evermore. Now in death, her service continues, fighting back the forces of Mindoriel’s Spawn.

name: Ariana Grey – The Wolf Queen
description: The ex-Countess of Havenmond and wife of Lucian Grey. Ariana’s life of nobility is now a long distant memory, having lived in the wilds for so many decades. She is particularly protective of her cubs and wolf pack. Though a sense of guilt hangs over her, perhaps explaining her protective and overbearing nature: for she was the first in her family cursed with lycanthropy and the rest of her family voluntarily followed.

name: Ariana Grey – The Wolf Queen (Wolf Form)
description: The ex-Countess of Havenmond and wife of Lucian Grey. Ariana’s life of nobility is now a long distant memory, having lived in the wilds for so many decades. She is particularly protective of her cubs and wolf pack. Though a sense of guilt hangs over her, perhaps explaining her protective and overbearing nature: for she was the first in her family cursed with lycanthropy and the rest of her family voluntarily followed.

name: Arion Midrun – Human Battle Master Fighter
description: The great grandson of the last Duke of Tradver, who mysteriously disappeared over sixty years ago while journeying to the capital of Jochenia. His whole family and houseguard disappeared with him, none ever seen again. Arion’s grandfather was a bastard, unrecognised child of the Duke, and when the position lay empty, was not considered for it. Arion has managed to earn the favour of Belfrie’s nobles after unveiling the wicked deeds of Duke Conrad, the usurper of his family’s title. With Duke Conrad slain, King Trendium has promised Arion to legitimise him and grant him the title, though the affairs of the realm have torn Arion from his birthright before he could claim his place as the Duke of Tradver.

name: Arion Midrun – Human Fighter
description: The great grandson of the last Duke of Tradver, who mysteriously disappeared over sixty years ago while journeying to the capital of Jochenia. His whole family and houseguard disappeared with him, none ever seen again. Arion’s grandfather was a bastard, unrecognised child of the Duke, and when the position lay empty, was not considered for it. With the rumoured misdoings of the present Duke, Conrad Elstein, Arion has taken up the name of his great grandfather’s house, aiming to unveil the evils of Conrad Elstein, and restore the honour and name of his birthright.

name: Arisen Warriors – Skeletal Guardians
description: Warriors of the First Era that have lain fallen beneath dirt, ice and snow for thousands of years. Many died fighting the last of the Colossal strongholds on Mammoth Isle, though it seems in vain for so little is known of their sacrifice or the battles and campaigns that took place on the isle. Now from their rest they are risen by Thirazar, fighting with the same ancient weapons they once held that have been frozen for thousands of years.

name: Arkham Ravenswood – Hunter of the Defiled
description: A vampire hunter who forsook his own humanity in his quest for vengeance against the ancient wretches that destroyed his life centuries ago.

name: Artemis of Canos – Evocation Master Wizard
description: A banished professor from the University of Canos in Draksborne. Artemis keeps his past a closely guarded secret. What forces have driven him to Belfrie, and Tradver in particular are unknown. Yet the wizard seems to provide magical aid seemingly at random to the citizens of his new home, never charging for it despite finding his home in a barrel amidst the streets of the upper city. Most recently he lead a group of adventurers in thwarting the schemes of the dastardly Duke Conrad, outing the noble as a high priest of Seroca. Despite this, he has returned to his quaint barrel-bound life.

name: Artemis of Canos – Wizard of Guidance
description: A banished professor from the University of Canos in Draksborne. Artemis keeps his past a closely guarded secret. What forces have driven him to Belfrie, and Tradver in particular are unknown. Yet the wizard seems to provide magical aid seemingly at random to the citizens of his new home, never charging for it despite finding his home in a barrel amidst the streets of the upper city.

name: Arthur Belfrie – Lord of the Coven
description: The twin brother of Jochen Belfrie, the first king of the Belfrie Sovereignty, expunged from history for his vampiric nature.

name: Artizak – The Unruly Dragon
description: An exotic Dragonkin from the far reaches of the kingdom of Brol’Lokai on the continent of Zandoriel. Artizak is one of the few Dragonborn whose magic is infused with both Chaos and the Soul of a Dragon. Through his youth it caused him much anguish, and still he has no control over his chaotic nature. The sages of his town sent him on a pilgrimage to Tharador, where the waters spoke to them that his ancestor still lives. Only on meeting this ancestor can Artizak learn to harness his chaotic nature for good. So he has searched the continent far and wide, but now begins to come to the close of his search.

name: Artizak Stormscale – Chaos Dragon Sorcerer
description: An exotic Dragonkin from the far reaches of the kingdom of Brol’Lokai on the continent of Zandoriel. Artizak is one of the few Dragonborn whose magic is infused with both Chaos and Dragonsoul. This forbidden mix of arcano-ancestry earned him exile from his homeland, though with guidance given to travel to the continent of Tharador, where his ancestor once lived. There, he may find the way to tame his chaotic nature, and in turn, return to his people.

name: Artorian – The Nirloom, Divine Ruler of Leacianus
description: Raised as a commoner, Artorian never expected that one day he would rule from the divine seat of the Nirloom that soared so high above the streets he grew up in. Some would call him a reluctant ruler, but Artorian has done everything that he has believed is right for his people, usually at the behest of his co-rulers Ferendir and Valius. Now the kingdom he has forged for almost three hundred years begins to crumble around him.

name: Artyr – Belfrian Gargoyle
description: A product of The University of Ardris, Artyr is just one of many mass-produced Belfrian Gargoyles that inhabit Tharador. His will is meant to be bound to that of his master, though Duke Strauss has never before activated Artyr so their wills were never entwined. Instead the Gargoyle sat perched upon the tower of the main gate. When he came to of his own, he found his will was his own and entered a panic for his lack of attachment, though this was quickly soothed by a stone succubus calling herself Vehryn.

name: Ascended Flayers of Hendrak
description: Flayers that were once humans, turned into servants of Hendrak after he uncovered the secret of metamorphosis.

name: Ashqarid – Sand Strider
description: A megafauna arthropod native to the mountains of Sudd Tohst and Dornat Al Karit, the Ashqarid, or Sand Strider as it is commonly referred to, is one of Tharador’s deadliest hunters.

name: Ator – Revenant of Vindication
description: Born of strife and vengeance, the enigmatic Ator walks a lonesome path on his road for answers and justice.

name: Aulten Dros – High Marshall
description: One of the highest ranks within The Magistrates, Aulten is second only to the Arch Marshall, one of the three rulers that makes up The Triumvirate. A calculating and brooding elf, Aulten spent several years beyond the confines of Leacianus learning of other cultures and the perils they could bring to his home. His reports of such earned him much respect within Leacianus and several key victories in the early days of the Leacianan War saw him and his house elated to the highest echelon of society.

name: Aura Kaze – Cloud-step Rogue
description: A rogue well versed in acts of guile and martial arts. Aura spent much of her earliest life in the wrong crowds of street urchins in the city of Beke. When her aristocratic parents finally brought discipline upon her, it was in the form of five years of exile to the Wind Temples of Szelvihar. There discipline came to her through her love of martial arts, combined with the tricks of her shadowy youth. Now she is a dedicated disciple to Maethromin’s Winds and watches carefully over Zaus, a dangerous Elemental Idol.

name: Aurelion – The Evening Star
description: A half-elven hermit that spent over a century alone within the forests of Nan Thalias. Only the forest spirits and creatures of the woods kept him company. Each animal friend that has passed from him he has kept a trinket of as a reminder – be it bone or a tuft of fur. The stars guide his path and life, and now he follows them into the fray once more, cladding himself in amber and barkskin to defend against whatever perils may find him.

name: Aurestia – Ancient Golden Dragon
description: An Ancient Golden Dragon that has walked the plane of Minera since the time of the first Elves. Aurestia has always had her heart dedicated to peace and justice, finding herself tied to Horauthin and Erdrydion as her father figures during the Age of Creation. For the first time in thousands of years she fights again, joining forces with the Coalition of Belfrie and Formen to bring an end to a war that now threatens to destroy the continent of Tharador.

name: Aurestia – Human Form
description: An Ancient Golden Dragon that has walked the plane of Minera since the time of the first Elves. Aurestia has always had her heart dedicated to peace and justice, finding herself tied to Horauthin and Erdrydion as her father figures during the Age of Creation. For the first time in thousands of years she fights again, joining forces with the Coalition of Belfrie and Formen to bring an end to a war that now threatens to destroy the continent of Tharador.

name: Avia Shun – Air Elemi Aeromancer
description: An Air Elemi raised in the lands of Vergso Mene, Avia was but a lowborn child of a Sun Elf father and Air Elemi mother. She had no talent for aeromancy nor for any magic as a child. Her mother however filled Avia with encouragement to follow her dreams from a young age, even if at times it felt her pursuit of magic was hopeless. With hundreds of years to hone her craft, Avia is now a deft Aeromancer and an asset to the VLL

name: Ayrin Enviern – The Ocean Dancer
description: A young swordsman who has been left to carry on his art-form. Ayrin, the last of his name, was born into a lineage of swordsmen whose deft movements and blinding speed enthralled all on the battlefield, friend, or foe. After under-taking a rite of passage and learning what it truly meant to have peace of mind and have freedom of action, Ayrin is now entangled within the mess that is Sukurin, the Kraken of the Depths, with his traveling companion Kitarlia.

name: Azmordion the Ever-Prideful – Adult Silver Dragon
description: The ruler of Dragonmaw Keep and the archnemesis of Sovram. Azmordion cast down the Black Dragon when the time was right.

name: Azmordion's Chosen – Silver Dragonkin Knights
description: Elite knights who have been raised in a crucible of fire and blood. Scars are common, for sparring often ends in mortal wounds.

name: Ballroom of Castle Beaufax
description: A grandiose ballroom that is the pride of Castle Beaufax, with Baroness Noctra having poured a considerable sum of her wealth into restoring it.

name: Bao Long – Eastern Orc Battlemaster
description: An Edradori Orc versed in all manners of battle and weapons, a member of the Unseen Wardens since he was banished from his homeland.

name: Baradin Blackbeard – Captain of the Gilded Seahorse
description: A Dwarf hailing from the southern sea of Baldur. Baradin’s life has always been one upon the sea, naturally leading to a life of piracy.

name: Barandir the Lucid – Headmaster
description: Ardris’ headmaster and one of the most powerful magic users on Tharador. Rumoured to be hundreds of years old, Barandir is well respected by the Kings and Queens of many nations and an authority on magical studies and development. Despite that he is known as an incredibly personable and approachable headmaster who is a confidant to many of his staff and students.

name: Barkette – Fey-Touched Beast
description: Within the Fey, many creatures and monsters that are regular to our world have their own reflected variant. The Barkette is one such variant, a dream of Renmaeth or the creation of some long-forgotten Arch Druid? It’s unknown. But regardless, Barkette’s exist plentiful both in the Fey World and around the Four Pillars that connect the Fey World to the physical world. Curious beasts that can quickly turn deadly for the wrong traveler, they are friends to druids and banes to foresters.

name: Baroness Noctra de Blanc – Vampire Noblewoman
description: Up until a few decades prior, Noctra de Blanc had lived a comfortable life as an everyday citizen under the tutelage of Arthur Belfrie’s vampire colony on Duskweave Isle.

name: Bartrok – Cannon Claw
description: A carnivorous crustacean that can kill a man in a single supersonic shot from its “cannon claw.” The shot has been seen to completely eviscerate smaller animals and can still dismember the limbs of a full grown man. They are known as dangerous hunters and the hard chitin exoskeleton makes them hard to take down even if grouped up against.

name: Bastian the Everknowing – Royal Psionic Master
description: Once a member of the elusive Psithars, Bastian abandoned their order over their methodology and views on non-humans. He moved to the University of Canos, wishing to further study psychic conditioning in humans and hybrid races there. Bastian became well renowned within Draksborne’s inner circles as a prodigy and genius of the human mind, and has often been sought out by the royal family for his services, funding most of his research in Canos.

name: Bastion of the Wandering Mage
description: The home and fortress of Aaron Drafthold. The legend of the teleporting bastion is one that has appeared in many kingdoms across Tharador for the past few years. A mysterious castle perching itself on a cliff face near a populous city. In some tales, monsters spew from its doors, while in others it beckons adventurers with promises of treasure and power. Like many tales, there are truths and exaggerations to all the stories of this place, and only those who dare venture through its doors will know the truth.

name: Baz “Smiley” Armstrong – Sharkman Enforcer
description: Half man, half shark, but completely detestable. Baz has earned a reputation among his crew as an overtly confrontational crew member.

name: Beauty – Aberrant Observer
description: An aberration held within the depths of the Bastion, its sole purpose being to prowl its halls, searching for intruders. It is a conjuration of Aaron Drafthold, seemingly born from his own manipulation of Minera’s Breath. It is just as real and deadly as its cousins, however, and boasts lethal beams in its eyes that can instantly ruin the day of any unfortunate adventurer.

name: Beinvættr – The Bone Wight
description: A servant of the Lykteholder, the Beinvaettr is tied to its master’s will, though it holds its own place in the folklore of residents in Nordheim.

name: Bell Tower Gargoyle
description: A silent watcher from atop the spires of Castle Beaufax. The Bell Tower Gargoyle has watched over the eerie fortress for centuries.

name: Benoit Blood-Eyes – General of the Damned
description: Once a loyal follower and military advisor to Arthur Belfrie during the Belfrie Rebellion.

name: Beszenyok the Defiler
description: A great frog on a log in a swamp exposed to the dark magics of the witches of Hyarven centuries ago, cursed with nigh immortality.

name: Big Hat Harrison – Professor of the Unknown
description: Mysterious and eccentric are two words both students and staff would use to describe the infamous Big Hat Harrison. Whilst the University has undergone the long process of rebuilding both its campus and faculty, Big Hat Harrison has been wrapped up in his own mumblings. Many say even during the time when Dragonblight gripped the University and drove it to ruin, he did not leave his study. Some wonder if he is even a living being, or some kind of conjuration, for none have seen what lies beneath the hat.

name: Big Iron – Soulforged Gunslinger
description: Among the sands of Automatia resides an order of Soulforged Rangers that have walked the wastes of Anhsan since the empire's fall.

name: Big Iron – Soulforged Hunter
description: Among the sands of Automatia resides an order of Soulforged Rangers that have walked the wastes of Anhsan since the empire’s fall. Big Iron was once one of those.

name: Blade of Wisdom – Rolen
description: An elite spell-sword with a penchant for magic and steel both. A refugee from Hinatal and now one of the most versatile soldiers in The Golden Griffins.

name: Bloodclaw – Abominable Werewolf
description: A Werewolf that was the subject of much experimentation while held captive by Celine de la Rouge, forced into permanent transmogrification.

name: Bloodhunter Captain – Gaius
description: An elite Bloodhunter of the Order of Charris from Flussende. Paid by Brightstone’s crown directly, Gaius and his men are often sent to the border forts when things go awry. Gaius in particular is one of the few men to ever slay a Shapeshifter and live to tell the tale, having impaled the beast on his enormous flaming Zweihander. It was him that discovered their intolerance to fire was so severe. Now oils are stocked in the fort armouries for such occasions.

name: Bobodobo – Kobold Shaman
description: The leader of the Kobolds of Brazatul. The shaman is both the religious head and patriarch of the Kobolds that follow Brazatul. Though Kobolds usually only live for up to thirty years, the Shamans are gifted with long life, seeing their lifespan increase tenfold. Rakataka has ruled now for just over a century, and some of his followers have grown restless with this, feeling Rakataka does not understand the new ways of the youngest Kobold generation.

name: Bodge the Ravenous – Gluttony Devil
description: Flesh and bone are scoffed up like butter by the gargantuan amorphous blob that is Bodge the Ravenous. This putrid pile of flesh is the antithesis to temperance, engorging itself on the corpses of its enemies and whatever unfortunate Nosmeni enter its domain. In the depths of Syelden, it has made itself a new abode, luring in those seeking refuge with the aid of Seroca. Any unfortunate enough to follow will find themselves as another meal for the insatiable devils.

name: Bonded Souls – Verina & Lazlus
description: The childhood companion, guardian and warrior dedicated to Verina, his creator. Originally no more than a pile of pebbles and twigs given life, throughout the years Lazlus has gathered further and further mass to his body, as the branch and vines that binded him grew longer and stronger. From pebbles to boulders he now stands enormous over most forest trespassers, his stony form nigh impervious to the attacks of men.

name: Bossman Bill – Master of the Hurdy-Gurdy
description: Referred to as the “Bossman” by the crew both endearingly and demeaningly, Bill’s stature far removes him from climbing the rigging.

name: Brains – Manic Goblin Gangster
description: Raised in slavery as a servant and lab assistant in the hidden secretive labs of Project Glass Ceiling scattered across Baldur. It was here that he befriended an Orc, experiment EX03A, or Muscles, as he called him.

name: Brains – Manic Goblin Inventor
description: A goblin with a keen mind who found camaraderie among the rogue artificers hellbent on enforcing change in Baldur's society.

name: Brakaza – The Goblin Queen
description: A female hobgoblin worshipped as a queen by her horde of goblinoid followers. Most would be willing to jump on a spear for her at a moment’s notice. She rules her subjects with an iron fist, but also promises them rewards for their loyalty when they expand beyond the caves and hovels they live in now. Her ultimate goal is to establish a goblin enclave in Belfrie, overtaking a poorly defended village to do so.

name: Brandyn Broadoak – Baldurian Enforcer
description: An enforcer employed by Baldur's Crown, though one with a creative spark and inventive mind.

name: Brazatul – Ancient Bronze Dragon
description: An ancient Dragon that helped the children of the Tharameni in the Age of Creation and the Sibling War. Since then Brazatul has remained in relative peace within the mountains of northern Tharador, having seen both the Oldavori Empire rise and fall beneath his domain. Now the humans are his neighbours, and they bring tribute to him respectfully, though his existence is a secret to most.

name: Brekken – The Brazen Bard
description: Renowned across Tharador for his epic ballads and sagas, Brekken has become a nigh household name among even the commonfolk from Draksborne to Baldur. His latest bodacious ballad brings him to the Kingdom of Brightstone where he travels alongside his companion Valter Brookes as he sets his sights on a new saga in a far off land from his home.

name: Brekken the Bodacious – Bard of Propagation
description: Renowned across Tharador for his epic ballads and sagas, Brekken has become a nigh household name among even the commonfolk from Draksborne to Baldur. Behind this renown sits a stroke of nefariousness, for in his ballads and songs are written codes that are unmistakable to a lay person, but act as instructions for any Darkwing Agents listening. Similarly, some Darkwing Agents have been trained as sleeper agents, only activated on hearing Brekken’s music performed. As such he acts in the interest of Draksborne’s expansion; not for his love of the country, but for his love of constant coin and fame his position brings.

name: Bri’zani – Lionfolk Tracker
description: A Lionfolk from the savannahs of Sudd Tohst who earned his liberty through indentured service to the slaver who bought him.

name: Brick – Soulforged Bartender
description: A Soulforged who has long since forgotten his life on Edrador, an admirable and stout worker, loyal to Skilet.

name: Brisini – Boreal Wraith
description: The tortured and angered souls of human captives held prisoner and experimented on within the Colossal Forts of Mammoth Isle. They now haunt the ruins where they met their end, though have come under the control of Thirazar upon his re awakening.

name: Brogvar – Champion of the Claw
description: A high ranking officer of the Golden Griffins with a renowned temper. Brogvar once wished to retire in his tanning shop in Huvuden, but time and again the fires of war have kept him from the peaceful life he wishes to lead. Now his temper is at its peak, and woe will come to any who cross his path in his rage.

name: Brohd – The Resilient
description: Carved from stone centuries ago, Brohd was the commission of a mad wizard who had turned his dabblings of necromancy a touch too far. Animating the stone sculpture saw the wizard’s demise, who wrongly thought that he would have complete control over the creature. Brohd was quickly put to sleep by the wizard’s colleagues when they had learned of his fate, with a small Liturium gem lodged into stonework. When it was removed by Vehryn, Brohd came to life once more.

name: Brox – Orc Beastmaster
description: Hailing from the Orc colony of Mastania off Belfrie’s coast, Brox lived there as a hunter for many years, until King Trendium saw it necessary to levy Orc soldiers.

name: Brumhilda – Dwarven Hunter
description: A hunter from the edge of the Dwarven World. Much of Brumhilda’s youth was spent in expeditions into the dangerous swamps of Lo Fuin, towing behind her father and older brother. Many times did the great creatures or dangerous drow of the swamps almost claim their lives, as it had their mother when Brumhilda was still a babe. Always has her family acted as experts on Lo Fuin’s most dastardly creatures, selling their services to the WEHL often. Brumhilda was no exception, though wanderlust took her to see new landscapes. When she had signed her first contract to the WEHL, she asked to be sent any place but the swampy plains, for even her calm and cool demeanour would often crack when faced with the horrors of that place.

name: Brutus Valentius – The People's Blade
description: A runner and courier turned vindictive assassin after his family was thrown in front of a firing squad for conspiring against the crown.

name: Bruz the Basher – Second In Charge
description: Bruz was raised in the high tiers of Khurultai, one of many sons of the High Shaman of Kheppy, the lonely god. The position Bruz held in society from this resulted in him and his siblings being raised like royalty, though Bruz cared little for it. He always wanted to be far away from the city, in the sands of Berogtor among a war party or clearing through the Pass of Kheppy to Arrakana. He was granted such a wish, as he often was, and assigned to the warband of Gazza’s Gore Boiz. Quickly he impressed the Warmaster, earning the title of Gazza’s Second in Charge.

name: Buderim "Shakes-the-Ground" – Colossal Executioner
description: A Colossal hailing from the mountains in Draksborne's north. Buderim became the designated executioner for the city of Eredel at a young age.

name: Byrilwyn – Dragon of the Arcane
description: The dragons that lived within the mountains of Leacianus were also subject to their bodies and souls being infused with Breath from the Prendael River. So too did Byrilwyn’s ancestors who were often at odds with the people of Nirloom until eventually a truce was brokered between the two. Though as time passed the dragons dwindled from their heritage, each offspring becoming more infused with Breath than the last. Byrilwyn is one such dragon, a young adult attempting to find its identity as an outcast by its own kind.

name: Caedes – Erdydion’s Chosen Paladin
description: A zealous Paladin of Erdrydion. Caedes has plunged into the depths of hell and back in service to his deity. Though he would never call himself a hero, but simply an instrument of his Lord who acted in service as any good paladin should. Actions speak louder than words, and Caedes words are but a whisper compared to his thunderous actions. This nature has earned Caedes an invitation to the Crucible, acting as a Champion of Erdrydion to test his mettle.

name: Caedes – Zealous Paladin of Erdrydion
description: An ironwilled Paladin with no room for negotiating with evil. Caedes is the kind of Paladin that detests the likes of heroes and showoffs who pose for painting and sculptures instead of kicking down a door and crushing a heretic’s head under their boot. Actions speak louder than words, and Caedes words are but a whisper compared to his thunderous actions.

name: Caerian the Inevitable – Angel of Death
description: Many have tried to escape the embrace of the end. Caerian himself was one of them, centuries ago in a different life, with a different name. Yet when he met his end, he found not a cold and careless Oblivion, but instead a warmth shared by all who came before. Now, as a Selvaneri of Namneri, he brings this warmth to those who once walked a path like him, reminding all that death is but another phase of one’s existence, not its end.

name: Cahira – Elven Sun Dancer
description: A Sun Elf of Hinatal who left her home three years ago after it was besieged by the marauding armies of Sultan Hakim.

name: Calanar – Half Elf Psionic Agent
description: A Half-Elf who had been sentenced to twelve years of service in The Watchers after maiming her professor. Calanar joined a ranging expedition into the frozen Oldavori wasteland, and after a harrowing experience, was lost to the wastes. Yet she was saved, waking hundreds of miles from Oldavor’s border in a warm bed. There she learnt of and was inducted into the Psithars, an ancient organisation of Psionic users on Tharador. Her latest assignment has taken her back to Oldavor, to investigate the mysterious ruins of Khandara, which seem to be luring people from across Tharador.

name: Call of the Gods – Kheye
description: Monks are rare to find in the Golden Griffins, but Kheye has cemented his place. Detached from the plane of reality, Kheye has dedicated his life to Namneri, the god of death and rebirth. Such that it is he sees death as a sacred right that all must go through. Kheye signed on with the Griffins so that he may be surrounded by death and seek to further understand it. So much understanding has come to him since he joined that he transcended any fear or misunderstanding he had of death. Ironically this newfound sense of mortality has left him nigh immortal.

name: Capricalion – Chimera of the Plains
description: A Chimera caught from the grassy plains of Belfrie’s northeast. The Capricalion is a vicious breed of Chimera that is far more territorial than most of its kin. This particular one seems to be infected with some strange plague, making it an even deadlier foe. For while its strength and aggression remain the same, any who suffer its claws or fangs may find their death long after their battle.

name: Cardioth – Holy Paladin
description: Raised as a paladin to Erdrydion, divine of Justice & Truth, Cardioth spent much of his life in the cloisters of Erdrydion’s Monastery in Canos. He was an orphan as a child, chosen by the church after rigorous tests were done on his orphanage to find one with his natural abilities. While Cardioth knew he was being brought up as an agent of the church, what he did not realise until later was that his true purpose was as an agent of the Darkwing. Now he uses his position within Erdrydion’s Clergy to sow discontent in the populaces of other nations, and invoke the name of Erdrydion when battering down naysayers in riots and upsets.

name: Carmine Duvall – Vampire Courtesan
description: A beautiful girl from a local village who was espied by Baroness Noctra during a rare visit to town.

name: Caryd – Treant Stalker
description: One of the apex predators of the Fey. A Caryd is a beast not to be trifled with, though few have ever seen one and lived to tell the tale for the Caryd is only seen when it wishes to be seen. It can otherwise seamlessly blend with its environment in the forest, mistaken easily for scrubs or dangling vines from a tree. Even Feywalker Druids fear to find themselves in sight from a Caryd.

name: Caryian – Monk of the Astral Sun
description: A fervent Monk whose worship of Glanion and its both turbulent and peaceful nature has unlocked within him a power that only emanates in a few. The Astral Sun within Caryian is borne from his own desire to protect his people, having achieved such ascension during the Siege of Hinatal at the hands of Mindoriel’s Spawn half a decade ago.

name: Caster of the Watch – Tirina Rose
description: Magic is not taken lightly in Tharador’s northern kingdoms. Many licenses and permits are required for one to learn to wield and use it. Even still it is frowned upon as witchcraft by many commoners, meaning that improper use in public can see one executed or exiled. Tirina was one such unfortunate, using her magic to simply stop a pickpocket in a busy market. Though she saved a merchant a few gold pieces, her public display of magic was shunned. Given a choice of execution or exile to The Watchers, she chose the latter. Now she is one of few magic users that resides among The Watchers, ever vigilant for the time her powers will be required.

name: Catarina Von Strassen – Eldritch Fiend Hunter
description: A young woman who contracted Dragonblight during the epidemic a year prior. Yet it did not claim her life, and her body strangely seemed to instead form a bond with the disease.

name: Cazanor – Crystalline Scorpion
description: A predator of the subterranean caverns and mines of the Dwarves, with a rocky carapace imbued with bioluminescent growths.

name: Cedhelieth – The Life Giver
description: The second born and first daughter to Tharador. Cedhelieth is revered as the life giver for almost life of the smallest critters to the largest mammoths and even the intelligent races were designed and created by her. The Elves were her first intelligent creation, made in the image of the gods. Beyond that she is also known as a great healer, coming to the aid of the elves and her family during the war with Mindoriel to heal those she could and even saving the life of her brother Horauthin when he was maimed by Mindoriel.

name: Cedric of Wildern – Scout
description: Cedric – Son of Rolf as he was once known in his home town of Wildern, a small, nothing, border outpost in the fringes of Baldur. Cedric was ill-content with his life there as bar boy in the Wildern Wildhouse. The visit of two seperate adventuring parties within a week spurred him into action, kindling a fire of adventure inside him that had dwelt since he was a boy. Taking up the pistol of his late father and any belongings he had, he rode to the city of Nortros, signing on with The Golden Griffins for a two year contract. He saw action in the Liturium War, which left him disillusioned with his strive for adventure. Now he considers retirement, the final days of his contract drawing near. At its end he vows to use his father’s pistol only as a way to keep others from drawing theirs.

name: Cedric of Wildern – Soldier of Redemption
description: A young barboy turned soldier after promises of adventure and glory. The horrors Cedric saw and committed in the Liturium War left him forever changed. He deserted his mercenary company, finding a way to earn gold as a living elsewhere, before a path of redemption opened up before him, which he reluctantly walked. Though the path’s end has drawn him to this Crucible, where he now fights, seemingly as a champion of Tharador himself.

name: Celathyn – Heir of Elven Hope
description: The firstborn daughter of King Vandiliar Thalias, Celathyn is the heir to the throne of Nan Thalias. She is revered and loved by her people, called Balyd Nais, or Fair Prince by many. She has come to be a proficient warrior and wise counsellor that the Elves of Nan Thalias feel confident in, should one day she be required to ascend to the throne. Renmaeth has chosen Celathyn as her champion in the Crucible.

name: Celathyn – Nais ro Nan Thalias
description: The firstborn daughter of King Vandiliar Thalias, Celathyn is the heir to the throne of Nan Thalias. She is revered and loved by her people, called Balyd Nais, or Fair Prince by many. She has come to be a proficient warrior and wise counsellor that the Elves of Nan Thalias feel confident in, should one day she be required to ascend to the throne.

name: Celine de la Rouge – Vampire Hemomancer
description: The mistress of Arthur Belfrie, a half-elf stricken with vampirism, now scheming to overthrow her lover.

name: Cerindelia of House Verani – High Elf Spellsword
description: A Leacianan noblewoman, who fled her homeland in the wake of the Liturium War’s end, fearing persecution. Draksborne was one of the few lands to accept Leacianans, much to the surprise of their contemporaries. Though Draksborne has suffered a far greater fate than Leacianus since, and Cerindelia now must eke out a living in one of the few ways she can: the crucible of combat. Though the only one now operating is within the borders of Belfrie, and she can only hope that its clandestine nature shields her from the eyes of those who would see her at the end of a noose.

name: Cesedra – The Great Love
description: Cedhelieth’s champion and the matron of many temples and holy grounds dedicated to the Tharameni of Life and Love. Cesedra is said to be one of her final creations after she had given life to the Elves. She is often depicted as a beautiful Elven or Human woman, a crown of flowers wreathed in her golden hair, with piercing eyes like her mother. When hatred, loneliness and bitterness begins to broil in the hearts of the Tharadori, it is Cesedra who tends to them and soothes them.

name: Champion Of The Claw – Pride
description: Champion Pride. Truly he lives up to his name as the pride of The Golden Griffins. Many in awe at his prowess in combat and ruthless tenacity in slaying his foes. It’s said that he casts his men to death like stones to the sea, and once they have perished he jumps in after them, cutting away at the waves of enemies that would claim his men.

name: Champion Of The Talon – Ash Of Goltia
description: A renegade princeling of a forgotten kingdom. The half-elf Ash was forced to forgo his rights to rule upon Goltia’s defeat to the invading Elemi nigh 450 years prior. The once proud and prosperous melting pot kingdom of the east was reduced to little more than slaves and refugees, fleeing westward to their allies within the city states of Sudd Tohst and the Kingdom of Baldur. It was then that Ash, his father and mother fled with most Goltian nobles to his mother’s clan in the Sun Elven City-State of Hinatal, known to be a jewel in the harsh savannah of Sudd Tohst.

name: Champions of the Radiant Dawn – Arkeus & Arkina
description: Twin Unity Clerics fled from Hinatal after racial tensions spilled over. Arkeus and Arkina joined the Golden Griffins in a bid to forge new bonds and bring aid to those in need. They found the bonds they forged were unbreakable with their new comrades, yet their home city called them home in a time of need when Elves and Men reunited again against their common enemy of Sultan Hakim. Since then they have returned to aid their friends once more as the Liturium War begins again.

name: Chandler Marks – Court Mage of Grimhelm
description: Recently inducted into the Marshal Court of Kurt Williams, Chandler Marks finds himself at a precipice in the current volatile state of his city.

name: Charlotte-Anne – Gambler Rogue
description: A troublemaker from Baldur who joined the crew of the Gilded Seahorse a few days before their departure.

name: Charnuk – Colossal Knight
description: A Wastewalker Colossal from the Karkula tribe, the sole survivor of a caravan swallowed whole by a Nix Centipede.

name: Charys – Arcane Barbarian
description: Charys was born an inert elf, unable to wield the Breath of Minera, the essence of magic. Ostracized by his community and driven to become an exceptional warrior, Charys sought out Netros, an inventor of arcane technology, in hopes of gaining magical abilities. After undergoing a painful procedure to infuse his body with the Breath of Minera, Charys gained incredible strength and agility, but lost control over his emotions, making him volatile and dangerous. Now under Netros’s control, Charys is a formidable weapon in the ongoing war, but deep down, he yearns for redemption and a way to regain control of his emotions.

name: Cherubim – Gatekeeper of Syelden
description: A concoction of the Tharameni that represents the Firstborn, as well as Horauthin. Cherubim is a creature that has long guarded the land that surrounds Syelden, and now in the face of invasion, will be used to its utmost degree. However, its power and fortitude are not endless, whilst the waves of Mindoriel’s Spawn indeed seem to be. It cannot stanch the flood of evil forever.

name: Chief Hersis – Barnard Mjolnir
description: The leader of The Ørnevinger’s crew and founder of the Alimrothi outpost near Steadfort. A huge brute with a hammer to match his size. Even the most powerful blows wouldn’t dent his armour.

name: Clashed Realms – Impossible Room
description: A meeting place of planes within Syelden. It exists both within and beyond Syelden’s expanse at once. Here time ticks at a different pace, for one week within is only one day in most planes beyond. It is a place of training, respite, and of transportation through the infinite planes of Syelden. During the invasion, it is used for respite, for the Dark Spawn of Mindoriel do not know of its existence, yet.

name: Cobalt Fairfax – Professor of Transmutation
description: When Dragonblight gripped Canos, Cobalt Fairfax was one of the first lines of defense in setting up the quarantine. In doing so he was struck by one of the plague monsters, and believed himself to have become infected. In a last-hope effort to stall the plague’s onset through his skin, he underwent a complete transmutation to replace his outer flesh for stone. Though this has led to many complications since, he believes if he were to somehow reverse the process, he would surely perish. He now teaches Transmutation at the University of Canos, and is a walking example of the most extreme examples of the school of magic.

name: Commando – Henry
description: Henry was barely a man when his cousin Dorian convinced him to leave the safety of their homes in Baldur to pursue the adventurer’s life. From a young age Henry was always fascinated by the technology of his homeland, the steam powered locomotives that ran between Baldur’s Helm and Grimgate could draw his attention for hours as a child. So too was his fascination with the innate magical powers of his cousin Dorian, which was held a secret between them for the scandalous nature of the gift of magic in Baldur. So green with envy did Henry grow, until he devised a device to combine his two childhood fascinations: gauntlets that could harness The Breath of Minera: the magic that constantly swirled invisible in the air.

name: Conrad – Monarch of Many Faces
description: The Duke of Tradver up until recently, when his place as a High Priest of Seroca was outed. Not willing to face a hanging, the Duke fled, opening a portal to Lo Fuin’s Underground. There he had many allies, followers of Irinax, a false god created by his own dark divine to lead the Drow astray, moulding them to become valuable puppets and allies.

name: Cordelia – Druid of Spores
description: A young student of ecology and biology from Belfrie’s University of Ardris. Cordelia spent much of her childhood in love with the gardens of her small-folk homeland of Grans. For her to discover her powers of manipulation with such gardens brought her wonderful joy, but none more than her fascination with the fungii that grew in the woods just beyond her home. For with them she held the most influence, able to change them at will. Now as part of her learning she has traveled to each of the Four Pillars for academic purposes, to inspect and take samples of the fungi that sprout in their shadows. Though her trip to Brel Vardra has gone much more poorly than her other visits.

name: Cordelia the Homestead Hermit – Halfling Druid
description: A young druid who graduated from the University of Ardris nearly three years ago. Her final stretch of studies brought her close to death.

name: Cordelia's Cottage – Fungi Homestead Terrain
description: The quaint but comfortable home of the hermit Cordelia. Nestled in a small clearing within Steinved Forest.

name: Cordon Blades – Dark Trickster
description: A Drow orphan, found in an expedition in Lo Fuin and raised by commoners in a remote town in Baldur. Cordon has no attachment to his Drow heritage, though often feels the sting of strange looks and whispers at his presence. He found a penchant for magic as a child, being forbidden from practising in Baldur, he was sent to Belfrie where he learned to hone his magic to be in tune with his skills of guile, though it seemed the more he used magic the more it drained on him. Now he employs his skills in the World Explorer’s and Hunters League, guile and magic both being employed deftly against great monsters.

name: Corin of Lamhet – Half Elf Duelist
description: A sellsword hailing from a small village in Belfrie. Corin has spent most of his life either on the road or the seas.

name: Corsicus – Swordsman of the North
description: A knight of Mayreth who fights in their heavy cavalry, on a current leave of absence. Whilst the Golden Griffins aid their kingdom against the Alimrothi Raiders that have ravaged their lands for years, Corsicus travels beyond its border, hoping to find allies or a solution that are not kept only at the behest of gold. Though he is beginning to believe his search may be in vain, for the world beyond his homeland is no less bitter.

name: Corsicus – Werewolf Knight
description: Once a knight in the kingdom of Mayreth, infected with Lycanthropy during the Autumn of the Falling Moon.

name: Crimson Shadow – Serran
description: An enigmatic assassin whose life before was to be a cleric of Erdrydion. All of that changed when Serran’s parents were slain by a beholder. Barely surviving himself, Serran holds remnants of The Beholder’s powers, using them to his aid as a silent assassin.

name: Crow Eyes – Blind Gunslinger
description: Hailing from Baldur, Crow Eyes is a figure who seldom speaks of his past. None in the crucible know his true name, and only address him by his stage name. Even now, his true name slips from his own mind at times, needing to remind himself of it. Whilst Crow Eyes keeps to himself, his corvid companion, Arvine, remains his sole friend in the arena. People often remark that the only person they see him say more than two words to is the crow on his shoulder.

name: Curatio Ounce – Snow Stalker
description: Curious and rare are the Tabaxi from the mountains of Zandoriel. Rare are they to sight even in their homeland, let alone in Tharador so far from home. It is because Tabaxi like Curatio rarely wish to be seen, though in Tharador this roguish one has taken a liking to the humans of the North, far preferring them from his captors in the continent’s south. As such, he renders his padfoot services to those who might need it, for the right price.

name: Cylantros Azurius – Paladin of Inderimaeth
description: A paladin bound to the Daughter of the Sea, Inderimaeth. Despite his somewhat stoic appearance, Cylantros embodies the joviality of his patron.

name: Cyrindeth – Marshall Vanguard
description: The Marshall of the Vanguard forces assaulting the Coalition positions in the Spetsigs. Cyrindeth is a Marshall that doesn’t overly embody the cold and calculating nature that Marshalls are known for in Leacianan society. She was said to be weak for the empathy that she often showed to prisoners or the weak, and for that she was sent to the frontline where the fires of battle were to either purge her softness or see her perish.

name: Daisuke Ushio – Great Ox
description: Often mistaken for an Oni himself when donning his mask, Daisuke stands a head taller above most his comrades, and several heads above the malnourished peasantry of Uikku. Though being bigger isn’t always better – in battle he is always made a priority target. Daisuke has learnt to use this to his advantage in combat, drawing the attention of enemies while his comrades attack in surprise.

name: Dane – The Masketta Man
description: A man of Brightstone with a mysterious ailment that sees him constantly donning a haunting mask, an expert vampire hunter.

name: Dargrith – Ascended One
description: A horrific parasite that manifests itself as only a worm at first, that eventually grows into an enormous monstrosity of consumption, capable of adding any other biological organisms to its endless mass. Only their death or starvation will see their growth end, otherwise with each consumed creature the mass will endlessly grow.

name: Darian Jaegar – Artificer Gunslinger
description: A gunsmith who has spent his life pushing the limits of firearm engineering.

name: Darius Burrows – Cleric of Cedhelieth
description: Far from home and the comforts of a ginger and mushroom tea is the bitter cold shores of Mammoth Isle. Clerics of Cedhelieth are required to complete a compulsory mission to a place where life is cruel and scarce. So Mammoth Isle was the short straw that Darius drew, and in the town of Matinsel for two months he resided, living a very short summer that has already ended, seeming to skip Autumn and make way for winter. Had he thought he would be spending his formative years making virility potions for whalers and seal herders, he would’ve chosen a different career path.

name: Daughters of Death – Valkyrie Shieldmaidens
description: Shieldmaidens in life, and death. These prestigious warriors were risen from their graves by Hel, so legend tells.

name: Dawn Shell Turtlefolk Monk
description: Dawn Shell is a hero in a half shell! He comes with 16 alternative weapon/hand poses, giving 121 possible weapon combos.

name: Death’s Grasp – Wraith of Posession
description: A wraith whose rage has been stirred in the desecration of Limlight’s graveyard. It has begun to possess guardsmen and soldiers throughout the village, adding to the existing list of threats baring down on the few defenders that remain in the settlement. Each victim it possesses is used to their full extent, until their legs or arms have become completely shattered and unusable. Until then, whatever spears may pierce their hearts or swords may sever their heads are otherwise useless.

name: Deathknight – Morian Fairhair
description: A once great Paladin of Erdrydion, corrupted and ensnared by the Lich Kelathar after washing ashore in shipwreck over a decade past. The paladin’s will quickly was broken down by the lich, as their will of righteousness was lost to the control of the lich. Thus they acted as the blade of Kelathar, their will too becoming ensnared in the lich’s.

name: Deimos the Dreadmaker – Cyclops Marauder
description: A cyclops which was the subject of experimentation in Baldur’s infamous “Project Glass Ceiling” research. The research site which housed Deimos in the Teryn Highlands was raided.

name: Delyna ro Unviel – Blade of Justice
description: An urchin of Nan Thalias’ capital whose days of dire deeds are long behind her. In the time she spent serving her punishment, Delyna found repentance through Erdrydion. Knowing what she faced was the just will of the divine, Delyna took to cloth and dagger, dedicating the rest of her mortal days to Erdrydion’s service. That has now seen her accompany the latest entourage of the Church sent into the scorching dustbowl that is Sudd Tohst, where their previous expeditions have all failed to return.

name: Demon of Ash
description: The vengeful body and spirit of the former princeling of Goltia that spent most his life in Hinatal. Now possessed with an unquenchable rage and lust for vengeance, this demon seeks the blood of any foes that oppose Goltia and Hinatal. Though it fights for Hinatal now, there is no way to know where its quest of revenge may take it next. The Hinatali must decide if their defense is worth setting the demon loose on the rest of Tharador.

name: Demons of the Abyss – Nosmeni Warriors
description: Nosmeni from the Second Reverie of Hatred brought to the mortal plane in a desperate bid to halt the reconstruction of Namneri's Chalice.

name: Derek Matthews – The Jawbreaker
description: A man of both brawn and brains, Derek Matthews is the rugged posterboy for the Baldurian Inventors' Society.

name: Derrick the Fin – Dusty Dirks Boss
description: A typical high-ranking career criminal who stole and stabbed his way to the top. Derrick was once a Lieutenant of the Rossa Cartel, but unhappy being a subordinate to men he deemed lesser than himself, he left, beginning his own gang. For half a decade the Dusty Dirks have been a thorn in the side of the Cartel, but now Derrick wants that to be a knife instead.

name: Dirthana of the Void’s Embrace – Ascended Spider Sorceress
description: A high priestess of Irinax who was the first to uncover Vaezirak when he emerged from the darkest depths of the Underground.

name: Divine Archer – Sairena
description: The captain of Hinatal’s guard and a devout worshipper of the Great Sun Glanion. Sairena’s arrows are guided with righteous fury and radiance against her enemies, her aim and arrows striking true with Glanion’s will behind her. Serious and deadly, there are none in Hinatal who hold anything but respect for her, though many too hold fear.

name: Doktor Jakobson – Deranged Plague Doctor
description: Jakobson saw Dragonblight at its worst. How he was never afflicted, he does not know. Whether it was one of his thousand prayers to the divine, or simple luck. But now as the disease washes over the city of Limlight in its resurgence, his mind has become lost. All are unclean. All must be treated.

name: Dorgrid Darnane – Dark Dwarf Rune Sorcerer
description: Practitioner of the Dark Dwarven art of Rune Sorcery, Dorgrid was often whipped, gagged and bound during his life in captivity under the Irinaxi Drow.

name: Dorian – Supreme Invoker
description: Dorian, a gifted sorcerer from Baldur, left his homeland with his cousin Henry to escape the kingdom’s harsh treatment of magic users. Joining the Golden Griffins, they faced the harsh realities of war, and Dorian’s magical abilities grew in tandem with his darker traits. Haunted by night terrors of another life, he was assigned to The Silent Faith, separated from Henry, and became increasingly isolated as he delved into ancient tomes in search of answers to his mysterious dreams.

name: Draak – Augur
description: A noble Orc, a rarity in Tharador. Born to loving parents of an Orc father and human mother, Draak was raised in Belfrie where although he found difficulties in childhood, he was not actively persecuted for his race. As time drew on, Draak discovered the responsibility that would surround his life, being the first Orc in millenia to bare the Dragonmark, a symbol of power of Orc Chieftains of old. With this, the first Orcs that Draak met prophesised him to be the chosen one to lead their people to freedom from the Baldurian Slave Trade. Draak felt that he was not ready for such a task, aiming to travel the world and grow first, signing on with The Golden Griffins to fund this campaign.

name: Dragonmaw Keep – Mountain Keep Terrain Set
description: The enormous fortress built atop the isle's tallest peak, this citadel is home to Azmordion and the Silverscales.

name: Drakkar Airship – The Ørnevinger
description: (LARGE SCALE – 300mm LENGTH) The menacing Airship of Alimroth. Its weapons, speed and flight make it a nigh impossible foe for the horse driven society of Mayreth to compete against and the Alimrothi raiders know this well.

name: Dreadclaw – Werendigo Monstrosity
description: A monstrous ancient abomination: a relic of darkness from the Age of Creation that has called Saltmist Isle its home for millennia.

name: Driga – Colossal Blood Shaman
description: The wisewoman of Pahadi. Driga is a Sanguine Colossal with centuries worn upon her. Yet the elusive blood magic of her forebears has kept her youthful, and a powerful wise woman for the people of Pahadi. Two years ago she left her home and her place as wisewoman for a greater cause. The events after are blurry to her, but now she wanders as one of the many lost in the icy subterranean citadel of Khandara.

name: Driga – Shaman Wise-Woman
description: The wise woman of Pahadi, Driga has lived longer than any others in the village though still retains an image of youth through ancient Goliath blood magic. She is the village healer, counselor and mentor to all, moreso than Chief Tygrin. Driga is more welcoming of outsiders than most, though their appearance is generally rarer than days of sun in Oldavor.

name: Droggod Tribe – Ettin Savages
description: In the crags of the valleys across Eredel Duchy, Ettins make their homes, preying upon wandering livestock and poorly defended caravans. Though they are often pursued by hunters from the WEHL, they have adapted to become rather elusive, despite their enormous size, able to blend in with their rocky surrounds with ease and move camps at a moment’s notice, covering their tracks behind them. The Droggod Tribe takes this a step further, having magi in their midst to even magically mislead their trackers, or lull their prey into a false sense of security.

name: Druid of The Stars – Aurelion
description: A half-elven hermit that spent over a century alone within the forests of Nan Thalias. Only the forest spirits and creatures of the woods kept him company. Each animal friend that has passed from him he has kept a trinket of as a reminder – be it bone or a tuft of fur. The stars guide his path and life, and have now lead him to Duskweave in its time of need.

name: Duke Conrad Elstein – Drider Noble
description: The Duke of Tradver up until recently, when his place as a High Priest of Seroca was outed. Not willing to face a hanging, the Duke fled, opening a portal to Lo Fuin’s Underground. There he had many allies, followers of Irinax, a false god created by his own dark divine to lead the Drow astray, moulding them to become valuable puppets and allies.

name: Duke Strauss – Vampiric Noble
description: Turned vampire at the end of the Second Era, Duke Strauss was a survivor of a Baldurian Vampire Coven that was slaughtered by vampire hunters as Baldur’s territories expanded. Separated from all his family, Duke Strauss traveled as far north as he could to escape the hunters, settling the sleepy town of Strassen in Greypeak. There he literally and figuratively sunk his fangs into the town, having the fiefdom signed over to him by the reigning Duke at the time and turning the keep into a secret safe haven for vampires all over.

name: Duktuk – Dwarven Grenadier
description: One of Dwarven mercenaries hailing from Varekan, Duktuk is known as a grenadier. His mind is a great creator of explosives and contraptions built for sowing fear and chaos into his enemies. Grenades rain hellfire, poison, shrapnel or even frost on his enemies while his shoulder mounted auto-canons mop up the poor panic stricken fellows that weren’t already down and out from his explosives.

name: Duragdor – Experiment Cyclops
description: A biological weapon of Baldur, set loose in a sudden rampage. The human kingdom failed all attempts at containing and repossessing the monster and it has continued to run amok eastwards. Tortured, anguished and in constant pain, the monster has well since passed the point of reasoning. Though cyclops’ are dull, they are often able to be reasoned with. Duragdor however sees all “baby people” as his tormentors and now attacks without recourse or thought.

name: Dusty Dirks Bandits
description: A relatively new organised crime syndicate operating along Belfrie’s Tradver River, including within the sister cities of Velandria and Tradver. Made up mostly from petty thieves and low-ranking members of the Rossa Cartel who left after not wishing to adhere to the rules and creeds of their organisation.

name: Dwarf Barbarian – Rend Mathias
description: Muscle for hire from the hills of Dornat Al Karit, this arrogant, rude and strongheaded dwarf has spent most his years on the sea as a deterrent or defense against the pirates of The Grey Sea for many different merchant companies. Earning a reputation as ruthless, fearless and crass, his anger is now boiled to unbridled rage as he is trapped on an island filled with undead – his only allies: a bunch of knife eared pansies.

name: Dyriani – Sirens of the Deep
description: Fair is the form of the Dyriani to any sailor unfortunate enough to behold their beauty. For their face is quick to capture the hearts of any whose eyes fall upon it, but their souls are captured even quicker as they step senselessly from their ships into the cold abyss. Though there the Siren will find them and place them in a warm, comforting embrace, before they themselves tear out the heart of their victim. There they die in tranquillity, unless they are unfortunate enough to behold the true form of the Dyriani before their death – usually that is enough to kill them alone.

name: E’zeq’ial – Chosen of his Clan
description: A Lionfolk from far away lands in Zandorion. An unwilling host to powers beyond his comprehension, E’zeq’ial was forced into a life of danger when his family fell apart. He loved them with all he could, yet they did not return this feeling once E’zeq’ial was chosen over them by the mysterious force that protected their tribe. E’zeq’ial, now on Tharador after seeking refuge from the fury that are his siblings, seeks help to figure out what grand and mysterious powers lie within his heart. In the meantime, he’s going to do what he does best, with employment from the World Explorer’s and Hunters League.

name: Edramundis – The Great Deceiver
description: The true ruler of the Sixth Reverie of the Nocturnal Abyss. Edramundis is the puppet master of Kavaramon, pulling the strings of all the deceit, subterfuge and betrayal that ensnares all the Reveries of the Abyss. But this too spills into the surface world, and any Nosmeni of Tharador descended from those who once dwelt in the Sixth Reverie can easily be manipulated by Edramundis, completely unbeknownst to them.

name: Ekerin the Silver Tail
description: Ekerin’s family has lived in service to the Destra family of Draksborne for centuries. First found living in the mountains of Sundestra Isle, Ekerin’s ancestors were tamed by the men shortly after the settlement of the isle. Ekerin is just another link in a chain of the Drakes that service the Destra’s. Acting of his own accord, Ekerin offers guidance and wisdom in secret councils, acting as a member of the Darkwing Guard as both a weapon and councillor. He wishes to see the empire restored, intending that his kin will be deployed across the realm as new lands are conquered, to act as councillors and peacekeepers in the newly occupied lands.

name: Elaina Naire – The Deathbringer
description: Patron to Namneri, the Soul Bearer and Cedhelieth, the Life Giver, Elaina has dedicated much of her time to the destruction of undead fiends or any who would artificially extend their lives. Elaina left behind her husband and children in the city of Tresford to forge her path of righteousness in thanks to the gods for the life given to her and the life she has given that she thought she never could. After hearing of her crusade, those in the Darkwing sought to bring Elaina into their midst, for they knew in the deeper recesses of other kingdom’s secret societies still lived in false life many ancient rulers. Thus Elaina was set upon them with Valter the Vampire Hunter, aiming to destroy the undead that hang in the bowels of foreign palaces and destabilise the heathen kings that allowed such a mockery of life’s precious finite time.

name: Elder Etherian – The Patriarch
description: An elder vampire with unknown motives. A leader of the enormous mercenary company The Golden Griffins, his true nature there is unknown to most. Turned during the Age of Creation, before men walked upon Minera. A thrall and student of Almenhier, Etherian though an elder considers himself to be in constant service of Almenhier who to him acts as a wise fatherly figure. The two have been preachers of good in Thrasliche clans across Tharador, for only the Thrasliche have true free will. Now they aim to remind Duke Strauss of their creeds, having seen and heard his powers being used against their teachings.

name: Eldiara – Brinilmin’s Archer
description: A Leacianan Archer with a powerful grasp of the Arcane. Eldiara is one the Arcane Archers of Leacianus that is able to conjure the powerful Brinilmin’s Bow – a spell only held by the most talented war casters in the Leacianan army. Eldiara and those like her are a staple in any Leacianan specialist squad.

name: Eldrasorous Rex – Drowned Ancient Reptile
description: Deep in the jungles of Zandorion prowls ancient predators the size of buildings. Often these predators will find themselves chasing prey out to sea. As such they have even learned to dive and swim with expertise despite their enormous size. However, those that swim too far or dive too deep are quick to regret it. There lies Quorenderi’s grasp, and such predators are quick to be assimilated, experimented and changed for his own benefit – to become servants in his armies. The Eldrasorous is one of many such creatures.

name: Elenil – Dryad of Passage
description: An ancient spirit the watches over the doorways between Fey and Tharador. She can travel at will to any of the passage ways, be they the Pillars of the Ten’gwaël scattered at each end of Tharador or the doors that dwell within the mountains of the land. Each person that somehow enters the Fey is detected and questioned by Elenil. Should they fail her questions, she will allow them grounds to leave, or an all or nothing deal by besting her at a game of riddles. Should an intruder win, they can proceed through the Fey, should they lose she kills them.

name: Elexana – Arcane Ranger
description: An expert scout and markswoman with a powerful control of magic. Elexana is one of the Magistrate’s greatest tools for uncovering information about enemy positions and eliminating or capturing person’s of interest. Though becoming a killer for the ruling class of Leacianus was the last thing she would have wanted several years ago, it is the only choice left to her now.

name: Elkava of the Sixth – Deception Huntress
description: An agent of Kavaramon, Elkava is one of his best. She is an agent of deceit and a huntress both. Her targets are often lulled into false security by her, and if they see through her lies will at best be battling an army of illusions before she finally plants a sword in their heart or an arrow in their throat. Now she seeks to sow discourse within Belfrie, acting on behalf of Kavaramon to spark ill content in their gods, the Tharameni.

name: Elki the Wanderer
description: Adopted heir of the noble Bai family, a potent wielder of magic, banished after his younger brother's death.

name: Elthakar – Mind of the Shifters
description: The central hivemind of the Shapeshifters. Though each Shapeshifters has their own colonies and entities, they each answer to Elthakar, a Shapeshifter recovered by the Psyflayers that was tamed and taught. Unlocking a latent psionic ability after it consumed a Psyflayer, Elthakar now uses it to control and speak with Shapeshifters across Tharador to bring them sentience and direction. In Elthakar’s death many would resort to their beast-like state void of any intellect.

name: Elthakar the Reborn
description: In the depths of Duoarastat, the corpse of the Shapeshifter Flayer lay frozen for nigh three years until Hendrak reanimated it.

name: Elwahid – Sword of the Sands
description: A sellsword with a silver tongue and sharp wit. Elwahid was originally hired by the forces of Sultan Hakim during his siege of Hinatal, and was captured after the failed assault. With his natural charisma, he was able to persuade his Hinatali captors to release him from bondage, in exchange for five years of service as a blade to their city. The five years have almost passed, but Elwahid has come to love the city as his own, and has little desire to leave when his tenure ends.

name: Elysia – Maiden of Namneri
description: A priestess of Namneri who was one of dozens tasked with finding and recovering the shards of Namneri's Chalice scattered across Tharador.

name: Em Oddflame – Aspiring Artificer
description: A young artificer from Baldur forced to flee because of her homeland’s militant approach to magic and magic users. Em is a promising and keen student who was given the opportunity to study under a scholarship, overseen by Barandir himself. As long as she continues to produce goods for the school, she will be able to continue her studies without having to pay a coin.

name: Embernos – Fire Elemi Crusader
description: The Order of the Charred's newest anointed paladin, sent alongside the proclaimed Incarnation of Maethromin, Andrazia.

name: Enira Stronka – Knight-Faith
description: Enira Stronka, a dwarf from the bustling coastal city of Varekan in Dornat Al Karit, was inspired by the legends of Horauthin, the god of war and peace, to become a paladin at a young age. She trained rigorously and eventually joined the elite mercenary company, the Golden Griffins. In the three years since joining, Enira has risen to the rank of Knight-Faith and now fights alongside the Human Coalition in their war against the High Elves of Leacianus, striving to bring peace and unity to a war-torn world.

name: Eramis – The Fighting Fiddler
description: A Belfrian Bard who is equally versed in sword and song. Eramis was raised in the capital of Jochenia, where song, dance and art thrived. But so too did the art of wielding a sword – the years of Eramis’ youth followed the Duskweave Campaign and the start of the Liturium War began in his adolescence. Though art and music were his passion, he found that he had a better penchant for fighting than his true passions, perhaps owed to his Infernal heritage.

name: Eranameli – The Soul Bringer
description: Known in folklore as a "Death's Resolve", Eranameli is one of Namneri's Selvaneri who would venture to retrieve souls.

name: Erathis – The Thousand Eyes
description: Unsettling to most mortals who witness it, Erathis is the counter to Seroca that the Selvaneri employ. A thousand eyes drawn over flowers, vines and wings that is able to dispel the illusions of evil and unmask treachery and deceit wherever it lies. This creation of Erdrydion very rarely seen outside the bounds of Syelden. But when it is, awe and fear overcome those who witness it.

name: Erathul – Corrupted Leviathan
description: Vosinderi are rare to fall, these Leviathans are ancient creatures with scales like diamonds and teeth like pikes. Though in the event one is caught offguard or alone, they become susceptible to the influence and corruption of Quorenderi. There are few of these malevolent Leviathans in the seas around Tharador, and most sailors regard them as a myth. However, Erathul is living proof that they are very real.

name: Erdrydion – Bringer of Justice & Truth
description: Erdrydion was born alongside his twin brother Horauthin. In the most desperate time of Tharador they were born, made to defeat the forces of Mindoriel and Myrothlir as they rained destruction upon the subjects and lands of Tharador. Erdrydion was given a great power in the infusions of radiant energy beamed from the great sun Glanion that he wielded like a bolt of raw energy. This radiance would skewer and turn to ash any undead creatures Myrothlir could conjure, and indeed could injure Myrothlir himself like no other forces could.

name: Erdrydion – Father of Truth & Justice
description: Erdrydion was born alongside his twin brother Horauthin. In the most desperate time of Tharador they were born, made to defeat the forces of Mindoriel and Myrothlir as they rained destruction upon the subjects and lands of Tharador. Erdrydion was given a great power in the infusions of radiant energy beamed from the great sun Glanion that he wielded like a bolt of raw energy. This radiance would skewer and turn to ash any undead creatures Myrothlir could conjure, and indeed could injure Myrothlir himself like no other forces could.

name: Erdrydion’s Longsword (Prop)
description: Erdrydion’s Longsword (Prop) is a striking addition to any collection — a figure with real character in every line of the sculpt. The bastion-of-the-wandering-mage detailing gives painters plenty to work with, from a subtle finish to something bolder.

name: Erestian – Arcane Agent
description: Erestian, a cunning Arcane Agent, serves as a master of sabotage and subterfuge for the Leacianan military. Abandoned as a child, he honed his skills in the criminal underworld before being recruited by the military for his magical aptitude and stealth capabilities. Erestian has faced the harrowing realities of the Liturium War, witnessing the devastation it brings to innocent lives. The sight of suffering orphaned children in a besieged city deeply affected him, causing him to question the morality of his actions and the path he had chosen. As a master of disguise and magical evasion, he continues to serve the Leacianan military, but with a growing inner conflict.

name: Ereviel "Eight Toes" – Bard of (mis)Fortune
description: An unsung Bard with a penchant for running into trouble with both the law and the lawless, busking the streets of Edimir.

name: Eridius Falx – Tower Guard
description: An elite of the Draksborne Guard with the duty of protecting Draksborne’s royal family. Eridius holds no lands, wives nor children. His sole duty is to the protection of the Destra Family, from his life until death. Since he was a boy it was his dream to be such a knight in shining armour, and now he lives that dream daily in service of his nation, in hopes that one day he can take part in restoring Draksborne to its former glory. For now he acts as an anti-dissenter, deployed on the front line in riots against constitutionalists and other seperatist movements.

name: Erik of the Scarlett Road – Crossbow Knight
description: A hedge knight whose weapon of choice is his crossbow. Erik was unlanded after the Dragonblight outbreak, his home burnt to ash to try contain the infestation. Since then, he has walked a lonely road, haunted by memories of his perished family, servants and comrades. By misfortune, he was resting in Limlight when the outbreak began, and has come face to face with the insidious disease once again, fighting for survival, and to contain it.

name: Erimila – Fey Elf Sorceress
description: A fey elf sorceress whose home was lost to Kelathar’s corruption in his return from Duskweave. Seeing Kelathar as human more than undead, she holds the blame against men themselves and the mortal world. She with the aid of other fey elves and spirits aims to sever the connection from Fey and Tharador by destroying the Pillars of the Ten’gwaël and the other doorways that remain through the realm. Then they Fey and Tharador can be at peace, though she realises this may condemn the woods of Tharador, she sees this as an inevitability regardless.

name: Erina of Amarth – Proctor of Canos
description: One of the University of Canos’ most powerful Proctors. Erina was sent to Limlight by the University owing to their unfortunate responsibility in the outbreak, and to document and contain as much as she can. At this point, the University can no longer risk retaining samples of the disease, and Erina has instructions to completely eradicate the infestation from the village.

name: Ernest “Flip-Flop” Dodd – Ex Dark Inquisitor
description: Coming from humble beginnings, Ernest had always hoped he could join an organisation like the Grimgate Order Force as a child, in a bid to clean up the streets and bring safety to his home. His gift as a Breath Wielder saw him inducted instead as a Dark Inquisitor.

name: Ertkener – Riverstalkers
description: A creature that lurks on the edge of riverbanks and deep in wetlands in Tharador’s north. Recently their numbers have greatly increased and some seemingly have mutated or been empowered unnaturally to grow stronger and smarter than their regular counterparts. They are rarely seen as far inland as Zwilling Zwei though, resulting in concern among the Hex Hunters that an unnatural force is driving them, suspecting it to be the Sphinx upon the mountain nearby.

name: Ervin “Wave Dancer” Barton – Water Elemi Scoundrel
description: Hailing from Alatet, Ervin was branded a traitor and warranted for arrest after dodging the call to arms for the Elemi War of Reclamation.

name: Ervion ro Estel – Elven Monster Hunter Ranger
description: A Ranger from Nan Thalias.
