Ervion was sent as part of an Elven diplomat’s escort, alongside his father which was attacked by a retinue of goblins and bandits near the duchy boundary of Tradver. Ervion barely survived, though was found and healed by a Dwarven Cleric of Cedhelieth. He then vowed to find his father or avenge him, slaying their attackers. Thus he was led into the pursuit against Duke Conrad who ordered the attack against the diplomat, eventually slaying him alongside his companions. Now his place in Nan Thalian society is cemented as a folk hero who drove the blighting Duke from their sacred forest.

name: Ervion ro Estel – Elven Ranger
description: A Ranger from Nan Thalias. Ervion was sent as part of an Elven diplomat’s escort, though was only a novice himself. As they reached the surrounds of Tradver, their retinue was attacked by a coordinated force of goblins and bandits. In the fighting and chaos, Ervion was thrown into the river, washing up downstream hours later. Finally he would arrive in Tradver, only to learn his brethren never arrived in the city. Now he aims to find out what happened to them, and bring whoever was responsible for the attack to justice.

name: Eryial of Arvere – Unhinged Explosives Enthusiast
description: A girl from the mines of Arvere, a dark bastion of isolation for any girl her age. Forced to work from thirteen summers old.

name: Erys – Vampiric Seductress
description: The paramour to Duke Strauss. Erys found her way into the Duke’s chambers on the edge of a bounty hunter’s sword who brought her before the Duke, wishing to claim the large price on her head. Though Erys pleaded to the Duke what uses she would have to him alive as opposed to dead. Succumbing to her, the Duke wiped the bounty hunter’s mind of the encounter, washed him in ale and dumped him outside a local gentleman’s establishment. Though Erys was not one to show such mercy, she began to learn the Duke’s ways and the two molded each other into their own ideals.

name: Estelia – Renegade Golden Griffin
description: A half-elf whose mind is scarred from the horrors of the Liturium War. Though she pressed on in the wake of the war, the horrors that emerged proved too much for her to bear.

name: Estranith – Godless Panther
description: Estraniths are native to Godless Isle and fearsome beasts like this are usually found in the forests of Zandorion, leading scholars to believe that Godless Isle may in fact be an isle of Zandorion that drifted far from the Twins. It was first thought to be a foreign kind of panther on first sighting, but only for its dark colour and swift motion. To the taxologist who first sighted it, it was merely a black blur on four legs.

name: Eulysses the Eversighted – Knight of the Owl
description: A knight of the Order of the Owl, Eulysses remains its sole survivor after its destruction during both the Liturium War and Dragonblight plagues. Now with little direction left, he sinks himself into the constant thrill of battle, in hopes to find himself a worthy death, even if it is to the cries and cheers of the commoners.

name: Evana the Proselytizer – Devout of the Tharameni
description: A maiden of the Church of the Tharameni, Evana has come to Grimhelm amongst the fleet as a healer and battle maiden.

name: Evarak – Treant of Duskweave
description: A treant captured from Duskweave Isle and brought in stasis to Belfrie by the University of Ardris for study. Several years after its arrival, it suddenly disappeared from the University’s archives, and now resides within the Crucible, kept as a worthy contender for its combatants for its regenerative properties that make it a creature that they can continuously reuse.

name: Exelian the Forbidden – Ancient Monstrosity
description: An ancient monstrosity of Seroca that has been summoned by the Serocan Cultists near Hinatal. This herald of destruction and doom is one of the Spawn of Secret’s more overt creations, though its nature as being mistaken as a creation of Myrothlir often serves its purpose of distracting and panicking those whom Seroca seeks to manipulate. Thus in Hinatal its purpose is intended to demoralise its populace, more than feast upon them.

name: Exrin Nvata – Moonlight Ranger
description: A Drow Ranger who is a devout follower of Glanbeli, acting as an instrument of her champion Kadna. Things changed drastically for Exrin during the Autumn of the Falling Moon, which resulted in Glanbeli’s true emergence as a deity. This event saw herself and her kin imbued with the power of the radiant moon, and Exrin has now been chosen by Kadna to act as Glanbeli’s Champion at the Crucible for her devout services.

name: Exrin Nvata – Scout of Swamps
description: Exrin was never one for following the rules. Her and her twin brother Xandir were always more interested in exploring the world outside of her small village in the underground. When she was old enough, her and Xandir left their home and never looked back, taking to the wild swamps of Lo Fuin. It was here they were discovered by Kadna Glydrin on one of her Full Moon Rituals, she took both the twins in her employe and began to routinely use them for scouting missions and ensuring the safety of Ritual Sites in the swamps.

name: Eyrik – Battle Engineer
description: The battle-engineer of Airship Clandestine, Eyrik is responsible for the well-being of the ship and keeping it in the air, which can also entail engaging combatants on the ground that might be responsible for harming the ship. His Third Arm is used in the swift fabrication of mechanical contraptions such as weapons, defenses or utilities such as mines or smoke screens.

name: Faenror the Fey Touched – Direwolf of the Woods
description: The Sentinel of Steinved Forest, Faenror has seen empires rise and crumble, all from the groves of his woods.

name: Faerie Queen Userios – Queen of the Fey Court
description: A mad Fairie Queen whose insanity has begun to infest the lands she calls home, both in the Fey and upon Tharador.

name: Father McKinley – Righteous Inquisitor
description: A Priest of Tharanais turned Inquisitor. Father McKinley was once a practitioner of magic in his younger years.

name: Felix Droste – Graduate Battlemage
description: Son of a lesser noble from the North, Felix lost everything during Dragonblight. He has endured, however. Completing his studies despite the adversity, and the loss of his parents, funding and home. Compassionately, the University of Canos offered him employment when he completed his studies in a bid to pay them back. Thus he is now contracted to five years working under the Proctors of the university, providing security and overwatch to threats within and outside the campus.

name: Ferdinand Vandame – Vampiric Virtuoso
description: Prestigious is a word that barely scratches the surface of the famed reputation of Ferdinand Vandame, a composer widely regarded as one of the greatest of all time.

name: Ferendir Miar – Arch Holder
description: The matriarch of House Miar and the Arch Holder of Leacianus. Ferendir is responsible for all matters of Science and Faith throughout the High Elven kingdom. She is one of the oldest of Leacianus’ noble house rulers, having lived since the early days of the First Era, remembering a time when the Colossals were still an empire. That is a long past memory now, for the new empires of Men crowd around her kingdom, challenging her faith and diluting pure Leacianan sorcery with their own bastardised casting methods. She welcomed the Liturium War at first, hoping to tear down the alliances Artorian had spent years forging. Now it seems her own walls will be torn down around her.

name: Field Marshal Kurt Williams – Commander of Baldur
description: The Field Marshal of Baldur, the ruler of the nation's military, second only to the king himself.

name: Filandira – The Bloodletter Buccaneer
description: An Elven rapscallion from the isles of the Katarn Sea. Filandira endured much hardship when her home was destroyed and her family was forced to flee to Baldur. Quickly she was taken advantage of and fell under the wing of a local street gang. When things went sour she fled, signing on to the Salty Charter and earning a reputation for being belligerent, difficult to work with but extremely adept at just about anything her job required.

name: Fiona “Dead-Eye” Stuttgart – Harpoon Marksman
description: A longtime member of the Gilded Seahorse, Fiona is hailed for her impressive accuracy with her harpoon gun, despite her lack of depth perception.

name: Firalyn – Fey Touched Owlbear
description: Creatures of Tharador often find counterparts of themselves within the Fey. Owlbears are no exception, and their Fey counterparts are every bit more deadly than their mundane cousins from the physical world. Firalyn especially is aggressive, driven with wrath by the whisperings of its master Torgothrin.

name: Firenzia Fireblood – Fire Elementalist Warrior
description: A Fire Elemi born within the fallen human kingdom of Arrakanna in Edrador, who fled across the seas in fear for her life, pursued for her cursed heritage.

name: Fjornath – Desecrated Forest Guardian
description: A Fey Guardian turned into a monstrosity through ill magick. Likely the work of a powerful Lich or something even worse. Only the most powerful of creatures could slay a beast like Fjornath, let alone bring it to life once more in a decaying and decrepit state to fulfill evil deeds.

name: Flim & Krim – Ettin Brute
description: An Ettin from the highlands of Nan Thalias, Flim & Krim are recent additions to the arena, and currently undefeated. With each combatant slain, the pair add an extra trophy and more gear to their bodies. Bucklers and shields from the slain adorn their body. Even the most experienced of the Crucible veterans do not wish to battle this creature.

name: Florian the Fallen – Deserter Knight
description: A vanguard of the Duke’s Army that was initially sent to quell the outbreak. A thousand men were torn apart within an hour of arriving in Canos’ south side, leaving Florian and a handful of survivors who retreated to safety across the Favian River. Though they were welcomed with chains as deserters. Florian and his comrades were then forced into the next wave, with his hand chained to a banner, told that wave he would instil courage in his comrades this time, so they would not waiver, nor retreat again.

name: Footsoldier – Rybeck
description: Rybeck is one of the newest members of Fang Squadron. A spindly man from Formen, boasting a background as a Duskweave Veteran. Naive were his thoughts that mercenary work would be easy compared to his listed deployment in the Formen military against undead. The battles of The Golden Griffins were long and gruelling. Even before the Liturium War began it seemed as though every week his life was on the line against a new threat. When Rybeck was reassigned to Fang Squadron he knew that he was not long for the world, and quickly made peace with the gods. On their first mission they were assigned already Rybeck had seen his death before him.

name: Forgotten Knights – Vine Possessed Armour
description: Armour of the fallen, those perished in the Liturium War. Their flesh and bone lost to time and scavengers.

name: Fortuna – Succubus of the Sixth
description: An infiltrator from the Sixth Reverie of the Abyss. Deceit is her weapon, and she will use it to sow discord.

name: Founders’ Dining Hall – Arcane University Hall
description: The centrepiece and most grand building of the university. On its ground level is the Founders’ Dining Hall, a grandiose place where the students receive their daily dinners and lunches. While attendance to such meals is not mandatory, students are seldom to pass up a meal already paid in their tuition, and the food far surpasses anything they might find elsewhere in the city, brought fresh from the kitchens in the basement.

name: Frederik Vahlen – Professor of Progress
description: Frederik was among those closest to Bastian the Everknowing, and became infected with the same Dragonblight strain that touched his friend. Yet both put their bodies into a form of stasis that would prevent the diseases spread, yet it did not shield their minds. Dissonant whispers filled Frederik’s head from that day onward, and the whispers have never stopped. He knows now that Bastian’s goal was noble, and just, but his methods were foolish. He hopes that he can perhaps continue his late friend’s research, but in a manner that is less devastating to the world.

name: Frederik Vahlen – Professor of Progress (Ascended Form)
description: Frederik, having felt there was no other way, ingested the Dragonblight strain he had altered, hoping to ascend to some sort of divine form similar to Hendrak himself. The risk he took was calculated, but it has not paid off. Instead he is bound in a grotesque form that is constant agony for him, stuck as a passenger in his own mutated body as something else steers it. Now he watches helplessly as he realises the folly of his own ways, and the undoing of his life’s work.

name: Freya the Feared
description: A warrior and leader of the Mayrethi Resistance. Freya and her adoptive brother Nils solely led the people of Steadfort and the surrounding towns and villages in a valiant defense against the invading and much more technologically advanced Raiders of Alimroth. With the Liturium War ended, the Golden Griffins took up a contract to defend the eastern half of Mayreth, giving Freya a chance to travel southwards to the Godless Isle in search of Anshani technology that might give her people an edge to turn the tide of the war.

name: Freya The Fearless
description: A leader in her own right. Freya is often the first to lead the charge, the last to leave in retreat and the first to stand in the way of a bullet to save the life of her comrade. One of the instigators of the guerilla movement within Mayreth, her resolve is stronger than the thickest plates of Alimrothi armour.

name: Froth the Belligerent
description: Hammer-for-hire and dedicated drink buyer. Felix (known always as Froth, who becomes even more belligerent if called by his name) is an elite mercenary of the VVL in Edrador. Arrakana has been his stomping ground since he was a child, and the face of it has changed drastically between Tharadori invasion and infighting between the remaining free cities of the land. Now with an Orc invasion added to the mix, Froth has his work cut out for him, and he’s gonna need a big drink when it’s all over.

name: Froth the Furious
description: Hammer-for-hire and dedicated drink buyer. Felix (known always as Froth, who becomes even more belligerent if called by his name) was an elite mercenary of the VVL in Edrador. During the Siege of Okh, Froth was slain by the Orcs as he fought them in the city streets, dying atop a pile of corpses he had built himself. Now the divine of Edrador send him as their ambassador to Tharador’s Crucible of Champions.

name: Frøya – Maiden of Life
description: The youngest of the Himlingr daughters, Frøya’s domain is life and the forests of Nordheim. Diametrically opposed to her eldest sister, Hel.

name: Fyrantius – Adult Mana Wyrm
description: A powerful male Mana Wyrm born from arcane experiments on Arcane Dragon eggs, wields a mastery over Minera’s Breath, leveling battlefields and striking fear into the hearts of enemies and allies alike. The aggressive creature, shaped by further experimentation, serves the Leacianan military as an invaluable asset, and his raw power and fearsome reputation make him a symbol of their relentless pursuit of victory.

name: Fyrindel – Juvenile Mana Wyrm
description: A young Mana Wyrm under the control of Leacianan forces. The manoeuvrability, speed and agility of Fyrindel and its kin make it a devastating tool of Leacianus in war. There are no natural creatures that can so precisely move in the sky as Fyrindel and other Mana Wyrms do. Therefore even a juvenile one can assure air superiority for Leacianus, and in missions like the assault on the Spetsigs, air presence matters.

name: Fyroth – Ancient Mana Wyrm
description: An ancient Mana Wyrm born from the earliest arcane experiments on Arcane Dragon eggs, wields immense power over Minera’s Breath. A veteran of countless battles, his presence on the battlefield both inspires allies and terrifies enemies. Although wearied by centuries of conflict, Fyroth remains a steadfast servant to the High Elves, and his unyielding loyalty and formidable abilities symbolize their enduring determination to protect their kingdom.

name: Garamoud – Ancient Treant
description: An ancient defender of the forest. As industrialization scoured the most beautiful forests and meadows of Alimroth, Garamoud was forced to retreat to the confines of the druidic circle of Brel Vardra. There he has stewed in vengeance and anger for nigh a century, the fires of man lighting a fire within his own heart. Garamoud however is gentle and loving with those who are friends of the forest, and acts as a wise sage in councils held at the Circle of Vardra.

name: Garamundis – Corrupted Treant Elder
description: An ancient treant of Tryamin whose body and soul were ensnared by the evils of Idinhelieth and Seroca sixty years ago during the Fall of Elen Estel. When all eyes were on the evils of Quorenderi, they were blind to the conjurations of his siblings. Garamundis is now a stalwart foe, being one of the most powerful treants of Tryamin turned to evil.

name: Gardan Mammoth Giant
description: Gardan – a beast of a mini with a 5 part assembly made easy with keys at 32mm plus a 2 part base perfect for dioramas.

name: Garyck of Cinta Mar – Infernal Forest Guardian
description: A Nosmeni of Elven lineage born and raised in the village of Cinta Mar in Nan Thalias’ outlands. Garyck’s infernal mother had escaped the Second Reverie of the Abyss, finding herself among the groves of Nan Thalias. There she was taken in by villagers, marrying and having several children. Garyck was one of them, becoming an outcast for his appearance. He left to the forests when he was young, becoming a devout Druidic follower of the Ten’gwaël.

name: Gatha – Duergar Battlerager Barbarian
description: A Dark Dwarf who escaped the dogmatic Cult of Irinax in Lo Fuin. Gatha has earned a name for herself as an exceptionally cost-effective mercenary with no banners or borders to bind her. Though she has been known to cause collateral damage on several occasions, earning her a slightly sullied reputation in certain townships of Belfrie and Formen, especially in the wake of the Liturium War.

name: Gazza the Arrowproof – Orc Warboss
description: One of the most respected Warbosses in the armies of Berogtor’s Yellow Orcs. Gazza was once a wonderer, living in the harsh arid land of the fallen Anshani Empire. He accrued a sizeable warband in this time, made up of Orcs, Goblins and Bugbears. He earned a name for himself among the wastes, eventually attracting the attention of the high rulers of Khurultai who gave him and his Boiz a place in their society in exchange for their loyalty.

name: Gelatinous Sphere
description: A security measure installed within the depths of the Crescent Casino's vault, a deadly trap for unprepared adventurers.

name: Gelzik Pad-Foot – Black Dragonkin Ranger
description: Master of the wetlands and forests that cover the isle, Gelzik has learnt to stalk them silently, ensuring his prey never hear him coming.

name: Gerhardt the Unwavering – Duke’s Executioner
description: A giant of a man, rumoured to bare Colossal lineage, Gerhardt is a stark sight and a symbol of the Duke’s authority in Canos. Whenever the hulking knight is seen with the Duke, a trail of death is sure to follow. For his status as an executioner is not just for the fanfare of the commoners who wish to witness a beheading, but also as an agent of destruction and retribution. Those who the Duke wishes to be destroyed, but cannot be captured first, are often set upon by Gerhardt who will deal out judgement and death to them and anyone who gets in the way of his goal. Thus is the role of all of the Duke’s Table.

name: Giant Infernal Skull
description: The animated skull of a servant who failed Nosmarka in the recent past. Now their brainless head will be put to better use.

name: Giga Gluglin – Fishfolk Abomination
description: Grunts of the armies of Quorenderi. The Angler Gluglin’s were once fishfolk that lived in the unmapped depths between lands. Quorenderi enslaved their people when he found them, torturing them, twisting them and breeding them to create a new race of hardy creatures that would do his and his officer’s bidding, and could take many blows from a sword before they fell.

name: Gintharax – Adult Silver Dragon
description: An age old friend of the Wandering Mage, Gintharax has agreed to take part in his gauntlet as one of the final challenges, in exchange for his own bargain. Gintharax knows most that face him will fall, but ensures that if they do, they are given a swift rebirth within a better life, or a place in the halls of Syelden.

name: Glanbeli – The First Great Light (Dragon Form)
description: Minera’s first conceived child, though born only months ago. Glanbeli has existed as a celestial body above Minera since time itself began. She was the first great light, before Glanion, the Sun. Before anything else. Like an egg, the Moon held her for millennia, until finally the working of the Drow brought her to hatch and take form on Tharador. Now she has none to raise her. The Tharameni fear her innate and unused power and her siblings are all spent in their own. Confused and alone, she flies through Tharador, trying to return to her home above the clouds and take aid from anyone willing, or unwilling to help her.

name: Glanbeli – The First Great Light (Human Form)
description: Minera’s first conceived child, though born only months ago. Glanbeli has existed as a celestial body above Minera since time itself began. She was the first great light, before Glanion, the Sun. Before anything else. Like an egg, the Moon held her for millennia, until finally the working of the Drow brought her to hatch and take form on Tharador. Now she has none to raise her. The Tharameni fear her innate and unused power and her siblings are all spent in their own. Confused and alone, she flies through Tharador, trying to return to her home above the clouds and take aid from anyone willing, or unwilling to help her.

name: Glancalion – Paladin of the First Flame
description: Paladins of Glancalnos are especially rare in Tharador, for the worship of the First Flame is only done in secretive circles. Glancalion believes its worship should not be so closely guarded, and has thus left upon a mission from his order, seeking to spread the word and light of the First Flame.

name: Glynbel – Priestess of Brinilmin
description: Born on a full moon within the glowing waters of the river Prendael, Glynbel was raised from birth in the love and care of the Brinilmin Church. Those dedicated to worshipping the divine entity of Brinilmin that imbues its magical essences into the waters of Leacianus. Glynbel, now coming of age acts as a Priestess within The Magistrates, continuing her path towards the title of Matriarch she learns under the wisdom of the Blind Seeress, Irivyl as she fulfils her duties to Brinilmin.

name: Gobz of War
description: The Goblins of Gazza’s Gore Boiz. They act mostly as fodder and scouts. Goblins have always sat on the lowest rung of Khuraltai’s hierarchy. The Orcs see the Goblins as pests hanging onto the coattails of their success in founding and upkeeping the marvel that is Khuraltai and the most coherent Orcish society on Minera. Without the Orcs, the Yellow Goblins of Berogtor would likely be living in caves or dugouts beneath the sands. Though the Goblins aren’t incredibly fond of where they do find themselves: sleeping with rats in the lowest tier of the mountain city where light seldom treads. But when fighting emerges, the usually docile and mischievous Goblins become rabid and unhinged; baring little regard for their own lives or safety. It is for this reason the Orcs see them as such exceptional fodder.

name: Golden Griffin Footsoldiers
description: The rank and file soldiers of the Golden Griffins. These make up the bulk of the mercenary company’s manpower. Though many have perished over the course of the Liturium War, there are still many eager to earn coin even if it may cost them their life. These soldiers are mostly used en masse in battlefield engagements and rarely are seen in specialist operations.

name: Golden Griffin Vanguard
description: One of the higher ranks of the Golden Griffins before officer positions. Most who have ascended to Vanguard rank are veterans of the Liturium War who have seen their fair share of action and split plenty of blood. These soldiers are rewarded with custom issue Griffin armour and generally make up the bulk of soldiers in specialist squads both in special operations or on the battlefield.

name: Goragora – Great Orcish War Beast
description: Goragora is one of several ancient Great Beasts that was kept in stasis by the Anshani for research purposes. When the Empire’s populace suddenly vanished, many stayed in their suspended state until they were discovered or awoke. Goragora was found by Gazza in the sands beneath Berogtor, the location of the Anshani Lab that held him memorized by Gazza during his own time living in an Anshani ruin. When the Great Beast awoke, its roar left several of Gazza’s Gore Boiz dead, and deafened many more. But Gazza was not dismayed. Using a shaman, he spoke to the beast and told it all that had happened in its time of sleep, asking it to join him in a pursuit of vengeance against the descendants of those who imprisoned it.

name: Gordrain Stonehand – Dwarven General
description: A stout, stubborn and stonehearted Dwarven general tasked with instilling martial law after the Rapture rendered his city to rubble.

name: Gorozai – Warden of the Sacred Fire
description: One of the few Fire Elemi that took side with the Elemi of Tharador during the Elemi Crusades. Gorozai and his cousin Tuzugo saw the reign of the Fire Clans in Abunen Kolden as tyrannical, and vowed to end them by any means. The crusades brought about such means, and as reward Gorozai and Tuzugo were uplifted through the ranks of Tharador’s Elemi Councils. They came to serve as the guardians of the great Kyubiko, previously entrusted to Water Elemi. Gorozai misses his homeland, but knows the war-ravaged land is now a shell of what it once was.

name: Gorr Spinebreaker – The Rage of the South
description: A half-orc born to a tribe of nomadic Orcs on the run from slavers in Baldur's Drylands.

name: Gorty – War Ram
description: The mount of War Chief Kartol. An exceptional steed able to carry nigh a tonne upon its back, and an anger in its heart. The beast is as ravenous and steadfast as other Alimrothi soldiers, but transports the War Chief wherever he is needed on the battlefield, able to carry his weapon of choice upon it, or even operate his weapon of its own accord through auto targeting connected to the Ram’s own line of sight.

name: Grand Trailblazer – Swifty
description: Despite his ripe age and high rank, Swifty had been with The Golden Griffins only since the start of the Liturium War. Before that he was a smuggler for the Rossa Cartel, managing a very lucrative route between Belfrie and Leacianus. With the two nations he smuggled between at war with each other, his business dried up and it wasn’t before long that the cartel tried to have him bumped off for no longer bringing in revenue to the organisation. Nimble and agile as he was, he was able to evade being cornered within the Cartel’s den in Tradver City. Disposing of his two “garbagemen” himself, he escaped through their den’s latrine and into the city’s canal system. Stowing away within a barrel on the first boat he could find, he sat for days until it docked at the end of the Tradver River within the city of Velandria.

name: Granny Nora – Voyeur Hag
description: An agent of Idinhelieth and Seroca that keeps constant vigilance over the corrupted lands in Tryamin. From her burrow her eyes see all who enter, and the many birdies across the woodland sing and endless cacophony of haunting whispers that reach her ears. There is nought that goes on in the woods without Granny Nora hearing of it.

name: Green Kobolds of Midorius
description: Followers of the Young Dragon Midorius, these Kobolds hail from the Hollow: the cavernous expanse beneath Greypeak. They trace their lineage to being spawns of the young dragon’s own great great grandfather, and thus have pledged loyalty to Midorius and his ancestors since. Though their loyalty to him is undying, Midorius sees them as little more than fodder and useful idiots.

name: Gresnos – The Broken Flame
description: A Selvaneri of Namneri who fell from grace long ago, ultimately rejected his patron's notion of death's inevitability.

name: Gruthdin – Dark Dwarf Pugilist
description: A Dark Dwarf who serves Glanbeli after her divine intervention freed him from his Irinaxi captors.

name: Gundrin Borgsten – The Holy Hunter
description: Holy Dwarves are not paid or given the respect that many of their human or Elven counterparts receive. Gundrin is no exception. Churches and temples receive little in the way of donations from Dwarves, so it becomes difficult to keep a lifestyle when working for them. The Temple of Renmaeth which Gundrin resided in could no longer afford his upkeep, and none others in Dornat Al Karit wanted his services. Thus he found a life in becoming a Hunter in the Ek Viriktar, ensuring a balance was always held in Renmaeth’s creations was a way he felt he could still honour his patron.

name: Gungnir of House Jernbark – Centaur Noble
description: The Head of House Jernbark, Gungnir's House has called Steinved Forest their home for generations.

name: Gunnhildr – Outlander Berserker
description: Living in the outreaches of Nordheim, on the fringes of the dense forest, Gunnhildr has lived among the legends and devils of the forest.

name: Gunthrak Destraz – Half-Orc Vampiric Chef
description: When a group of escaped slaves fled from Baldur to Belfrie for their freedom, Gunthrak was the sole survivor after their vessel was engulfed in a storm.

name: Gwambari – Animal Friend Shaman
description: Hailing from the southern savannah of Sudd Tohst, Gwambari has lived among the lands of the south since his childhood.

name: Gwynevel – First Daughter of Renmaeth
description: An Ancient Fey spirit and guardian of Renmaeth's forests. She can take the form of her choosing in spirit.

name: Gwynevel – Guardian of the Fringe
description: An ancient forest spirit given life by Renmaeth herself. She can take the form of her choosing in spirit. For physically she resides in the Fey World, yet can project her spiritual form into Tharador’s physical plane. There she provides guidance and care to the residents of her forest, given to her by Renmaeth. Though she once shared the forest with her brother Melwyn, it was cut in twain by man, her brother residing in its eastern half, vengeance growing deep in his heart and twisting his form. Though vigilant of men herself, Gwynevel is graceful in her attempts at ridding them, only resorting to violence when all else has failed.

name: Gyokusho – Jade Golem
description: A hardy enforcer and guardian of the Cult, hauled from the reaches of Edrador, an intrepid force of reckoning.

name: Hadrian – The Iron Colossal
description: Referred to as "The Wall", this Soulforged originally hails from Edrador, forged as a weapon of war and now seeking redemption.

name: Hali Brookes – Water Elemi Rogue
description: A Water Elemi woman born and raised in Velandria, Tradver’s sister city to its south. Once the manager of a shady tavern and inn, Hali was forced out of her home and workplace after it was aggressively acquiesced by the Dusty Dirks in a territorial feud with the Rossa Cartel. In the scuffle, Hali watched several of her friends lose more than their jobs. Now she aims to enact vengeance against the Dirks, placing herself in Tradver after hearing whispers of the gang having ties to the city’s duke.

name: Hali Brookes – Water Elemi Swashbuckler Rogue
description: A Water Elemi woman born and raised in Velandria, Tradver’s sister city to its south. Once the manager of a shady tavern and inn, Hali was forced out of her home and workplace after it was aggressively acquiesced by the Dusty Dirks in a territorial feud with the Rossa Cartel. In the scuffle, Hali watched several of her friends lose more than their jobs. In vengeance she pursued the Dirks to Tradver, where she fell in with a group investigating the gangs attacks on convoys outside the city. The trail led her to discover that the Duke of Tradver himself was behind the attacks, and her target shifted to him, earning her a reputation as a hero across Belfrie, her days as a criminal outlaw dwindling behind her.

name: Halls of Khandara
description: An ancient fortress that was used as the centre of advances in genetic research during the Oldavor Empire’s height. Initially constructed as a prison where the empire’s most valuable prisoners of war were interred, its purpose changed as the Colossals came to realise there would be little negotiating with the Men they warred against.

name: Hand of Seroca – Dark Cult Leader
description: The leader of the Serocan Cult, his name long forgotten, as is his own identity. His memories and secrets were the price paid to lead Seroca’s worshippers to glory, and now the price seems trivial. What he has gained in the service of Seroca far outweighs any memories he may have of childhood, of love, of family and friendship. Such concepts themselves are foreign to the Hand. His goals are Seroca’s goals, and he will gladly pay with his life to fulfill them.

name: Hannes Vyrios – Noble Barbarian
description: Noble are the Minotaurs of Myitelnari, though their existence is kept as a secret to most. Hannes is one such noble, son of a Duke. The Minotaurs rule their people in secret, and though they are worshipped in most ceremonies of their homeland, Minotaurs are mostly thought of as mythical creatures or evil beings that prowl the depths of labyrinths and caverns, moreso than the shrewd diplomats and rulers that they truly are.

name: Harias of the Borderlands – Elven Fighter
description: Hailing from a small Nan Thalian village nestled against the Syndi Duin, Harias has spent his life in war against the ever-encroaching Men of Baldur. Over centuries he has seen endless bloodshed in the forests of the Fringe, yet now is tasked not to make war, but peace. With a small contingent, he travels into the heart of the land of Men, where they might broker peace with the various logging conglomerates that are responsible for the incessant deforestation that devastates his homeland.

name: Harmara “Dances With Blood”
description: One of the few Colossals on Tharador not to be born in the bitter Frozen Wastes of Oldavor. Harmara is also one of the few hemomancers to exist out the bounds of Oldavor, the practice of blood magic being forbidden alongside necromancy in almost all kingdoms of Tharador. Still, it has served the University of Ardris well over the years, who keeps the source of her magics a secret from Belfrie’s crown.

name: Harvold “Blue Eyes” Stalson – Soulforged Swashbuckler
description: Whatever life, memories or secrets Blue Eyes held in his previous memories matters little to him.

name: Hel – Maiden of Death
description: The eldest daughter of the Himlingr family. Hel is the matriarch and leader of her family after the sudden disappearance of their father.

name: Hendrak – Ascended God-Lich Flayer
description: Known as Henrique in his mortal life, one of the founders of the Psithars, now walking the darkest path to return to Terra.

name: Henry Dannis – Psionic Prodigy
description: A young artificer who discovered a dark secret about his own self during the time of the ceasefire in the Liturium War. Though still technically part of the Golden Griffins, Henry was bound by honour and his half-brother Serran to return to the war as it drew to it’s end, rather than seek out the answers that have long eluded him.

name: Henry the Punished Immortal
description: After the Liturium War, Henry, haunted by his past and driven by the revelation of being a clone, embarked on a journey to Oldavor to confront his maker Henrique and merge their souls for completeness. In Oldavor’s eternal winter, Henry faced Henrique, who had revealed his life-long manipulations of Henry designed to strengthen his soul for a ritual that would combine their psionic powers. Despite Henry’s efforts to escape, Henrique initiated the ritual, merging their beings, with Henrique assuming control over their unified form. However, a violet void transported Henrique to a Crucible under the Tharameni, where Tharanais, the Prince of Wisdom, offered him a chance for redemption or eternal damnation based on his loyalty.

name: Hera – Blood Rogue
description: An outlaw who has been on the run for her forbidden arts and grand larceny for years. With a bounty on her head in every kingdom, she settled in Draksborne, owing to the fact they have had much more severe problems to deal with in the wake of Dragonblight, than chasing after petty bounties. Yet, fate would deal an ironic twist to Hera, as now Dragonblight surrounds her, trapping her in the village of Limlight under quarantine as a new outbreak threatens the already crippled kingdom.

name: Heron of Daronai
description: A Nosmeni born beyond the bounds of the Reveries of the Nocturnal Abyss, bound to it all the same by a lust for power and beauty.

name: Higashi no Shikame – Eastern Dragon Turtle
description: Dragon Turtles in the Shallow Sea are far removed from their cousins found in western and southern waters. This breed of Dragon Turtle has a distinctly different look and a much more tranquil demeanour. They are known colloquially as “Eastern Sea Dragons” and this is what they have also been called by foreigners as well.

name: High Elf Soldiers – Leacianan Vanguard
description: The Vanguard of Leacianus’ military is mostly made up of those who have evoked the ire of some upstanding member of Leacianan society, or simply hail from lowborn families. Still, although they are considered the most disposable of Leacianus’ military, it does not mean they are essentially seen as worthless. The Nirloom ensures that all his troops are armed to the teeth when they clash with his enemies on the frontlines.

name: High Inquisitor Lorthren – Veteran Mage Hunter
description: Defined by his stoic attitude and disdain towards magic users of any kind, Lorthren has spent his life tracking wild mages.

name: Hilda Bjornstain – Mother Bear
description: A Werebear from birth who has never known the comforts of civilization. Hilda is fiercely territorial and often finds herself amidst feuds with neighbouring Werewolf and Werebear clans. She is the wife of Orik Bjornstain, and together the two reside in relative peace in a cottage with two children north of Havenmond.

name: Hilda Bjornstain – Mother Bear (Werebear Form)
description: A Werebear from birth who has never known the comforts of civilization. Hilda is fiercely territorial and often finds herself amidst feuds with neighbouring Werewolf and Werebear clans. She is the wife of Orik Bjornstain, and together the two reside in relative peace in a cottage with two children north of Havenmond.

name: Hippogriff Rider Rolen
description: With Ash of Goltia far gone from the Golden Griffins, a new rider and face was needed to bring awe into the hearts of its soldiers. It came as a great irony that the one chosen was none other than Rolen of Hinatal, a man who once swore an oath of vengeance to slay Ash for what evils he had enacted in their homeland of Hinatal.

name: Hitalia – Paladin of Glanion
description: A servant of Glanion who has battled much evil in the years since Hinatal rose from beneath the desert sands. She is considered an elite servant of the Great Sun Glanion, and has thus been tasked by her Church to seek out the apparent interlopers near the city’s borders, and attempt to drive them away. Yet she now finds herself bound to their cause, for the common enemy they share.

name: Hoover Brightfeather – Student of Evocation
description: The unintended adoptive son of a Draksbornian mage, Hoover was found to have a strong bond with Minera’s Breath from a young age. Though his father tutored him as best as he could, he ultimately decided that Hoover’s future would best be decided on his own terms, at the University of Canos, as his was as well. Hoover, hoping to follow in his father’s footsteps as a wiseman of the Arcane

name: Horace of the Far Sphere – Owlkin Ranger
description: An entity of old, Horace has been a Sentinel of the Planes for centuries. The Web of Worlds was his domain to guard.

name: Horakthar – Dragon Commander (3 Poses)
description: Death is swift to those who defy or cross the Dragon Commander of the Hollow. Innumerable are the corpses left in his wake, smouldering in the fires of his forebears, the dragons of the Hollow. Horakthar is their champion, commander of their armies and knights. Atop their backs he rides into battle, thrown into the midst of their enemies in a trail of fire and glory. Few have witnessed it and lived.

name: Horauthin – Father of War & Peace
description: Known by many as the Harbinger of War, Horauthin has truly earned such a moniker, though Peace is also his domain.

name: Horauthin – Harbinger of War & Peace
description: In a world in strife Horauthin and his brother Erdrydion were given life, side by side. Mindoriel and Myrothlir wreaked havoc upon Tharador, raising legions of undead across the land, led by their vampiric commanders the Felanhier and their leader Almenhier. Horauthin and Erdrydion together slew Almenhier in a decisive battle, stifling the growth led by the expert commander. Horauthin would later split part of his own soul to create the Velgaryn, the first Goliaths. They would turn the tide of the war as a war-like race with a minute life-span compared to the elves. Though after Mindoriel was defeated this war-like nature instilled in them proved maleficent as they began a genocidal conquest across Tharador. Horauthin was banished for the sins of his children, only forgiven when they were utterly defeated by their own undoing and Horauthin repented.

name: Horzin Ashen-Palm – Black Dragonkin Druid
description: Horzin has dwelt in the depths of the Tar Pool Swamps for decades, still remembering the time when Sovram ruled from atop Dragonmaw.

name: Hrimyhyrnir – Frost Horned Beast
description: A gargantuan creature that prowls the foothills and mountains on the northern edge of Nordheim, between forest and mountain.

name: Hu Shen – Commander From the East
description: The commander of the Unseen Wardens' expedition to Tharador, able to recall some of the continent's customs and languages from centuries ago.

name: Hudin the Summer Breeze
description: An Air Elemi native to the town of Elhalad, who has watched in horror as his town was torched by the Fire Elemi invaders.

name: Humans & Elves
description: Humans & Elves is a character first and a miniature second — built with a clear sense of who they are and what they've done. The loyalty-rewards detailing gives them a distinct silhouette that holds up in a crowd of other figures.

name: Hunter’s Respite – Mountaintop Encampment
description: A WEHL encampment that boasts formidable defenses against the wilds of Tharador. This campsite formation is a standard sight among larger WEHL squads.

name: Hvitabjörn – Druid of the White Tundra
description: A druid inflicted with a curse of Arctanthropy, the curse of the Werebear. Whilst it ostracized him from his place among his druidic circle.

name: Hyan – Blink Hound
description: Through years of selective breeding and arcane infusions the seers of Leacianus were able to create a breed of dog that can tap into Minera’s Breath in similar ways to themselves. Though their ability is rudimentary it gives them a competitive edge over most wildlife and the hounds act as superior hunting companions and provide effective mobility in battle to overrun enemy positions when unleashed by the dozens. Hyan is one such Blink Hound, though an older breed he was made stronger than the new pups that brave the front lines of war.

name: Hyatiri – Flying Serpent
description: Serpent-like creatures with a gliding ability that hunt from the tree tops of Godless Isle’s jungle. Hyatiri are monstrous beasts with monstrous appetites. Few have been studied by taxologists in person, usually due to their escape artists nature and the fact that few are able to actually slay such a beast. It is thought that they can store up to five men in their stomachs at once to save for later before beginning digestion. Some prey such as smaller animals or halflings are often swallowed whole, though the Orcs native to Godless Isle have stories of folk heroes cutting their way out of the stomachs of the beasts.

name: Hyl Hygrie – Hill Harpies
description: Hill Harpies native to the mountains and foothills of the Great Havel Range. More disorganised than their southern cousins, the Hill Harpies of Brightstone usually attack indiscriminately with little regard for self preservation, making them a menace to most travellers in Brightstone’s north, particularly caravans en route to the Watchers at Oldavor’s borders.

name: Hyl Reiser- Hill Giant
description: Hill Giants are relics of the Oldavori Empire that have enjoyed their freedom from their oppressors in a relatively rustic lifestyle, keeping to hillocks and clearings in the forests upon the hillsides of the Great Havel Range. They have little care for the musings of Men, but sometimes might see a lost traveller as an easy meal, often invoking the wrath of townsfolk and a contract sent to the Hex Hunters for a Giant’s head.

name: Hyol Droll – Cave Troll
description: Trolls that spend most their life in the caves throughout the landscape of Brightstone and Greypeak, Cave Trolls are a common term, though Hyol Droll refers specifically to the subspecies local to northern Tharador. Hyol Droll’s are more aggressive and much less reasonable than their cousins found in Tharador’s central lands. Because of this Hex Hunters approach these creatures with a “Attack on Sight” mentality.

name: Ice Heart – Colossal Barbarian Sorcerer
description: A Colossal born and raised far from her ancestral homeland of Oldavor. Ice Heart once took contracts for the World Explorers and Hunters League, though finding they seldom scratched her itch for battle. More often than not their weeks of trekking would result in a pitiful fight against a beast at best, or nothing at worst. Now she is able to hone both her arcane and martial skills together in the crucible, becoming a well-loved fighter amongst its patrons.

name: Idinhelieth – Harbinger of Pestilence
description: Fourth of Mindoriel’s Spawn. Idinhelieth was not known to the Tharameni for some time as his part in the Sibling War was mostly covert. It was thought that the disease and emptiness that gripped the land was the work of Myrothlir and his unholy abominations, when in truth Idinhelieth had been concocting his own means to dwindle the numbers of Tharador’s mortals. Sickness, starvation and suffering were his means to such an end, leaving the lands barren and wasted.

name: Ignacio Reyes – Hexhunter of the Sea
description: Born in Sudd Tohst, raised in Brightstone and inducted into the Hexhunters after a childhood of rigorous and bloody training.

name: Ilisyia of the Tower Dunes – Desert Priestess
description: A nomadic Sun Elf priestess who has wandered the desert guided by the will of Glanion for decades. While relatively young by Elven standards, Ilisyia’s wisdom is built upon generations of wise women bound to Glanion’s service, like herself. Her mother and mother’s before them were the matriarchs of the freefolk tribes, those who under Glanion’s guidance ensured their people’s legacy during the trying times of Sudd Tohst’s desertification.

name: Illirian of the Lost Fleet – Spellsword Artificer
description: Sent on an expedition by the WEHL to the uncharted Godless Isle far from Tharador’s coast, Illirian was the sole survivor to return from the lost fleet.

name: Illyria Spineshatter – Half-Dragon Barbarian
description: The companion of Styrax, Illyria found her condition mirrored in the sorcerer in a chance encounter.

name: Ilnia Vasrith – Paladin of the Moon’s Sanctum
description: A Paladin of Glanbeli whose faith is wavering; beset on a pilgrimage alongside a nomadic clan of her people.

name: Ilvias the Reaper – Silver Dragonkin Warlock
description: Once a practitioner of the arcane, Ilvias found himself bound to an eldritch pact to service his master's betrayal of Sovram.

name: Ilvos Drak’thin – Drow Lunar Sorcerer
description: A powerful Drow sorcerer whose soul is tied to Glanbeli herself, his magic waxing and waning with the phases of the moon.

name: Indelian Katarin – Ocean Soul Sorcerer
description: Raised in the remote isles of the Katarn Sea, Indelian left his homeland only a few years ago, his home destroyed by colonial raiders.

name: Indua’ne Viverik – Drow Ranger
description: A Glanbelite Drow and one of Kadna Glydrin’s many disciples. His current quest takes him beyond the secretive confines of Lo Fuin, to the land of Belfrie. There he is tasked to learn as much as he can of the supposed anti-magic material Liturium, and attempt to secure some for his people’s quest against the Irinaxi Drow that are quickly becoming a potent threat.

name: Indua'ne Viverik – Ranger of the Reaches
description: A Glanbelite Drow tasked with escorting freed Dark Dwarves to the city of Delvdor, navigating a razor-thin diplomatic line.

name: Inedra-Ki – The Wave Breaker
description: An ex-soldier and a deserter from her home nation of East Hydana in the far land of Zandorion. Inedra-Ki uses the training she received in the East Hydanian army to make herself a force of reckoning in battle. Even the strongest waves crash upon her armour as though she were a mountain in her steadfast stance. But in the sea itself is where she truly excels and woe to any foe of hers that might meet her there.

name: Ingeniør – Frida Lars
description: A jarl’s daughter that took more fascination with the inner workings of machines than blades. Forgoing the lessons of blade and shield that were uniform for noble children such as herself, she now is one of the more renowned engineers in the Alimrothi fleet.

name: Invoker – Dorian
description: A gifted sorcerer haunted by other-worldly nightmares every night. Dorian left his homeland of Baldur where magic is nigh outlawed and set out to make a name for himself by joining a Mercenary company.

name: Irinax’s Chosen – Drow Soldiers
description: What is life without meaning? What is death without purpose? For Irinax’s Chosen, both of these questions are answered in their service to the Broodmother. Their life as at her beck and call, and their death marks them as martyrs, or fuel and sustenance for future generations of her spawn. But their undying, fervent love of Irinax does not make them weak, as their zealotry makes them deadly, calculating and cunning foes.

name: Irinia – Drow Spidermancer
description: A devout follower of Irinax who has chosen to worship her through immersion, having left the shackles of civilization to live within the dens of her Broodmother. Here Irinia has gathered love and admiration from the Cult of Irinax, and she has became and oracle or prophet of sorts to its members, many who travel treacherous paths to seek her guidance, seeing her as pure manifestation of Irinax.

name: Irivyl –  Awakened Seeress of Brinilmin
description: Born blind to noble parents, Irivyl was kept cloistered for many of her earliest days. When she drowned within the Prendael River as a child, she awoke with sight blessed through magic, a miracle. Though her sight was not that of any regular elves, she could see Breath and any beings it coursed through. Magical items, any living creatures and magical spells became her vision. With this she became a wonder within noble courts, able to instantly discern the properties of magical artifacts and even uncover truths buried deep within the minds of prisoners without speaking a word to them. Such powers were unparalleled, and she had her own role made within The Magistrates to accommodate her powers in aiding the Triumvirate. Though in her time she aided outsiders in a matter she saw that was greater than the Liturium War, and for this Valius Hanar had her eyes sliced out. Now she plots against her rulers, waiting to strike when the time is right.

name: Irivyl – The Blind Seeress
description: Born blind to noble parents, Irivyl was kept cloistered for many of her earliest days. When she drowned within the Prendael River as a child, she awoke with sight blessed through magic, a miracle. Though her sight was not that of any regular elves, she could see Breath and any beings it coursed through. Magical items, any living creatures and magical spells became her vision. With this she became a wonder within noble courts, able to instantly discern the properties of magical artifacts and even uncover truths buried deep within the minds of prisoners without speaking a word to them. Such powers were unparalleled, and she had her own role made within The Magistrates to accommodate her powers in aiding the Triumvirate. Now she aids them directly in the war efforts, yet also is an oracle to some, a truthseer to others and a tutor to many.

name: Istar the Redeemer – Nosmeni Divine Soul Sorcerer
description: A Nosmeni of peculiar heritage, bound by ancestry both divine and devilish, awoken to his heritage after facing death.

name: Ivy Dupré – Student of Enchantment
description: Nosmeni are rare in Draksborne, seen usually as an ill omen or scourge of the times. In the wake of Dragonblight, such superstitions are even more cemented. Ivy has dealt with such matters her entire life, however, and her astute knowledge has earned her a scholarship at the University of Canos, whilst her dry and playful personality has earned her the popularity of her peers.

name: Izumi Akaneko – Unseen Feline
description: Usually mistaken as a courtier for her unassuming dress, Izumi often uses this to her advantage. Seldom is she expected to be as deadly as she is, and that underestimation is often the downfall of her foes, at least those who get a chance to meet her before the find a blade in their throat.

name: Jacquie Sparkes – The Eccentric Electric
description: One of the most brilliant minds of the separatist artificers and Lumens' right hand.

name: Jarls Wrath – Ymir Tresarg
description: A common footsoldier of The Ørnevinger, though with eyes clouded by hatred and an endless want for rebellion. He bides his time for the perfect chance to find a life of relative normalcy, never knowing when that day may comes.

name: Jeanne du Lac – Knight of Justice
description: A devout exactor of Erdrydion’s Justice, Jeanne is one of the most respected members of her order in her homeland of Greypeak. Despite her age, she has led many conquests against the dark forces of Mindoriel that pervade her homeland. She was among the first to storm the walls of Strassen, at the age of only nineteen. Four years later she would lead her own army into the halls of Castle Beaufax, eviscerating the vampiric menace that had bred there. Now she is one of the commanders leading the Church of the Tharameni into Sudd Tohst, commanding admiration and respect from all who follow her.

name: Jeanne du Lac – Maiden of Justice
description: A devout exactor of Erdrydion’s Justice, Jeanne is one of the most respected members of her order in her homeland of Greypeak. Despite her age, she has led many conquests against the dark forces of Mindoriel that pervade her homeland. She was among the first to storm the walls of Strassen, at the age of only nineteen. Four years later she would lead her own army into the halls of Castle Beaufax, eviscerating the vampiric menace that had bred there. Now she is one of the commanders leading the Church of the Tharameni into Sudd Tohst, commanding admiration and respect from all who follow her.

name: Jeji – The Free Born
description: A Tabaxi born and raised in Belfrie, Jeji is one of the few Tabaxi on Tharador who was actually born there. Raised in the Elven City of Aluvitar, she combined her cat-like instincts in the trees with expert training provided by her peers as she grew up. The forest surrounding Aluvitar became her home, and seldom did she visit any cities thereafter, and never were they joyous visits when she did.

name: Jeremus of Jochenia – Hammer of Horauthin
description: Anointed in the fires of the Liturium War, Jeremus entered the conflict as but a disciple of the Divine of War and Peace, and emerged as a holy weapon. After crushing the skulls of the heretical High Elven worshippers of Brinilmin, the Church of the Tharameni sought him out. Seeing his fervent desire to quell heresy, they knew he would become an instrumental weapon.

name: Jesmira the Jaded – Feywalker Ranger
description: A Feywalker whose life has been eschewed from joy for decades. In the fall of Elen Estel, Jesmira was the sole survivor of her family.

name: Jin Shi – Serpentfolk Commander
description: The commander of the Cult of the Coiled Serpent's armed forces, having seen many defeats in Edrador previously.

name: Johanna Saffron the Pious – Maiden Knight
description: One of the twin daughters of His Excellency High Bishop Madrigal, Speaker of Erdrydion. Johanna’s life, like her twin sister’s, has been spent entirely in service to Erdrydion. As a student of both blade and book coupled with her fervent and tenacious nature had her quickly rise through the ranks of Erdrydion’s Church despite her young age. Ultimately this culminated with her recruitment by the Duke of Canos, taking her as his personal Paladin of Erdrydion and requesting her father anoint her as a Judge of Erdrydion.

name: Johanna Saffron the Scorned – Vengeance Paladin
description: One of the twin daughters of His Excellency High Bishop Madrigal, Speaker of Erdrydion. Johanna's life has been spent entirely in service to Erdrydion.

name: Jonah of the Badlands – Satyr Mercenary
description: A Satyr banished from the Fey, doomed to wander the planes of Minera. A cutthroat sellsword who charges top coin for his services, mostly within the badlands of Sudd Tohst.

name: Jonas the Trick – Illusionist Wizard
description: A wizard with an ego as big as his staff, often employed in the Casino to favour the house's odds during big bets.

name: Jorjie of Hvirna – Veteran Fighter
description: A shieldmaiden of Formen who saw action during the latter-half of the Liturium War, fighting in the Siege of Nirloom.

name: Jotun – Mark VI SPW Mech
description: The sixth edition in a long line of multi-purpose steam-mechs. The Jotun is an industrial-strength mech purposed in many aspects of Alimrothi life. With removable attachments it is capable of being an asset in warehousing, transport, manufacturing, agriculture, forestry and even warfare. This particular edition is the SPW, standing for Steam-Powered-Warfare, indicating its power source (steam) and its purpose (warfare). It sits sister to the CPF mechs, which are the Coal-Powered-Forestry mechs, able to constantly be topped up with coals by other workers in the woods. The Jotun is the benchmark of Alimrothi progress and hailed by many as a sign of the times and the vision of Alimroth’s future.

name: Jugak’thar Tribe – Orc Tribals
description: A Tribe of Orcs that has spent many generations on Godless Isle. Descended from the Tharadori Orcs of Ukrondia, these are thought to be waylays, a tribe that somehow became lost at sea and settled on the rogue island, rather than joining their kin in Edrador. These orcs are more savage, brutal and tribal than either of their continental counterparts, and actually fit into the stereotype of orcs held by most commoners in Tharador.

name: Juri the Lightdancer – Sun Sorcereress
description: Among the devout of Glanion, there are those who pay tribute to the Great Sun in the form of intricate dances, some of which last from dawn until dusk. Juri is one such Lightdancer, a powerful sorceress whose magic is harnessed with sunlight, rhythm and movement. The Hinatali hold great respect for the Lightdancers, who see them as heralds of fertility and bountiful harvests.

name: Kadna Glydrin – Glanbeli’s Chosen
description: The High Priestess of Glanbeli. After the events of the Falling Moon, Kadna has been chosen as her goddesses champion upon Tharador. With her newfound power, she aims to bring the Glanbelian Drow to the surface, repopulating and purifying the foetid swamps of Lo Fuin, If the Drow who’ve sworn fealty to Irinax hinder her, she will be be happy to turn them into food for the spiders they so dearly worship.

name: Kadna Glydrin – High Priestess of the Moon
description: Kadna was born to a wealthy and powerful family in the underground city of Hirika. She was raised to be strong and independent, as all Drow noblewomen are raised, and she quickly rose to power within the city’s ruling council. Many nobles of Hirika have long wished for a return to the surface, against the rule of the Crown in Iriksha and Kadna is one of them, using her power of the moon to bless many and restore safety to many places on the surface. Kadna however is quick to judge and sentence those who might bring harm to her people and their way of life, and often employs her powers to silence dissenters that oppose her and the nobles dreams of a surface world. Kadna’s power and influence have only grown in recent years, and she is now one of the most respected and feared leaders in Hirika, hoping to one day spread that power across all the lands above in Lo Fuin.

name: Kael the Forlorn Soul – Dark Pact Warlock
description: Whipsers from his patron drove Kael to the next sight of bloodshed. A place where its thirst for death might be sated. Whilst Kael wears the guise of one there to bring aid to the village of Limlight, it is his hope that every inhabitant of the village meets a gruesome end, if only to satisfy his patron and further empower himself. He will do his best to ensure such things come to fruition.

name: Kahlia Birdsong – Druid of the Canopy
description: A Farlander Elf who lived among the canopies of Nan Thalias’ far north. She has left the sanctuary of her closely-guarded kin to pursue life beyond her cloistered home, much to their dismay. She is quickly becoming in awe of the world beyond, but also more appreciative of her own home, hoping that she can live to see the day to return, and that they will accept her when she does.

name: Kaiar the Omniscient – Psionic Knight
description: An agent of the Psithars sent to Lo Fuin after they detected a rift open in the depths beneath the swamps.

name: Kaoru Okami – Stoic Wolf
description: The strong silent type of the Spirit Samurai. Kaoru is often thought of as the defacto leader of the group, despite being one of the youngest and much to the annoyance of Saburo. Despite his young age, his combat prowess is unrivalled and his decision making unquestioned by his companions. Those who have walked away from a fight with the Wolf have only done so because he has let them.

name: Kara’Ta – The Catfolk Corsair
description: Previously known as the Feline Fighter in his last life, Kara’Ta has redubbed himself the Catfolk Corsair in his new identity as a mercenary sailing over the seas of Tharador. Though he is far from his old life in silken beds with new maidens every night, he prefers not having the looming threat of his master executing him at any time, and the freedom to do as he pleases.

name: Karena – The Airborne Psionic
description: An Air Elemi hailing from the exotic Elemi land of Abunos, found by the Psithars only a few years ago amidst much contention.

name: Karina Remar – The Lost Queen
description: A mysterious Tiefling from lands unknown. Far East, West or South, none know. Yet her tongue is exotic as like her dress, weapons and jewels. Claiming to come from an ancient line of royalty long since ended. Karina is unaging, claiming to have been born in the early days of the Second Era. She hunts in Tharador for in her homeland she is hunted herself, she claims this helps her understand her own pursuers better and how to counter them.

name: Karisia of Timberly – Half-Elf Hexblade
description: A half-elf sellsword from Belfrie, though the sword she sells is imbued with a power unlike any other. Karisia is well regarded among mercenary circles, though has always worked as a freelancer, never signing her name to a particular company, in turn creating more demand for her. Now her reputation has earned her a summons to Hinatal to act as a bodyguard for a wealthy merchant, but his disappearance has put her in a scenario where she must play detective to find him, and her pay.

name: Karthis – Spear of the Crimson Sands
description: Hailing from a long line of Baldurian military officers, Karthis was poised to follow in the footsteps of his forefathers.

name: Karthys of Zezima – Dragon Culist
description: A self-proclaimed “father of dragons.” The delusions of grandeur that this zealous cultist espouse make him seem like a force not to be trifled with, or a raving lunatic, or both. Though at times he can make himself appear cognisant and sane, even charismatic, as he lulls folk into a false sense of security.

name: Kartol – War Chief
description: War Chief is an ancient and argued to be dated title in modern Alimroth society, yet it still bestows a great responsibility and honour upon those who carry it. Kartol is one of few War Chief’s, having command of all military forces in East Alimroth. This encompasses everything from the smallest grunt to the greatest Airships. Kartol is not just a military genius either, his body and armour are hulking and many of his subordinates have watched him crush the skulls of his enemies with only his bare hands. Truly a remarkable soldier and commander who has earned the love and adoration of all his men.

name: Kartol & Gorty
description: The War Chief and his War Ram, Gorty. Kartol is one of few War Chief’s, having command of all military forces in East Alimroth. This encompasses everything from the smallest grunt to the greatest Airships. Kartol is not just a military genius either, his body and armour are hulking and many of his subordinates have watched him crush the skulls of his enemies with only his bare hands. Gorty, the mount of War Chief Kartol is an exceptional steed able to carry nigh a tonne upon its back, and an anger in its heart.

name: Karydian – High Elf Chaos Sorcerer
description: A sorcerer who saw his death in the Liturium War. His soul vanished into oblivion after, yet his latest memories after his death were being thrown into a Crucible of the Gods, alongside his kinsman, Netros. Both were sent forth by Brinilmin as interlopers into the Crucible, though the Tharameni have seen the mischievous work of their estranged brother as a welcome addition to their crucible.

name: Karydian – Master Sorcerer
description: The staple sorcerer of Cyrindeth’s squad. Karydian does not have much love for his empathetic leader. In Leacianus’ schools of sorcery there is little room for empathy, only ascendance. Karydian has done his best to ascend, but still there are scores of better sorcerers than he. He feels his rank as master is only ceremonious, and won’t rest until he has earned it on the battlefield.

name: Katrin Veldius – Travelling Assassin
description: Confused looks often meet Katrin when she introduces herself as a diplomat of Draksborne. Inhuman types are often segregated in Draksborne, yet Katrin is dressed well in noble garb, speaks well and comes off as well learned. Those that are foolish enough to face her in combat or challenge her are often quick to regret their actions, as she is swift as wind with her razor claws and can take down several soldiers on her own, looking as though a vicious beast has mauled them to death after. Her appearance leaves little failure in describing her, so as an assassin she must always ensure no witnesses are left behind. As she knocks off targets of the Darkwing one by one on the roads and in the wilderness of Tharador, she sates her bloodlust while furthering Draksborne’s goals.

name: Kavaramon – Arch Devil of the Sixth Reverie
description: Ruler of the Sixth Reverie of the Nocturnal Abyss. Kavaramon is known as the Devil of Deceit, he is the Arch Devil of the Sixth Reverie of Treachery. He is said to be the father of all lies, and his rule in the realm was built upon treachery and betrayal. Now he seeks to sow discord in the lands of Tharador, a vengeance he seeks in retribution of Nosmarka, the mother of all evils.

name: Kazuhira Orochi – Peaceful Serpent
description: Cool, calm and collected is the demeanour of Kazuhira, always known as the level headed and laid back guy among his peers. Though from the comes an aura of mystery, for the Serpent is secretive, keeping his past vague and hidden whereas those around him are open about the traumatic events that led to their places in the Seirei no Samurai

name: Kelathar – The Immortal Lich
description: Darkest and most known of liches within Tharador. Single handedly he brought Baldur’s Liturium production to its knees by enshrouding the one isle that the rare metal was found in a thick and cursed fog. Growing his army overtime with Baldur’s failed attempts at reclamation, he was himself slain by the great Paladin Yinsylim and his companions in The Battle of Duskweave seven years prior. With the help of his servant Morian Fairhair, he is now revived and enshrouds Duskweave once more in his miasmatic fog of undeath.

name: Kenshi Kitsune – Foul Mouthed Fox
description: The son of a priest, Kenshi’s disposition as arrogant and foul mouthed is certainly a surprise to most who first meet him.Though his heart is warm and kind, he often makes a point of his talents and skills, using some very colourful language to do so. His abrupt and uncouth way of talking often lands him in trouble, but despite that he has made no attempts to course correct, believing his coarseness is part of his charm.

name: Kharmir “Lorehand” Kilrak – The Chronicler
description: Freed from the bonds of Irinaxi slavery by Kadna’s agents, Kharmir has taken up service to his liberator, alongside many of his Ashen Dwarf kin. Though with him he takes a great tome, the Book of Ash, in which he chronicles the living history of himself and his kin. His hope is that many of the chapters in the book will involve public executions of Irinaxi Drow.

name: Kigari Solheart – Paladin of the Great Sun
description: A Lionfolk bound to the service of Glanion, who found a place in the halls of Syelden after his death in defending the city of Hinatal from the forces of Mindoriel several years prior. Now he is given another chance to prove his valour against the invaders, hoping that in doing so he may earn a place among the Selvaneri, ascending to more than a mere warrior.

name: Kijaa Shadowblade – Black Dragonkin Rogue
description: Raised not among the Darkscales, Kijaa was brought up by a cloistered sect of vicious killers whose influence stretches far beyond the swamps of the isle.

name: Kilda Swordreign – Cleric of Battle
description: A Cleric of Battle, devout to the divine of war and peace, Horauthin, sent from Varekan to aid peacekeeping in Delvdor.

name: Kilgoola – Orcish Dragon Turtle
description: Dragon Turtles certainly aren’t a common sight in the sandy dunes of Berogtor. Kilgoola was born near the inland Orange Sea that sits on the barren land’s south. It’s first moments were in captivity, part of an experimental animal taming program purported by the Yellow Orcs. Still, it received better treatment than most beasts in captivity on Minera, and now acts as a war beast for Bruz the Basher.

name: Kilroy of Voksnja – Earth Elemi Dwarf Cleric
description: A Dwarf Earth Elemi raised far from either of his ancestral homes. Kilroy has forged an identity of his own.

name: King Hjolmir II – King of Formen
description: The King of Formen and the man who declared war against the High Elves of Leacianus after they assassinated his father and framed Belfrian messengers as his murderers. Hjolmir has been itching to place the skulls of the Leacianan Triarchy on his throne, and now he may finally get his chance: justice and vengeance will be dealt in Nirloom this day, Hjolmir is sure of it.

name: King Trendium – King of Belfrie
description: King of Belfrie and a just, but stern king. Trendium ascended to the throne two years before the start of the Liturium War when his father King Silus passed from natural causes. Now he has earned a name as a skilled warrior and tactician for almost his entire reign has been fraught with war, moreso than any of his ancestors since the days of Jochen Belfrie.

name: Kira Solseth – Rogue of the Arcane
description: A dropout from the University of Ardris who took her arcane talents to a life of crime. But with the current state of Belfrie’s Criminal underworld, she prefers her odds in an arena of sand and blood than waiting for a knife to find her back in the streets. It’s given her time to add some flair to her fighting, and should she return to her life of crime, she knows she will be a force of reckoning.

name: Kitarlia of Tenger – Incarnation of Maethromin
description: A bold girl infused with a power well beyond her understanding. Kitarlia is the Avatar of Maethromin, the aspect and champion of the Divine of the Elements. Unlike most Elemi, Kitarlia is able to handle the aspects of all four elements, changing her powers and physique to fit each element. Though she hails from the lands of the Water Elemi and considers them her people, she is revered and loved among all Elemi. As part of her training she has been tasked to watch over Sukurin, the deadly Kraken of the Depths.

name: Kitarlia the Ascended Incarnate
description: A bold young Elemi woman with a power she is only barely beginning to grasp, the Incarnation of Maethromin, the Divine of the Elements.

name: Kiz Ai’er – The Lionheart
description: From the far continent of Zandorion, this Lionfolk Prince joined the Hex Hunters in hopes to learn ancient and arcane knowledge that he could use to defend his clan back home. Though he is far from a novice with a blade, his mastery of magic leaves much to be desired before he is ready to return to his people.

name: Kiziri – Queen of the Harpies
description: The Queen of a large Harpy family that lives in the mountains west of Sharprahk. Mostly isolated, occasionally picking off goats or Dwarven livestock that ventured too close to their territory. Suddenly Kiziri and her brood have grown much bolder, attacking farmers on the outskirts of the towns of Torarol and Torsid, as well as wiping out entire caravans between the two towns. Whether their behaviour is motivated by some greater power or they have become more daring in food is unknown.

name: Knight of The Breath – Rolen
description: An elite spell-sword with a penchant for magic and steel both. A refugee from Hinatal and now one of the most versatile soldiers in The Golden Griffins. Rolen returned to Hinatal alongside the twin Unity Clerics, Arkeus and Arkina to defend it from invaders. Once defended they all returned to the front line and continued in their unfinished war.

name: Knight of The Dawn – Arkeus/Arkina
description: Twin Unity Clerics fled from Hinatal after racial tensions spilled over. Arkeus and Arkina joined the Golden Griffins in a bid to forge new bonds and bring aid to those in need.

name: Knight of The Eagle – Sycamore
description: Little memory does Sycamore have of his life before the Golden Griffins. It barely spans back three months prior to his joining. All he could remember was working as one of many servants or slaves to a powerful sorcerer in the fringes of Baldur’s wildlands. His master was cruel, and would often seem to revel in the misery of his servants. Thus himself and those entrapped with him rose up against their former master, ending his life while losing many of their own in the battle. With naught else to remain in the manor for, Sycamore and his colleagues parted in separate ways, aiming to find their true identities or to create new ones.

name: Knight of the Lion – Runs on Wind
description: In the tongue of his people this Goliath’s name is Brogvar, but in common he goes by Runs on Wind. In the Wastes of Oldavor he was born, in a small seaside village that was pitted against an endless plain of ice for 10 months a year. Fatefully he left his home, as a gargantuan creature wreaked havoc upon his village. Runs on Wind was able to slay the beast, but dozens were dead, including his family which were devoured in their yurt by a single gulp from the creature. Though the village declared him a hero, he felt a failure. So he exiled himself from the wastes to the warm lands beyond the white wall.

name: Knights of the Dragon
description: Knights that answer to the command of Horakthar, who in turn is the voice of Rokarthion the Red Tyrant. They answer to the whims of their commander, gladly ready to throw themselves upon their own swords, or the front lines of the enemy. Honour is seen in death through battle, and all Knights of the Dragon wish to see their lives end in a glorious slaughter against Rokarthion’s enemies.

name: Knights of the Inquisition
description: In magic is heresy. In heresy is death. In death is glory. Words that bind the Knights of the Inquisition in Baldur.

name: Kobold Scrappers
description: The grunts and disposable fodder of Brazatul’s followers. The Scrappers are just as their namesake implies: those who scrap and recover any bits of food, metal or resources otherwise they can find within the surrounds of their master’s den. They are also usually the first to be thrown at a potential enemy when trouble arises.

name: Königsratte – The Rat King
description: A rat infused with a strain of Dragonblight in clandestine experimentation by an unknown party. It was donated to the Crucible, with the organizers unaware of the beast’s true nature, believing themselves to simply have another powerful creature in their midst. It will prove to be much more of a problem than they first thought.

name: Kopok – Stone Spider
description: Subterranean spiders infused with the rocky elements that they call their home. These beasts make easy prey of rodents, lizards and any insects worth their time that are attracted to the bioluminescent crystal-like growths on their stony carapaces. Singularly they can prove deadly for an unwitting adventurer, but in groups they may overrun even the most experienced parties.

name: Korgrin Bloodstone – Blood Pact Warlock
description: Banished from his Dwarven homeland for the foul practice of Blood Magic, Korgrin found refuge in a land where all magic is deemed foul instead.

name: Korgrin Bloodstone – Fledgling Haemomancer
description: Banished from his Dwarven homeland for the foul practice of Blood Magic, Korgrin found refuge in a land where all magic is deemed foul instead: Baldur.
