description: A sentinel of Lion's Den Citadel, Ser Claudius has acted as the right-hand and bodyguard to the Field Marshal for many years.

name: Ser Elias the Forgotten – Knight of the Void
description: A Knight of Space and Time who was once a member of the ancient order of Psithars, trapped in the void for millennia before returning.

name: Ser Elias the Heartless – The Burning Knight
description: A Knight of Space and Time who was once a member of the ancient order of Psithars, trapped in void for millennia.

name: Ser Gaston – Vampire Knight
description: A relatively new addition to the ranks of Arthur Belfrie's Coven, once a knight in Greypeak under Duke Strauss.

name: Ser Ludwig – Will of Horauthin
description: Hailing from Draksborne, Ser Ludwig was among the first to valiantly fight against the forces of Dragonblight when they took root in the kingdom. Since Draksborne’s fall, Ser Ludwig has wielded the weight of a million souls on his shoulders. A warrior once propelled by rage is now driven by guilt, hoping to find redemption in a crusade against evil.

name: Sergeant – Silus
description: Though Sergeant hasn’t been his rank for long, Silus has seen more action than any others of his station. Being thrown into Talon Company: the Vanguard of The Golden Griffins was a death sentence for all any new recruit, especially in the midst of The Liturium War.

name: Sergeant Molly Cliffburn – Half-Elf Arcane Constable
description: A Sergeant in the Grimgate Order Force with a Breath Wielder’s License, one of the only members on the force who openly practices magic.

name: Seroca – Bearer of Secrets
description: The first of Mindoriel’s children, though Seroca is mostly featureless and was given little in personality. Never was it decided if the being was a daughter or son, and little did Mindoriel ever think of it as a child yet more as a tool. Seroca was able to show Mindoriel all that transpired beyond her sight, while keeping itself hidden. Even when Mindoriel was defeated Seroca maintained its place in hiding until it was revealed by Erdrydion as it attempted to sow seeds of malcontent under the instruction of Myrothlir. Still Seroca maintains its secrets and often weaves discord into the people of Tharador, baring influence in strange cults that dot the land.

name: Seroca’s Devout – Dark Cultist Warriors
description: The Cult of Seroca that lives among the desert plains of Sudd Tohst. This particular sect was once a nomadic tribe of Sun Elves, lured to the service of the Dark Spawn of Secrets. Discordant whispers set them against their Hinatali brethren, those in golden towers and manses who lived in luxury while their kin beyond their walls suffered in the agony of the desert. Now they are Seroca’s tools, enacting the will of the dark divine to undo Hinatal from within.

name: Shambling Corpse Mound
description: Wretched creations devised by Celine to gather corpses across Tharador in the wake of the destruction of Namneri's Chalice.

name: Shelldon – Mimic Clam
description: Mimics are known to take many forms, but it takes a special kind to mimic the form of another creature. Those that have achieved such a power are far more dangerous than a common mimic one might run into in a dungeon, and these particular ones have been bred by Quorenderi’s own lieutenants to exist in the depths of his fortress and the sea floor.

name: Shiasirix – Korthart's Faithful Spider Steed
description: The companion and mount of Korthart, a creature he bonded with while lampooning as an ally to his Drow captors.

name: Shingorion – Ancient Undead Dragon
description: A dragon whose fetid remains have boiled beneath the deserts of Sudd Tohst since time immemorial. Shingorion was among the many dragons to perish during the war between Mindoriel and Tharador. His own corpse fell into the ashen sands that would one day become Sudd Tohst, where until now, they have dwelt undisturbed. With Ridan’s rise from the sands, Shingorion has emerged with him, enthralled by the will of the ancient Colossal King, whose own will is bound by Myrothlir.

name: Shinkoryu – Eastern Crimson Dragon
description: An Eastern Dragon under Lian She's spell, once an ancestral protector of the Mamori Mountains in the nation of Uikku.

name: Shyamiri – Serpentfolk Assassin
description: Yanak Ti is a dangerous place, and assassins like Shyamiri make it all the worse. Hailing from a cult of killers that liken assassination to sacrifice, Shyamiri was said to be defective for his few moments of hesitation in ending his prey. A mark was placed on him and he was forced to flee to the isolated lands of Arrakana to escape his pursuers. The VVL provided him protection and a steady income with his existing skillset. But still, he constantly watches his back.

name: Shyasara – Snakemen Cultists
description: More snake than men, the Shyasara are the twisted children of Lian She, their bodies twisted and manipulated from birth.

name: Siltharis – Lich of the Restless Grave
description: A Lich captured by Aaron Drafthold and held in a torturous manner not too dissimilar from how the Lich once ensnared the souls and corpses of the dead himself. Siltharis must now die a dozen deaths, set against unsuspecting adventurers. Whilst he is happy to send them to their graves, his abilities are dulled by Aaron, leaving him much weaker than he once was.

name: Siltrak’thos – Knight from Beyond the Planes
description: Drawn from a world that was neither Vaezirak’s nor Minera, Siltrak’thos was drawn by the call of the Eldraeth to service a new master in a new world.

name: Silvia the Tearless – War Priestess
description: A Priestess of Horauthin, Silvia has seen the worst evils the dark divine could conjure, and the minds of corrupted Men. Whilst her place is serving the Church of the Tharameni and Horauthin, she considers herself a patriot, and thus flew to Limlight when she first heard of the Dragonblight outbreak there, against the wishes of her superiors in the clergy.

name: Sindan the Southern Hammer
description: A mercenary from Sudd Tohst who has found a home in the more temperate climates of Tharador’s central lands. Sindan has hung up his sellsword life, escorting slaves across the dunes, to a life where coin and blood flow just the same, but on his own terms. Though his dreams are still haunted by what he endured through the desert, he hopes to find a cure in the crucible and forget his nightmares.

name: Sintrius Gulch – Leader of the Lost
description: Initially a scholar and engineer, Sintrius took a de facto leadership position among the remaining Soulforged on Godless Isle after the Great Departure. For years Sintrius made attempts to send for aid using the remaining longform communications on the isle, while also trying to keep a balance for peace in the remaining Soulforged. When small groups attempted to rebel, Sintrius dealt with them swiftly, reducing the numbers of the Soulforged on the island to a fraction. When the Orcs arrived, it was Sintrius’ initial schemes that saw the tribals worship them as the gods of the land. With centuries passed he has come to live deep in his own delusions, truly believing himself to be a god.

name: Sir Albert of Oakrun – Steadfast Inquisitor
description: A stalwart Inquisitor who approaches combat with a strange elegance and speed despite his cumbersome weapon.

name: Sir Brax Attican – Dark Knight
description: The Attican line can trace itself to the founding days of Draksborne. Always was House Attican loyal to the emperor of Draksborne. When the empire fell, so too did the prestige of their house, for as the Marshall’s of the realm they were those who oversaw much of the war efforts against the revolting kingdoms. Now Brax aims to restore that prestige, dedicating himself to the Darkwing, he often leaves in service of Draksborne’s future, accompanying Agents on voyages across the sea or leading raids against constitutionalists across Draksborne, cutting off their heads wherever they may sprout.

name: Sir Davion Gainsworth – Magebane Inquisitor
description: Cocksure and headstrong, Sir Davion has given himself the moniker "magebane", a title which earns him an eyeroll from many of his peers.

name: Sir Enidus of Old Town – Inquisitor of the Crown
description: Born to a mistress in the bowels of Grimhelm’s opulent Old Town district, Enidus was raised as the illegitimate child of a cutthroat Naval Officer.

name: Sir Harian Southwall – Gunslinger Inquisitor
description: No nonsense, stoic, straightforward. Sir Harian is a man of few words, though in his brief and sparse moments of speech, his words carry an edge.

name: Skadi – Maiden of Vengeance
description: The middle daughter of the Himlingr family, Skadi lives in scorn of her sisters. She envies the love her father had always placed upon Frøya.

name: Skardi of the Third – Warlock of Decay
description: Born in the depths of the Third Reverie, Skardi emerged with a beauty so profound it ensnared the attention of a powerful devil. Bestowed with a double-edged gift, her magic siphoned the very essence of beauty from all she touched. Drawn to the lush allure of Tharador, Skardi now treads its verdant lands, her beguiling curse threatening to tarnish its splendour with every spell she weaves.

name: Skildanir the Dracolich
description: A great dragon ensnared in undeath by The Immortal Lich Kelathar, swept up from his body’s resting place upon Bloodtrail Isles, far to Tharador’s south. One of the old ones from the age of creation – his reanimated and putrid corpse now serves as little more than a puppet to the lich that raised him.

name: Skilet "The Boss" – Halfling Crime Lord
description: The leader and founder of the Rossa Cartel. For six decades he has been the central figure of authority for the crime syndicate.

name: Skjolnir & Haarn – The Wolf Knight
description: A pair bonded from youth, raised as siblings. Skjolnir riding atop his brother Haarn is a fearsome sight that can leave even the sturdiest warriors fleeing for their lives. Whilst they are usually far from the fringes of civilization, the pair have become caught in the web of Dragonblight in Limlight, having briefly visited the town to trade furs for supplies.

name: Skjolnir Ulvar – Barbarian of the Wolf
description: A barbarian raised among the Ulvar clan of Karkanoth, a group of wildlings who live side by side with direwolves. They hunt, eat and rest as the wolves do, creating a strange cross-species family that have been long pursued for the havoc they wreak upon the lands they visit. Skjolnir left the inner-embrace of the clan a year past, along with his wolf-brother Haarn. They have since wandered the wilderness, mostly free from pursuit.

name: Skorn Skullsplitter – Knight of the Seventh Reverie
description: An old Draksbornian general of old, taken by Nosmarka's Abyss after his death, his soul too tainted to wander the halls of Syelden.

name: Skraa Dark-Eye – Black Dragonkin Barbarian
description: Recognised easily by his hulking form and his jet-black right eye, Skraa is something of a legend among the locals, both Silverscale and Darkscale.

name: Skrittit – Devourer of Wisdom
description: A scout and cannon fodder used by The Psyflayers. Though unassuming in appearance the small creatures known as Skrittits are able to easily kill an unarmed man and prove a formidable foe to even veteran fighters. Brains of Psyflayer subjects whose bodies have passed are fashioned horrendous limbs using Shapeshifters and placed under mind control to do the bidding of their masters. With jaws beneath them, they are capable of beheading a man quite easily and bringing the severed head back to the Psyflayers to create even more Skrittits.

name: Slagsting – Shapeshifted Blood Hounds
description: A pack of hunting hounds kept by the Watchers upon Oldavor’s border. These unfortunate hounds met a gruesome end in the maw of a rabid shapeshifter.

name: Snippy – Bladeclaw Crab
description: Tales of the giant three-clawed crabs of the far isles have sifted through chatter in watering holes for centuries.

name: Soldiers of the Underkeepers – Mafia Brigands
description: The everymen of the Underkeepers, a nationalist gang that dedicates itself to the people of Grimgate, rather than kings and nobles.

name: Soleria – The Judge
description: A devout warrior who perished during the Battle of Duskweave over a decade ago, fighting the forces of Myrothlir’s spawn. Now she looks down from Syelden, among the Selvaneri, wondering if her death was in vain. The suffering that followed the battle in the infighting that led to the Liturium War far outscored the suffering in the battle itself. She ponders if Mindoriel’s Spawn had a hand in it, or if such conflicts are the nature of Men and Elves.

name: Sonari the Bridled Bat Monstrosity
description: A regular bat which once exposed to Eldraeth, grew in gargantuan proportions over the coming weeks. Now it towers four men tall.

name: Sonatus Noctursa – Northern Masked Owlbear
description: A distinct breed of Owlbear native to the mountains and valleys of northern Draksborne and southern Karkanoth, these creatures are remarked for their unique flat faces, resembling masks. Elves native to the region call them Moon Owlbears, owing to their face resembling a crescent moon. These Owlbears however are some of the deadliest on Tharador, and are responsible for dozens of deaths every year, able to easily gore a whole squad of unprepared soldiers.

name: Sora Takashi – Flying Falcon
description: The most mischievous and free spirited of the Spirit Samurai. Sora’s place among the group is well regarded for his cheery optimism and resilience against adversity. Though his past is one of turmoil, it bears little influence to the way Sora now lives among the Spirit Samurai in service of his ancestral spirit.

name: Sorngaar – The Cindering
description: Found in the heart of Karignen, Fire Peak, Sorngaar has been said to be the benevolent guardian of the volcanic mountain for time immemorial. Dwarves have always held the Lord of Karignen with respect, yet it seems in recent times he has grown displeased with the Dwarves. Now he poses a great threat to them and their way of life, and the Dwarves feel they must act swiftly against The Cindering One before he spells their doom.

name: Sovram the Betrayed – Elder Black Dragon
description: Once the ruler of Dragonmaw Keep, cast down by his lesser in a bid of betrayal. His wings clipped, and his pride shattered.

name: Sown One – Flesh Golem
description: An atronach of flesh, conjured and animated by the Wandering Mage. The Sown One does not suffer, for it feels nothing; it is nothing. A mindless amalgamation that is a terrifying facsimile of a humanoid, it only knows its masters will. Such a will sees that it would bring a violent end to any who dare tread in his realm.

name: Strika – Ranger of the Frozen Wastes
description: A Wastewalker Ranger who was a renowned scout and hunter for the Boundless Wind Clan of Eastern Oldavor. Strika was said to have single-handedly slain a Nix Centipede, and earned her place among her clan as a fearsome hunter since. During a mundane Mammoth Giant hunt, Strika was ensnared by a trap in a craggy, narrow valley. She hung upside down for hours, helpless. When weariness finally took her, she slept a long, dark sleep. She awoke in Khandara soon after, and has vied to escape ever since, though any semblance of time has eluded her, and she knows not if weeks, months or years have passed since her arrival.

name: Styrax Thunderscale – Half-Dragon Sorcerer
description: Companion to Illyria, after finding her by chance in a busy market in Canos. Styrax vowed to keep himself tethered to the young woman.

name: Sukurin – Kraken of the Depths
description: Dragged from the depths of the Katarn Sea, Sukurin is a great and angered Water Spirit that brings death and destruction in all its hours of waking. Formed of water, the spirit takes on the shape of a Kraken to strike fear into the hearts of sailors when it rises, adorning itself with the armour and materials of sunken ships, weapons and even deceased sea monsters. It finally lay frozen and dormant for a time, kept in a temple in Tenger to be watched and worshiped.

name: Sultan’s Bodyguard – Kara’Ta
description: A cat-folk fighter from the far reaching jungles of Zandoriel, brought over by boat in chains when he was barely matured from a cub. Spending his whole life fighting, he eventually reached an unbeatable peak at the top, earning his freedom through the blood of the dozen other slaves he fought against. Hearing of the champion’s freedom, Sultan Hakim swept him up with promises of wealth, women and large spacious areas in his palace. With fighting all he knew, and an undefiable Sultan, Kara’Ta accepted.

name: Sultan’s Sorcerer – Inaya
description: A tiefling sorcerer fled from a darker life. Travelling through Sudd Tohst made her resilient and hardened to the perils and misfortunes of others. She is the fixation of her own world, and impressed Sultan Hakim on storming his palace singlehandedly and dispatching his personal guards. Though not the most powerful sorcerer, her magical abilities make her a golden rarity in the desert kingdom.

name: Sun Cleric – Suraci
description: One of the Great Sun Glanion’s most devout – Suraci’s family lines traces back to the first human migrants from Goltia. His ancestors joined the temple of Glanion as one of the first human devotees to the sun. His father Suladead is the head of the human sect of Glanion, and as a result Suraci himself is more pious than any others – so devoted that he may conjure the raw flames of Glanion and his son Glancalnos upon his body and wield it as a weapon against his enemies.

name: Supreme Master of Poisoned Talons – Orlena
description: A tiefling that was not always so. Orlena’s past of affluence feels like another life from her current one as one of the Golden Griffin’s head of Special Operations. None can brew a poison like her and none can ensure a swift death like her.

name: Surtson – Fire Jötunn
description: An enormous fire giant that has found a home in the icy peaks on the northern side of Nordheim, not far from the border into Oldavor.

name: Susaneko – Swordmaster of the South
description: A Swordmaster of Uikku, a continent in the far East of Edrador. Known as the Swordmaster of the South in his homeland, he has earned his reputation as one of the most proficient but expensive ronin of Uikku. A job taking him to Tharador ended poorly when his employer was betrayed, and Susaneko hunted across the city, ultimately bested by the power of the flintlock firearm. Markamin has taken the dying catfolk and used him as his wildcard entry into the Crucible of Champions, promising him with resurrection and returning him to his homeland.

name: Sword Dancer – Nahida
description: A deadly yet unassuming assassin that takes the role of a traditional Sudd Tohsti belly dancer. Often she will case out her victims in a tavern or inn, taking the guise of a paid dancer before brutally slitting her prey’s throat or poisoning their drink. Even in single combat she is incredibly proficient with her blades and can take down even the most disciplined swordsmen.

name: Syelros – The Ender
description: A champion of Horauthin and one of the Selvaneri, Syelros was a great warrior, a Colossal who lead the remnants of his people in a desperate charge against the Psyflayers before they could be unleashed on the world. If it were not for his actions, thousands more would roam the world today. Thus his bravery had him reborn as Horauthin’s agent upon Tharador, the Selvaneri who was unparalleled in martial prowess.

name: Syelros the Ascended
description: A champion of Horauthin and one of the Selvaneri, Syelros was a great warrior, a Colossal who lead the remnants of his people.

name: Syldi – Feral Faeries
description: Mischievous chaotic faeries that have lived their lives in the forests of Nan Thalias and the Fey of Renmaeth. They are able to Feywalk at will, changing the planes they exist on at a whim. Often they use this to disorientate their victims. Though they might appear cutesy and innocent, Syldi are carnivores and hunt in packs. Any creature that bleeds is a potential meal for them.

name: Sylvia of the Fringe – Faun Enchantress
description: A faun who has called the Tryamin Woods home her whole life. Sylvia grew up in the wake of destruction left by the fall of Elen Estel, and thus grew fond of the Druids that tended the woods who she saw as family by the time their job was complete. She is fiercely protective of her woods as a result, and though she won’t ever try directly to harm intruders, she will certainly send them astray with her enchanting songs.

name: Sylvios the Slip – Elven Rogue Gambler
description: A member of the Cartel whose job is evening the odds of the casino floor, keeping an eye out for cheats.

name: Synoria the Noble Hearted – Feywalker Caster
description: A young elven woman born and raised in the warmth of a small treetop village. Her and her people had kept to ways of antiquity for millennia.

name: Syntheia the Daring – Tiefling Scoundrel
description: The daughter of a Nosmeni couple raised in the slums of Tradver, approaching a life of crime with a "devil may care" attitude.

name: Syrinlena – Seeker of Erdrydion
description: A high ranking Paladin of the Order of Erdrydion hailing from Nan Thalias. Syrinlena acts independently to the politics of her nation. She is the unknown and unsung half-sister to the great hero Yinsylim Lichbane who has gone missing for the past year. She has followed his traces to Mammoth Isle, in hopes to find him and his fate there.

name: Tanagor – Sentinel of the Woods
description: A sprightly hybrid Dryad Centaur that has lived within the Fey Realm of Renmaeth’s Dream for centuries. Though usually occupied with the happenings in the west of the Fey’s equivalent of Nan Thalias and Belfrie, the recent surge in plane shifts have caused her to investigate the realm that once belonged to Melwyn, one of the first Fey Spirits before Renmaeth had even entered her great slumber.

name: Tarick Wolfheart
description: A man who bears more winters against him than it seems. Tarick was exceptionally resistant to the negative effects of Crystal Augmentation, so was subjected to more extreme and experimental crystals that further enhanced his powers, and granted him life longer than most other Hex Hunters and Men.

name: Tarraan – King of Katarn
description: A great Sea Lizard from the depths of Lo Fuin, none match the legend of Tarraan that is told by sailors all over Tharador. A Leviathan with legs, some call it, the Kraken’s Bane it’s known by others. Many chalk up Tarraan as a sailors myth used to impress landlubbers when they reach shore, but any seasoned sailor knows Tarraan is very real. Unfortunately for the citizenry of Varekan, a Dwarven sea town, Tarraan has decided to confirm its existence in their city.

name: Tasmin Greaves – Druidic Gunslinger
description: A Half-Elf born of the forbidden love of a Druidic Grove Warden and a Baldurian Forest Ranger, embodying both parents' traits.

name: Tekrana of the Bloodfangs – Half-Orc Barbarian
description: Brought into the WEHL after living in the wilderness of Belfrie for most of her life, Tekrana offers her employers a unique skillset and bloodlust.

name: Telnam Gnik – The Big Game Hunter
description: Dwarves of Tharador are usually known to be resplendent lovers of nature, (despite the usual bad wrap they get as industrialists). However, there are many Dwarves who do fill this stereotype, and none better than Telnam Gnik. Telnam hunted many great beasts in his time, but a year prior his home city of Varekan was assailed by a gargantuan monster of the sea. His family perished in the attack, and Telnam has been on a self-destructive war path against giant beasts ever since. His mind has been corroded and strident whispers have led him into the wastes of Oldavor, to find the greatest game he might in the depths of the forgotten fortress of Khandara.

name: Temple to the God of War
description: Temple to the God of War does the quiet work of making a battle mat feel like a real place. The loyalty-rewards styling makes it a natural fit for framing a key encounter rather than filling empty table space.

name: Tengaraya – Flying Sea Ray
description: Marine creatures native to the coasts of Abunen Kolden, used as mounts or draught beasts by Water and Air Elemi.

name: Tergrid Everen – The Crusher
description: A scribe of the Ek Viriktar, Tergrid stands as a measure of encyclopedic knowledge against the enemies that her party might face in battle. Having studied the teachings of the Temple of Tharanais most her life, Tergrid quickly came to realise no coin could be made as an Acolyte of Tharanais in the Dwarven lands. She entered the Ek Viriktar in a bid to keep her fellow Dwarves safe, and continue her quest of knowledge through learning and regurgitation of all the strange beasts that she would face.

name: Terrain – Bones of Cazarion
description: Cazarion was the last Mineran Dragon of the hollow, called a divine messenger by some and a tyrant by others. The story of his death is the subject of many ballads, tales and epic sagas told throughout the Hollow. Details change each time, and it seems the true cause is lost to history. If his bones are to be believed, he was skewered by dozens of ballistae in his final flight against the forces of Rokarthion, but some attribute these to having been planted by Rokarthion years after the elder’s death.

name: Terrain – Granny Nora’s Hovel
description: The interior of the hovel of Granny Nora. It has been used by her for sixty years while her nefarious schemes poisoned Tryamin Forest. To the unassuming observer, all the interior of her hovel is quaint and cute, the collections of a druidic maiden, the persona she projects. Yet beneath the veneer is the darker truth, as sickly scents and revolting sights are the true form of her home’s interior.

name: Terrain Set – A Place of Respite
description: A place of respite and rest for any weary adventurer. An adventurer’s camp is their home away from home, where their woes are forgotten and their wounds healed. Though do not be completely careless, for peril can still strike at home, and the denizens of Tharador are oft drawn by the warmth of fire at night.

name: Terrain Set – Cemetery of the Damned
description: An old abandoned cemetery that has not seen use in half a century, quickly exceeding capacity during the Bloodlung outbreak.

name: Terrain Set – Crescent Moon Casino
description: An old bordello transformed into the magnificent jewel of Tradver City, seen by all who enter via Dream's Doorway.

name: Terrain Set – Grimgate Sewers
description: A honeycomb network of storm drains and sewer tunnels that runs beneath the streets of Tharador's largest city.

name: Terrain Set – Kazadran Mines
description: A silver and jewel mine that has been overrun with Troggs and other foul creatures in the wake of the Rupture and its aftershocks.

name: Terrain Set – Koldeni Encampment
description: The bulwark encampment of the invading Elemi from Abunen Kolden, composed of palisades and watchtowers built of stakes.

name: Terrain Set – Lion's Den Citadel
description: Perched atop Beckett Rock and looming over Grimhelm like an iron sentinel, Lion's Den Citadel has stood as the military heart of Baldur for centuries.

name: Terrain Set – Nosmarka's Hellish Abyss
description: The evershifting arena of Nosmarka's Abyss. Islands here rise and fall as though they were bound by a tide.

name: Terrain Set – Plagued Streets of Canos
description: As Dragonblight's grip tightens on the city of Canos, its corruption transforms mundane objects into horrific creatures.

name: Terrain Set – The Defiled Chalice of Namneri
description: As Dragonblight swept the land, Hendrak teleported into Syelden itself where he would pilfer the Chalice for his ascension.

name: Terrain Set – The Shifting Foundry
description: A secretive foundry held by Baldur's Crown in an unsuspecting building in Grimhelm, home to daring experiments.

name: Terrain Set – The Silent Garden
description: A demiplane created by the powerful magics of the Cult, used as a means to store captives they consider dangerous.

name: Terrus Videm – Cleric of the Lost
description: A human combat engineer reborn in the form of a Soulforged following his death in the Centaur Wars. Terrus carries the weight of his past life, while finding solace in his new reality. Over centuries, he’s grown to fall into delusions cast by Sintrius long before he can even remember, now believing him and his kin to be gods, vowing to protect his home and its orcish inhabitants from the disruptive influence of any foreigners. Terrus stands as a stalwart protector, ready to meet any threat with divine magic, mechanical ingenuity, and a warrior’s resolve.

name: Testidi – Dragon Turtle Hatchling
description: Testidi, or Dragon Turtle Hatchlings as they are known in Common, are sizable omnivorous reptiles native to the warm oceanic regions of Minera, particularly drawn to the equator and the bustling shores of Godless Isle. Despite their young age, Testidi already measure an impressive 3 to 4 meters at birth, equipped with sharp, powerful jaws that serve as a stern warning to overly curious explorers. While amphibious, these creatures prefer the water, venturing on land primarily for food or to escape predators. Each year during the Equinox, the beaches of Godless Isle come alive as countless Testidi make their inaugural journey from nest to sea – a fascinating spectacle that underscores the relentless cycle of life and survival.

name: Teverys – Arcane Paladin
description: A Leacianan High Elf and Arcane Paladin who has devoted his life to serving Brinilmin, the deity of Chaotic and Arcane magic. Celebrated as a hero during the Liturium War, Teverys faced the bitter truth of fighting former allies but remained unyielding in his devotion to his homeland and faith. When he encountered Zyril, a young elf who manifested Brinilmin’s Blessing, Teverys trained him in the ways of this mysterious power, helping him hone his newfound abilities, and together they stand united in their quest to safeguard their land and their divine connection.

name: Thaddeus the Fortress – Horauthin’s Favoured
description: A powerful man with a head as strong as his arm. Thaddeus has always lived by his gut, more than his mind. It is this trait that leaves many within the Church of Horauthin to be skeptical of his place there, yet thus far Thaddeus has managed to consistently prove them wrong. His instincts have never failed, and as a result, he has worked his way to Captain within the Church’s armed forces.

name: Thalorad "Goldhand" – Illustrious Elven Merchant
description: A wandering merchant of various curious wares, nicknamed "Goldhand" for his innate ability to find magical properties in mundane items.

name: Tharador – Father of Wisdom
description: The last child of Minera to rise from the ocean depths as a great landmass. Tharador is the smallest of all continents and most meagre in body. Yet his wits more than make up for the shortfall in stature. Tharador discovered and harnessed the Breath before any of his kin, becoming the first magic wielder in time before history. He used it to empower his own children, the Tharameni, and their children, The Beremeni (The First Elves). Again it was used to battle his sister Mindoriel when she came for the lives of the Elves seeing the cycle of life and death that had been designed for them as an evil that she ill-understood. When Mindoriel was defeated Tharador used the last of his strength to bring the race of Men to the world from another plane far away. Now his spirit rests in eternal slumber, though at times he dreamwalks, imbuing his spirit into a mortal to explore the world his children still keep.

name: Tharanais – Prince of Wisdom
description: The first of Tharador’s children, made in his image. Tharanais took the task upon himself of forming and molding the first elven civilizations, teaching them metallurgy, wood working, agriculture, construction and all other forms of knowledge that see tribes turn to empires. Tharanais along with Renmaeth shaped Elven society, most notably when bestowing the power of magic through the Breath. Though Renmaeth argued against its destructive nature, Tharanais pushed the elves towards wielding it in any way they see fit to defend themselves from the evils of Mindoriel. This divide between the siblings saw the elves divide also. When Tharador went into slumber, Tharanais took charge as the family Patriarch and has kept order amongst his siblings and mortals in The Tower of Verdens ever since.

name: Tharavës – The Wise Warrior
description: The Selvaneri of Tharanais. When the worship of Brinilmin rose in Leacianus, Tharavës in his past life did all he could to ensure that the teachings of Tharanais were not forgotten, as they were the foundation of their Triarchy, and to forget them would forget what the kingdom was built upon. If it were not for the actions of Tharavës, the worship of Tharanais would have all but ended in the High Elven land.

name: Tharia Moonshadow – Cleric of Glanbeli
description: Few Nosmeni find themselves tied to Glanbeli, yet fate brought a wayward girl to find hope and rebirth in her service.

name: Tharvaya – Ascended Dragon Warlock
description: Tharvaya was a disciple of Brazatul, one of his chosen progeny alongside her brother Tharvian. The Dragon trusted them both dearly, bestowing his powers upon them to act as his champions. When Brazatul was defeated, her powers waned and her brother was killed. Finding herself powerless, Tharvaya honed her mind until she became her own patron for her powers, becoming more powerful than ever by doing so.

name: Tharvaya – Dragon Warlock
description: From within the depths of Brazatul’s domain rises his most devoted followers. Those who he would lend his power and pay homage to him as his champions. Tharvaya is one such champion. Her and her brother Tharvian are two of Brazatul’s greatest champions, each gifted with traits of leadership and strength, now enhanced by the powers of their dragon ancestor.

name: Tharvian – Dragon Knight
description: A great knight and warrior of Brazatul who invokes his ancestor’s name in combat against those who would do harm to him. Tharvian is a master of many weapons, and a keen smith at that as well, forging most of his own weapons to his liking. With the power of Brazatul’s Breath, his items are tempered in Dragon Flame, making them more powerful than the mere crafts of Greypeak’s mortals, and with such items he is an unstoppable force.

name: The Absolver – Eldritch Beast of the Depths
description: A beast that was until recently, held in captivity within a secret lab outside of Grimhelm, one of the earlier experiments of Project Glass Ceiling.

name: The Amalgamation – Aberrant Abomination
description: As Dragonblight victims' bodies break down, they merge into large colony-like entities, towering behemoths of dripping flesh.

name: The Ark of the Enlightened
description: One of the final forms of the Dragonblight lifecycle, a result of the combined mass of nearly a dozen Amalgamations.

name: The Blessed – Servants of Vaezirak
description: Among the Drow of Irinax, the Blessed were the first to give themselves entirely to the service of their prophet Vaezirak.

name: The Blight’s Chosen – Blighted Angel
description: An amalgamation of many perished villagers of Limlight. This creature indicates that some sort of force is driving this infestation: something intelligent. Whether the form of this creature is intended as a mockery to the divine, or is its own delusion that it is something holy, is up for debate. What is certain, however, is that it will add any unfortunate enough to cross its path into its amalgamated flesh.

name: The Blight’s Warriors – Blighted Knights
description: Soldiers of Draksborne who have become infected with the most aggressive forms of Dragonblight. It seems that in those with martial prowess and weaponry, the disease bolsters its hold, focusing additional energy into growing masses of flesh that it uses as weapons, as well as armour.

name: The Bloodied Cairn – Ritual Site
description: An old stone circle that has stood since the First Era. Any true history of this ominous formation is lost to legend.

name: The Captain – Tiefling Veteran Soldier
description: A veteran of Draksborne’s army, the Captain’s past is a secret he holds close. Though he claims to have fought for Belfrie in the war, there are none who claim to know him, despite his alleged position as an officer. Still, he retains his story, despite the claims and rumours to the contrary, with belief circulating that his place as a soldier is a fabrication. Still, he certainly fights like a man who has seen years of war.

name: The Converted – Dwellers of the Nocturnal Abyss
description: When a soul is rejected from Namneri’s Chalice and does not enter the bounds of Syelden, it is doomed to aimlessly wander the spiritual realm that exists alongside the physical plane. But a lure brings many away from that plane, an ephemeral glow of warmth in some far, vague place. Like moths to a flame they are drawn to it, and like moths to a flame they are singed and burned, reborn as Nosmeni, burning Children, or “The Converted” as those who live in the Nocturnal Abyss call them.

name: The Crucible
description: Hidden in the Steelpeak Mountains of Belfrie, the Crucible is an open secret of Tharador’s High Society. Spectators come from across the continent, all of whom do so via teleportation circles hidden in plain sight in major cities. Its yearly tournament is currently underway, with spectators arriving from all corners of Tharador to empty or bolster their coffers as blood is spilled on the sand and wine fills their gullets.

name: The Damned Galleon – Shipwreck Terrain Set
description: The aft-most part of the Damned Galleon washed ashore after it met its gruesome end. A handful of its cursed bounty landed with it.

name: The Devouring Eye
description: Beneath the city of Tradver, the Devouring Eye has made its home. An aberration with a penchant for gold and jewels, it was naturally drawn to Belfrie’s trade centre, where gold flows just as readily through its canals as water.

name: The Fallen & Damned – Lost Crusaders
description: Those who came before. Soldiers lost to the sands, but not forgotten. These were the earliest members of the Church who came to Sudd Tohst a year prior in search of fragments of Namneri’s Chalice. When they did not return suspicions were raised. Each party sent in search of them fell to whatever peril had claimed the first, though the Church unknowingly were raising an undead army for each failed expedition they sent.

name: The First Vampire – Almenhier Thrasliche
description: The first vampire born from Myrothlir during the Age of Creation. His devotion to the divine of undeath severed and freedom bestowed unto him by Tharador, Almenhier grew to hate his kindred and has since used his own immortality to hunt vampires, and all other manner of Myrothlir’s creations, vowing never to feed upon humans unless in the most dire circumstances or they were men of evil.

name: The Forbidden Section – Library Golem
description: The University of Canos does not keep their contraband books under lock and key. They instead are animated in the form of a Golem that would deliver a devastating beating to any students who might be attempting to take them without permission. Its hostilities can be disabled, should the student know the passcode to do so. It changes regularly, however, and only Lady Elara and Headmistress Delacour know the code.

name: The Gilded Talon – Thyralmir
description: Thyralmir is one of the last of his kind: A Northern Moon Griffin. Shocked are most who see him (though often he will be the last thing they see) as his appearance greatly deviates from the common depiction of the Griffin, with a head more like a falcon or eagle than the drake-like appearance of Thyralmir and his kin.

name: The Great Sultan Hakim
description: The Sultan of The United Sultanate of Sudd Tohst. He rules on a throne of gold and rubies from Dahabi Palace in Torish Istrath. Inherited from the conquest of his great great grandfather one-hundred and twenty years prior, Hakim enjoys all the wealth and power with none of the hardship his forefathers endured. He rules with an iron fist and a mind of wine.

name: The Listener
description: A creature of the deep, the Listener is an agent of the Voice. It blindly lists through the catacombs, sewers and halls of Ardris, moving through echolocation. It is able to consume the body of any humanoid and then assume its form, though the assumed form is imperfect having empty eye sockets and unable to verbally communicate. It searches for the body of the Riverstalker held by the university, so it can halt the study of it and return it to the sea.

name: The Matriarch – Tiefling Noblewoman
description: A Nosmeni who escaped Nosmarka’s Abyss in rebellion after her people were sent to slaughter in Velandria several years ago. While she had dreams of uniting the Nosmeni of Minera and creating their own nation, she realises that is a far away dream, for her people are scattered and her resources upon Minera are limited. The Crucible is her hope to secure gold, funding and the eye of Xarvir Barikdral.

name: The Mind Walker – Abomination of Intellect
description: Non-human races who meet a gruesome fate at the end of Dragonblight's lifecycle, forming enormous megabrains from their gathered brains.

name: The Mole’s Hole – Crime Syndicate Hideout
description: Located on a small hillock in Grimgate’s outskirts, the Mole’s Hole is a well-kept establishment that whets the whistle of any travellers making their way out the city, or who just arrived. Little do they know that beneath their feet, the masterminds of one of Baldur’s deadliest crime syndicates sketch out their macabre plans and greet each other with bloodstained hands.

name: The Moon Devil
description: A monster thought of by most as a tall children’s tale to stop the young from wandering into the woods at night, though any hunters or trackers in north Karkanoth know that the Moon Devil is as real as wake of bodies it leaves behind of any hunters foolish enough to poach in the forest on a night bathed in moonlight.

name: The Nightwalker Corrupted Forest Spirit
description: Once a keeper of the forest and a spirit that would tend to the groves and trees of the island, as well as the herder and wise-one of the animals that lived there. Though when the lich Kelathar came to power this spirit was slain along with many other creatures of the isle. Brought back undead, The Nightwalker as it was hence known became a corruptor of the forest and a weapon of Kelathar.

name: The Observer
description: A lesser aberration hiding in the bowels of Tradver’s forgotten and flooded dungeons. From beneath it pulls the strings of the city above for its own personal gain. In its truth, the creature acts as a servant to Seroca, the God of Secrets, and its own personal gains are the gains of its dark divine.

name: The One Eyed Wanderer
description: A mysterious stranger who wanders the forests of Nordheim, a raven ever-perched on his arm or shoulder.

name: The Ordained – Face of House Glydrin
description: A position of penance in Glanbelite Culture, The Ordained is a title given to those who have committed a great sin or failure for their people.

name: The Plagueborne – Plague Carriers
description: Victims of Norminos, these undead plague carriers are those slain and reanimated by the dark servant of Idinhelieth and Myrothlir. They act to his command, and are most commonly used to sow dissent and panic into the forces that would stand against him, for even a worry that may best them in battle will lose to the ailment they gain from their fight.

name: The Progressed – Dragonblight Stricken Students
description: Students that have become unintentionally stricken with Dragonblight during classes with Professor Frederik Vahlen. Rather than attempt to cure them (and since there is no known cure), the professor has instead confined the students to a secret chamber beneath the University. There he has studied them, attempting to alter the strain of the plague to unlock its psionic potential, without harming the hosts. It is in this hope, that he could potentially unlock the latent psionic powers that exist in all humans, and the memories of their past lives.

name: The Reindread
description: What an unfortunate reindeer looks like after an encounter with a shapeshifter. This particular one is sharp, separating its form in two when in danger, doubling its odds of survival or its attacking power if fighting a group of enemies. Relentless in its onslaught, it won’t rest until anything around it becomes part of it.

name: The Scourer – Glaive Artillery
description: Glaive Throwers form the backbone of Leacianus’ military. Enormous siege machines with anti-infantry design, they are made to clear swathes of men or forest and break down the hope of enemies. No crew is required physically to man the Glaives, as they are each held together with an arcane core within that uses telepathy to load, aim and fire any glaives. The results are horrific, with the glaives each imbued with a magic that prevents any harm they deal to be unhealable unless such magic is first dispelled. This results in extraordinary loss of life even beyond the initial hits that bisect dozens unfortunate enough to be caught by them.

name: The Spire of Glanion – Sunspire Temple (Playable Dicetower)
description: The towering spire that is visible miles away from its place in Hinatal, its spherical glass topper shining from dusk until dawn. It is in this temple that the Teardrop of Glanion is housed, a powerful artefact capable of temporarily harnessing the power of the sun, a tool of potentially endless destruction. Many have sought it for its power, and the enormous amount of Breath contained within it.

name: The Thornmother – Corrupted Forest Sentinel
description: When Conrad Elstein fled into Tryamin Forest, the foul ichor of Idinhelieth and Seroca left in his wake took hold on much of the flora and fauna of the region. The Thornmother is one such corrupted creature.

name: The Three Faces – Elemental Golems
description: Golems representing three of Maethromin's Faces: Fire, Water and Earth, conjured by the Strike Forces of Abunen Kolden.

name: The Travelling Jack
description: The Travelling Jack is a demonic jester that lures travelers with its enchanting music before devouring them. It has recently been spotted in the sewers beneath The University of Ardris, where its melodies can be heard echoing through the pipes, tempting students into the darkness. Its ultimate goal is unknown, but anyone who falls under its spell is never seen again.

name: The Travelling Jack – Reborn Trickster Devil
description: A devilish jester that was slain years before, its soul returned to Nosmkara’s Abyss thereafter. It would lure travelers with enchanting music like a siren, before lulling them into a state of waking dreams, and devouring them. Now it is among the swarms of devils and demons that assault the divine’s home of Syelden, finding his own realm within the ceaseless tower to call his own, sharing it with the gluttonous Bodge. They together lure their victims into a false sense of peace, and dine together on their flesh after.

name: The Ugadrin – Snow Giants
description: In the twilight years of the Colossal War, the Oldavori Empire succumbed to desperate measures to stave off the resilient and unrelenting humans. Before there were Shapeshifters and Psyflayers, there were giants. Beings that were stretched to the very limits of their potential, to be used as soldiers in the war against Men, and slaves and servants in the cities of the empire. Those entombed in Khandara were those loyal to their King Vurimandi in his attempted rebellion against their Colossal creators. Over a thousand years later they still roam the halls, though their minds ring hollow, and madness has taken them all.

name: The Voice
description: One of the more powerful spawns from the great creature of the deep, Quorenderi. The Voice guides its Listeners through telepathic means, each of its Listeners dedicated to a single mission of The Voices’ accord. The Voice is enormous, and should it die, one of its Listeners will go through the rigorous process to evolve to take its place.

name: Theldranax the Ancient – Elder Vampire
description: An ancient ancestor of Baroness de Blanc that has lived in the deep catacombs of Castle Beaufax for millennia.

name: Theubian – Champion of the Serpent
description: Part of a secretive sect diverged within the Hinatali nobles, Theubian acts as their enforcer and blade. Those who oppose their plans, their design and sow dissidence not according to their own will, are met with a gruesome end at the hands of Theubian. These serpent worshippers within Hinatal make up a small secretive faction, one that is unknown to all except those who are in it.

name: Thilinos – Elder Psyflayer
description: One of the first Psyflayers to be brought into the world. Thilinos was conscious for all this time of torment in the first age, and was one of the first instigators of the Psyflayer rebellion. Now he acts as a puppet master, an alpha Psyflayer that commands the rest spread across the continent who each have their tendrils dug into the minds of the elite.

name: Thirazar – The Forgotten
description: A Lich that perished to frost for hundreds of years. Only recently through the error of the Paladin Yinsylim was Thirazar released from his icy tomb. Now the paladin is under his control and Thirazar is building an undead army to begin his assault of Tharador. Scouts were sent ahead to Karkanoth and Greypeak in hopes to begin slowly building armies in each and beginning a foothold before his main force invaded. With both slain, he feels now he may have to enact his plan faster.

name: Thrones of the Leacianan Triarchs
description: The three levitating thrones of the Leacianan Triarchs are more than seats of power; they are tangible embodiments of their reign. Each is meticulously crafted upon the ruler’s ascendancy, uniquely reflecting the essence of its occupant. These thrones not only inspire their subjects but also serve as constant reminders of the distinct powers that guide Leacianus.

name: Tira of the Farlands – Outlander Ranger
description: Hailing from the remote and monster-infested regions of Nan Thalias’ north, Tira was a proficient monster killer from childhood.

name: Tiranite – Obsidian Demon
description: An elite spawn of Nosmarka, goddess of Chaos and Destruction. Tiranite was one of many Obsidian Demons that fought for Mindoriel against Tharador in the Sibling War. These demons were great fire breathers and used as artillery from the rear lines of the army. When Mindoriel was defeated, Tiranite and many of his kin fell dormant, and those that would discover them centuries later would think them to be ancient statues, ignorant to their darker nature. Now he has risen in the catacombs of Gehr Keep, unaware of his surroundings and situation save for what he has been told by a lone succubus.

name: Tizariel – The Sphinx
description: An enigmatic creature said to be a wish granter or oracle. The Sphinx Tizariel sits upon the western-most mountain of the Great Havel Range. Many men have travelled to her in search of fortune, glory or guidance; few have returned. Those that did speak little of their encounter with the creature. The Sphinx has a powerful control on both humanoids and beasts in swaying their hearts and minds.

name: Tjornir – Reanimated Mammoth
description: A Mammoth long fallen and decaying in a glacier within the Hjolheim Range. Fallen during the First Era, this creature has now been risen from its long slumber to bring terror and carnage to the villages of men, descendents of those who slew it. The mammoth’s rage still burns within, even in its frozen and shambling corpse.

name: Tokrik – Dark Dwarf Hunter
description: A Dark Dwarf who lived his life beyond captivity for years, prowling the dangerous Underground, until tracked down by the Irinaxi Drow.

name: Tomas Lumens –  Half-Orc Artificer
description: Tomas would forever live in the vengeance of his father, a brilliant human engineer responsible for Baldur’s first trans-city locomotive machine. So too did he live to see the vengeance of his mother, an Orc slave labourer. Tomas watched from a young age his parents be worked to death in the mines. At eight his father passed, then at nine his mother. Through all the turmoil of the rest of his life Tomas vowed that no child would suffer what he endured, no orc would suffer from slavery any longer and the industry of Baldur would be built upon machine, not man or orc. Inheriting his father’s knack for machinery, mixed with unsanctioned magic, Tomas has joined the WEHL in hopes of further exploring the boundaries of Tharador and beyond in answers for his quest of artificial machine-life.

name: Tomas Lumens – Unbridled Inventor
description: A half-orc driven by vengeance: his father, the pioneer of Baldur's first trans-city locomotive, sentenced to death by hard labor.

name: Toraxid Drenth – Swamp Druid
description: There are few Drow born and raised beyond the confines and safety of the Underground. The Druids of Lo Fuin make up some of those few. Toraxid was born in such a druidic circle, devotees to both Renmaeth and Irinax. The Druidic circle has reacted negatively to the meddling of the Moon Drow that aim to restore their lost lands on the surface, ensuring that the swamp and its creatures continue encroaching on the lost ruins.

name: Torde – The Gatekeeper
description: An ancient statue that has stood the test of time. It existed in Gehr Keep before the keep was built, with the main gate being built around the statue when it was constructed. A fallen angel turned to stone, Torde aims to restore his honour through actions in hopes he can one day return to the realm of Syelden and be amongst his kin.

name: Torgothrin – Lord of the Fey
description: A direct spawn of Melwyn, descended from the Wrathful Spirit’s own soul. Torgothrin aims to continue where his father failed, and ensure the eradication of all humans near the lands of the Reach and the Fringe comes to pass. The means he has taken to get there however have fallen to methods not even his father would have considered.

name: Torgothrin – Punished Fey Lord
description: A direct spawn of Melwyn, descended from the Wrathful Spirit’s own soul. Torgothrin aimed to continue where his father failed, ensuring the eradication of all humans near the lands of the Reach and the Fringe. Though he was defeated and killed, now used for entertainment by the divine as his punishment, forced to fight as a combatant in the Crucible.

name: Torgrik “Tall Hat” – Dwarven Gunslinging Gangster
description: Initially intended to be the captain of the forthcoming Dornat Al Karit branch of the Rossa Cartel, Torgrik’s dreams of power were cut short alongside Skilet’s life when the Cartel’s leader was assassinated.

name: Torrent –  Water Genasi Warrior
description: A wandering Water Genasi, disillusioned by the rife nationalism and xenophobia of his own people. Torrent sought to expand the horizons of his mind, to decide of his own accord. Often he is challenged in the lands of men, Baldur particularly for sour relations centuries old between their people, though he finds much kindness also in the hearts of Elves, Dwarves and men beyond Baldur. When he heard of the WEHL he opted to join, for seeing Tharador and being paid to do so seemed as if it needed no thought for him.

name: Tors of Delvdor – Dwarven Cleric of Life
description: A Dwarven Cleric from the depths of Delvdor. Tors was raised in a traditional Dwarven household, which often sees reverence to Cedhelieth, the divine of Life and Love. But Tors found himself smitten by love for his deity, dedicating his life to her. On a pilgrimage to Belfrie, Tors found an injured Elven ranger on the roadside nearing death. Healing the ranger, Tors learnt of the Elves’ conflict, making a promise to aid him in his quest as part of his duty to Cedhelieth.

name: Tors of Delvdor – Dwarven Cleric of Life & Glory
description: A Dwarven Cleric from the depths of Delvdor. Tors was raised in a traditional Dwarven household, which often sees reverence to Cedhelieth, the divine of Life and Love. But Tors found himself smitten by love for his deity, dedicating his life to her. On a pilgrimage to Belfrie, Tors found an injured Elven ranger on the roadside nearing death. Healing the ranger, Tors learnt of the Elves’ conflict, making a promise to aid him in his quest as part of his duty to Cedhelieth. Though what seemed like a straightforward quest proved a spiritual journey for Tors, who undertook a second oath to Erdrydion as it progressed.

name: Touches-The-Sky – Mammoth Rider
description: Enormous even by Goliath Standards, Touches-The-Sky is one who has had the fortune of travelling beyond Oldavor and returning. Aided by his enormous mammoth steed Skari, he is able to travel beyond the border mostly unopposed. Now he brings aid to his people in his home village of Pahadi, bringing foreign technologies and spells to aid in their survival. One day he hopes to bring them all beyond Oldavor, though knows that may result in too many deaths to bare.

name: Treasure Mimic
description: Chests left in the false vault beneath the casino that are in place to deal with any would-be thieves.

name: Trellus Tacitus – Baldurian Defector
description: Once a officer in training of Baldur, Trellus was considered among the most promising up-and-coming stars of the Baldur Military Academy. It was here that he excelled for his love of reading, constantly taking himself into study for hours. It was this that would also be his undoing – as he read of the Goltian War, he begun to piece together things that Baldur’s higher ups did not take lightly. Accusing Baldur of funding the Elemi invaders against their Goltian allies, Trellus attempted to blow the whistle, though quickly he was branded a traitor and slapped in the dungeons of Grimgate. Only after a year in captivity did he escape, thanks to a military coup that ravaged Grimgate at the time. He fled to Draksborne the first chance he could, and begun to plot against the downfall of the nation he once called home.

name: Treneal – The Resilient
description: A lumberjack turned druidic guardian. Treneal was once an industrial woodcutter for a Baldurian logging company near the fringes of Nan Thalias. When all his colleagues were slaughtered by Gwynevel and her spirits, Treneal knelt down to the spirit – offering his services to his dying days in exchange for his life. So his offer was accepted, and his human name of Bronson was stripped, replaced with Treneal, elven for “Devoted Warrior”. Now he fights the enemies of the forest, drinking the sap of the great Estel trees to further his own growth, lengthen his life and drive him into a frenzy when he enters combat.

name: Treneal Ironbark – Devoted Warrior
description: A lumberjack turned druidic guardian. Treneal was once an industrial woodcutter for a Baldurian logging company near the fringes of Nan Thalias. When all his colleagues were slaughtered by Gwynevel and her spirits, Treneal knelt down to the spirit – offering his services to his dying days in exchange for his life. So his offer was accepted, and his human name of Bronson was stripped, replaced with Treneal, elven for “Devoted Warrior”. Now he fights the enemies of the forest, drinking the sap of the great Estel trees to further his own growth, lengthen his life and drive him into a frenzy when he enters combat.

name: Trenon the Chainbreaker – Orc Hero
description: An Orc freed from slavery years ago: Trenon had spent his freedom in service to many. To gold, to lords, to honour.

name: Trenon the Redeemed
description: An orc freed from bondage who took up the role of a mercenary and a warrior in bid to repay those who freed him. Though down this path he realised his deeds were no less evil than those who had chained him. Thus he left the life of a mercenary and travelled north, forging a new and noble path for himself as a knight of honour.

name: Trenon the Remade – Golden Griffin Vanguard
description: An orc freed from bondage in Baldur, who took up the name of the liberator King of Belfrie in honour of him. Having spent the last several years of his life on the coastal isle of Mastania, Trenon chose to venture to the mainland shortly after his coming of age, along four of his kin. Shortly after their arrival, they witnessed a stagecoach robbery, which he and his kin intervened against. The other four were slain, and he was wounded, but the sole survivor. The merchants he saved were ever-grateful, though took pity on the death of his kin, giving him a large sum of gold that would have otherwise been stolen, they encouraged him to buy weapons and armour, so that he might continue his noble quest unabated by petty thugs.

name: Trixie “Sureshot” Kelpie – Pirate Gunslinger
description: Raised on the decks of a dozen different merchant vessels in the Grey Sea, Trixie was forced to learn to fend for herself at a young age.

name: Trogg Cannibals
description: Cursed creatures confined to the lightless depths of the darkest descents of Tharador, preying on discards and lone travellers.

name: Trostaka the Vengeful – Treant of Hatred
description: A treant without a home. His woods burned, mawed, forgotten, left to rot. No Druid can soothe his rage, nor quell his anger.

name: Tulva Drolls – Snow Trolls of the Deep
description: Those entombed in Khandara are not limited to the first giants and the experiments that were conducted here. A family of trolls, at one point or another, chose to settle in the depths. With a very small genetic pool, they have grown grotesque, inbred and even duller than their surface-dwelling counterparts. This has not made them any less deadly however, and the arms and armour of the giants in Khandara is well-fit to their boisterous forms.

name: Turak’tali – Colossal Druid of the Valley
description: A Colossal hailing from the Druidic Circle of Brel Endra in Oldavor. Turak’tali left her homeland to become the head of a smaller satellite coven of the Western Pillar of Brel Alda. It was her and her kin that first bore witness to the terrible affliction of Dragonsblight, and Turak’tali and her disciples have desperately travelled across Draksborne to contain the illness, before it can wreak further havoc on the densely populated cities of the kingdom. Canos is the largest city on the mainland, and Turak’tali feels it is her charge to save whatever she can, in spite of her failures to contain the illness when it first sprouted at her doorstep.

name: Tuzugo – Evangelist of the Sacred Fire
description: Alongside his cousin Gorozai, Tuzugo began a small uprising of Fire Elemi who sided with the crusaders in the Abunen Kolden War. Seeing the Fire Elemi rulers as tyrants and dictators over the others, they wished for a unified Elemi kingdom as it was in times long past. Rewarded for their bravery, the cousins were given the holy task of overseeing the guarding and containment of Kyubiko, a great Fire Spirit in the form of a Fox that resided on Tharador. A task that was of great religious significance to the Elemi, but of little risk, usually.

name: Tygrin Char – War Chief
description: Chief of Pahadi, inherited from his father at death. Tygrin is a charismatic leader though often will allow his more dominant and rage-induced side to shine through at times that require a clear head. Though when mistakes are made in these times Tygrin will admit to his faults and take responsibility, earning him more respect than most other chiefs are garnered in other tribes.

name: Tyria Ravensong – Dark Sorcereress
description: A licensed Sorceress for hire that has spent most her life on the road as a problem solver for the right fees.

name: Tyria Ravensong – Unbridled Sorceress
description: A licensed Sorceress for hire that has spent most her life on the road as a problem solver for the right price. She has often contemplated leaving the land that holds magic in such ill-regard, but knows that beyond Baldur’s borders magic is in much higher supply and much less demand. Though her clients hate her, they rely on her, and are thus willing to pay a huge sum of coins. Whilst she wields barely a fraction of her power to aid them, she longs for the chance to truly test her arcane abilities, and wonders whether that day will ever come.

name: Tyriana – Blade of Faith
description: A Knight-Paladin of Horauthin, dedicated to peace keeping and spreading the word of Horauthin within and beyond Tharador. Most recently returned from work with Slavers in Zandoriel, she met and befriended a Dragonborn on her return voyage, with whom she formed a strong bond after converting the wayward soul to Horauthin’s followers. When returned to Tharador, the two joined together in The Golden Griffins, Tyriana justifying it as a peacekeeping effort for them to partake in. Serene and calm in her demeanour, she seemingly ignores her partner paladin’s own bloodlust that erupts in the heat of battle.

name: Tyrius the Reborn – Angel of Erdrydion
description: Cursed with an incurable pestilence by Idinehleith, Arch Paladin Tyrius III vowed to act as the leader of his order until his body and mind failed him. He persevered, but his final expedition into the desert of Sudd Tohst saw his end, as he heroically sacrificed himself in a final show of strength to save his comrades. In such a selfless end, and devotion to Erdrydion in life, he was given a place among his patron’s Selvaneri.

name: Uktakun – Harbinger of Namneri
description: Colossals seldom worship the Tharameni beyond Horauthin: many see them as being directly responsible for the ruin of their civilization. Uktakun is one of the few exceptions to this, having a brush with death where Namneri spoke to him in a vision. When he awoke, an owl sat upon his chest, guiding him to safety. Uktakun saw the divine intervention for what it was: a call to a higher purpose. He has never strayed from that path since.

name: Umbra of Nortros – Shadow Rogue
description: Raised as an urchin in the sooty slums of the "jewel" of the Katarn Sea, Umbra's life was preordained into one of crime.

name: Umbrascale – Draconic Rogue
description: An agent of Rokarthion, though his loyalty to the Red Dragon are tenuous. Umbrascale and his kin descend from Kargon the Black Death, who is forced into subservience by his red scaled foe. Should Kargon dare to fight for independence against Rokarthion and his pacts again, they would face utter annihilation. So now they serve, though with gritted fangs and a hope that a chance will rise again for their freedom.

name: Underthwyn – Ancient Fey Dragon
description: An ancient green dragon who dedicated herself to Renmaeth in repentance for her sins in the Age of Creation. Becoming a creature of the Fey, Underthwyn has sought to act as a guardian to the creatures of the Hollow, ensuring it remains bountiful for those beneath, and does not impact the dwellings of Renmaeth’s Dream below, or Tharador above.

name: Undying Scallywags – Crew of the Damned Galleon
description: The mutinous crew of the Damned Galleon, cursed in their dying breaths to be bound to their rotting corpses.

name: Urkadu Goblin Tribe
description: One of many Goblin Tribes that have carved a home for themselves in the wilderness and caves of Belfrie. The Urkadu Tribe is a conglomerate of several lesser tribes, united by conquest several years ago by their queen, the hobgoblin Brakaza. They are mischievous and cantankerous, though their minds often teeter between brilliant and brainless. As more tribes join their ranks, the threat they hold to Belfrie grows, and with the Liturium War having raged for the last 5 years, they have been out of the sight and minds of Belfrie’s military.

name: Uxas the Reborn – Drow Lunar Monk
description: A wise monk who was captured, tortured and blinded after speaking out against the cruelties of Irinax’s followers in Iriksha.

name: Uxas Vergos – The Awakened Monk
description: A wise monk who was captured, tortured and blinded after speaking out against the cruelties of Irinax’s followers in Iriksha. His blindness is now a blessing, for he does not bear witness to the wrath he inflicts on his enemies in retribution. His shackles of restraint are long broken, and his shackles of bondage are now weapons he uses to disembody his foes in righteous fury. The complete destruction of Irinax and its followers are Uxas’ only remaining goal, as a man who never had anything, but still lost it all. Wisdom has been abandoned, only showing fleeting moments as anger and rage consume him instead.

name: Vaa'dren Snowmane – Lionfolk Bouncer
description: A lionman raised far from his ancestral home of Zandorion, dragged into organised crime from a young age.

name: Vaakrin Steeljaw – Black Dragonkin Fighter
description: Sovram's most loyal enforcer, an elder among his clan who was still alive in the days where the Darkscales called Dragonmaw Keep their home.

name: Vaezirak – Lord of the Eldraeth
description: An abhorrent spawn of proliferating corruption from planes far beyond Minera. Vaezirak was an outcast in his world, yet it was this banishment that spurred him into the monstrous form he takes today.

name: Vakara N’thara – Drow Assassin
description: An Assassin of the Order of N’thara. Vakara’s targets are both in the same place at the same time, adding double the thrill to her current hunt. Calculating, cold and efficient, Vakara kills pragmatically, and cruelty in her kills is usually just a side effect.

name: Valadhar Elite – Keydrin
description: An elite fighter of the Valadhar order – the highest ranking members of Hinatali military society. This ancient order of Eldritch Knights exists to protect the ancient merchant rulers of Hinatal and uphold Sun Elven way of life – meaning most have little allegiance to their human neighbours. All armed with an innate ability for spellcasting, Keydrin outshines the rest. Though relatively young, having been born in the subterranean city centuries after The Calamity, his deft magic abilities outshine all others in his order, leaving him to rival even most sorcerers or wizards while still being nearly as deadly with his double-bladed scimitar. Because of his lifelong praise, Keydrin has grown arrogant, and many heed him warning that it will prove to be his downfall.

name: Valius Hanar – Arch Marshall
description: The Arch Marshall of Leacianus and an unparalleled warrior. Valius Hanar has time and again proven why he is the ruler of Leacianus’ military and one of the three Triarchs. Even against both Ferendir and Artorian he is confident he would best them. He personally assassinated King Hjolmir I of Formen, ultimately beginning the Liturium War with his actions. He commanded his troops to plentiful victories at the war’s start, despite being heavily outnumbered. But now attrition weighs down on them all, and Valius now feels he must face the full retribution of his actions.

name: Valoris the Unscathed – Immortal Warrior
description: A warrior who never lost a battle, save for the battle of time and age. In his rebirth in Syelden, Valoris was given his body of youth and strength once again, pitting himself in an endless arena as his ideal afterlife. Now, after centuries of toil, he can put his experience to use against a true foe once again.

name: Valter Brookes – Hunter of the Defiled
description: The Brookes family were vampire hunters for generations. Valter’s ancestor was tasked with killing the vampiric twin of the Belfrie brothers during the Belfrie Rebellion. Having failed, it left a stain on their family that Valter now aims to set right. Having heard Arthur Belfrie was alive and well on Duskweave Isle before fleeing from the isle’s colonists, Valter now hunts him and other undead nobles through the seceded kingdoms that surround Draksborne. He now seeks aid from the Hex Hunters in Brighstone after hearing tellings of a Vampire Coven that matches Arthur’s in the northern kingdom.

name: Valter Brookes – Vampire Hunter
description: The Brookes family were vampire hunters for generations. Valter’s ancestor was tasked with killing the vampiric twin of the Belfrie brothers during the Belfrie Rebellion. Having failed, it left a stain on their family that Valter now aims to set right. Having heard Arthur Belfrie was alive and well on Duskweave Isle before fleeing from the isle’s colonists, Valter now hunts him and other undead nobles through the seceded kingdoms that surround Draksborne. He travels alongside Elaina, a warlock with similar convictions against the undead. Both backed by the Darkwing, they thank the organisation for the opportunity to fulfil their goals, though have little investment in the political ramifications of their actions.

name: Vampire Socialites – Guests of the Masquerade
description: Vampiric guests of the latest Masquerade at Castle Beaufax. Hailing from all corners of Tharador, some are kindred that have known the Baroness since the days of Duskweave.

name: Vampire Thralls of the Coven
description: Thralls ensnared into the Coven by various high ranking members, kept in chains and starved until set loose in a blood-crazed frenzy.

name: Vanguard – Trenon
description: Trenon was the liberated name this Orc chose to take upon himself. To name himself after the king of Belfrie that chose to welcome Orcs with open arms, rather than the aristocrats of Baldur who would see him enveloped in chains. Rescued by a smuggler in his fourth year of slavery, Trenon spent much of his recent years on the coastal isle of Mastania: an orc refuge funded by the Belfrian crown that still maintained its own autonomy. At the dawn of his maturity Trenon ventured to the mainland with four of his kin. In an attempt to protect merchants from a robbery his kin was slain and he was the sole survivor. Those in the carriage thanked Trenon and gave him funds to purchase his own armour and weapons.

name: Varathos – Warden of Syelden
description: One of the many wardens of Namneri who prowl the halls of Syelden, ensuring everything is as it should be. As Namneri designed it. They are mostly instilled to keep watch of malevolent forces that might infiltrate the home of the divine, and punish those who have tainted the holy place in their afterlife.

name: Varys Farseeker – Inquisitor Initiate
description: Half-Elves are rare to see within the Inquisitors, as many Baldurians superstitiously associate all Elves with magic and Minera’s Breath. Even rarer is to see a Half-Elf gifted with psionic potential, a trait that usually only emerges in humans. After a recent incident that resulted in the loss of his vision, Varys has begun to awaken to Psionic Powers. The Inquisitors, differentiating it from the whole evilness that is the Breath, wish to see how these powers might manifest, hoping to move him to the Dark Inquisitors if he proves himself as useful, and secretive.

name: Varys Farseeker – Psionic Dark Inquisitor
description: Half-Elves are rare to see within the Inquisitors, as many Baldurians superstitiously associate all Elves with magic and Minera's Breath.

name: Vastergotten – Grand Lancer
description: A Mastanian Orc that took on the name of a renowned and famous Orc that lived and died some sixty years ago, one of the heroes of Belfrie who had dispelled the demonic infestation at the Tower of Ardris. Vastergotten however is not the holy hero he was named after, and rather fits into the Orcish stereotype of having a penchant for big weapons and fighting powerful foes. The bigger the foe, the bigger the weapon – and Leacianus has some very big foes.

name: Vehryn – Petrified Succubus
description: An ancient Succubus turned to stone eons ago by a powerful Goliath Breathwielder during the first era. Her and ill nature forgotten, she was used as a statue moving through civilizations, merchants and nobles over millennia. Finally she found a resting place in the halls of Gehr Keep in Strassen, where she remained for centuries, constantly watching all that surrounded her but unable to do more than see. Finally in a time when the moon was veiled by the sun, Vehryn’s stony skin became animated, and she could move, speak and use her fiendish powers once more.

name: Velandrin Wolfsbane
description: An ex-Bloodhunter who left the ranks of the Brightstone Bloodhunters several years prior. Velandrin was deemed to fervent and passionate for her hatred of the unholy and undead even for them. Anything that might get in her way in her quest to purge might as well be undead themselves in her eyes.

name: Venatoris – Clockwork Golem
description: The latest and greatest creation of Tomas Lumens, aimed to be the vanguard of might in his revolution.

name: Vendimar Thyran – Dark Sun Paladin
description: Though Vendimar was once an aspiring Paladin of Glanion, that path has long since been strayed from. On the dawn of the solstice, he drew the blood of his brother-in-training in self defence. None would listen to his claims, believing him to be cursed, the mark of the black sun appearing on his chest thereafter, a mark denoting him as a bad omen. For his crime his was exiled from Hinatal, though has since embraced his cursed identity, now returning to Hinatal with renewed ill omens to inflict upon them.

name: Vera Lanius – Marshall of the Realm
description: Only daughters were born to Geryn Lanius, whom was the acting Marshall of Draksborne before his untimely death. When he passed, his duties fell to Vera, his eldest daughter who was only fourteen at the time and unwed. Thus, her and her sister’s youth was filled with military training and duties, very different from any other noble daughters in Draksborne. At the age of fifteen she was conferred the title of Marshall of the Realm and stepped into her father’s role. Now at only eighteen she commands the armies of Draksborne and has begun the training regiments to see them ready for invasions on the neighbouring kingdoms. So too does she oversee much of the operation of the Darkwing organisation.

name: Vera Lanius the Absolved – Knight Commander
description: Only daughters were born to Geryn Lanius, whom was the acting Marshall of Draksborne before his untimely death.

name: Verda – Vengeful Dryad
description: A Dryad from the Fringe who had merged with her treant partner as they lay dying. In her new form, Verda has taken on the barky skin of her partner, and learn how to wield them in deadly fashion to protect her woods, learning how to use the firearms of Baldurian Men against them. Though a new threat rises in the west, and she must leave her home of the Fringe to protect it from whatever grave threat is stirring in the Tryamin Woods.

name: Verdant Basilisk
description: An apex nocturnal predator of the forests and crags in the valleys of Eredel. Solitary hunters that occasionally hunt in pairs when mating, two of these creatures are enough to decimate a large contingent of soldiers, making them a terrifying foe.
